The wisest know well to fear the anger of a gentle soul; yours is the gentle soul they fear.

Tranquility barbarians are masters of the primal energies that flow through them. Such warriors are focused, calculating, and devastatingly effective in combat, wielding Rage not as a sledgehammer, but as a scalpel. Far from wrathful brutes, they are often eloquent and gentle, but the perceptive might glimpse the fire that smolders behind their eyes. The fury within warriors who walk this path is under control, but remains just as potent as the fire that burns within any barbarian. They are tenacious and brave, speak softly, and carry a very large stick.

subclassFeature.name: Tempered Fury
entries: Your rage focuses and fortifies your mind. While raging, you have bonus to Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws equal to your Rage damage bonus.

subclassFeature.name: Heightened Instinct
entries: The steely mastery you have cultivated over your own rage makes you more astute than most. You gain proficiency in the {@skill Insight} and {@skill Animal Handling} skills, and you can add your Strength modifier to checks you make with those skills.

subclassFeature.name: Calculated Aggression
entries: You have the focus to unite ferocity with calculating technique in combat. You learn the {@optfeature Great Weapon Fighting} fighting style or another {@filter fighting style|optionalfeatures|feature type=FS:F} of your choice from the Fighter list. You can change your chosen fighting style for another from the Fighter list anytime you level up.

subclassFeature.name: Stalwart
entries: Your unshakable tenacity in combat lends confidence to your companions. Allied creatures within 10 feet of you are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition.

subclassFeature.name: Watchful Warrior
entries: Your focus in battle is unparalleled, letting you flawlessly track and predict your foes. Creatures cannot have advantage on attack rolls against you as long as you aren't {@condition incapacitated}.

subclassFeature.name: Flow State
entries: Your hyper awareness and mastery of mind and body allows you to enter a trance-like state in battle. When you make an attack roll while raging, you can choose to begin concentrating (as if concentrating on a spell) and enter this flow state, which lasts until your Rage ends or you lose {@status concentration}.

While in a flow state, your movement speed increases by 10 feet, you have advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws, and when you take the {@action Attack} action and reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can immediately use a bonus action to leap up to 30 feet and make a single weapon attack.
Once you enter this flow state, you cannot do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

subclassFeature.name: Explosive Strike
entries: Your mastery of the primal fury that dwells within allows you to unleash it at the most devastating moment. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack while raging, you can expend a further use of your rage to deal additional damage to the target equal to your Strength score. You can use this feature a number of times per day equal to half your Strength Modifier (rounded up), regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Barkarmour
entries: Druids of the Circle of Barkarmour fortify themselves with the immutable power of the Ironthorn Forest. Barkarmour druids are legendary carpenters and fierce warriors, harnessing the abjuration-infused plants native to Ironthorn to fortify their clothing with incredible magic; the result is the legendarily tough and flexible garb known as Barkarmour.

Many druids of this circle tend to forests as guardians, ferociously defending the woodland's borders from poachers, monsters, and any who would trample the natural world for their own gain. Others of this circle travel the world, sowing the seeds of Ironthron far and wide and cultivating its plants and magic wherever they tread. To all barkarmour druids, the relationship with nature is one of symbiotic protection; the magic of Ironthorn guards and invigorates all who bond with it, and in turn, members of this circle wield its power in staunch defense of the wilds.

subclassFeature.name: Circle Spells
entries: The magic of the Ironthorn forest confers unto you the ability to cast certain spells. Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the {@filter Druid spell list|spells|class=Druid}, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

entries.caption: Circle of Barkarmour Spells
rows: {@spell conjure minor elementals}, {@spell Otiluke's resilient sphere||resilient sphere}

subclassFeature.name: Druidic Armourcraft
entries: You have the knowledge and craftsmanship to create powerful armour from wood and plants blessed with the magic of Ironthorn. You gain proficiency with {@item Carpenter's Tools|PHB}, and you can craft a set of magical Light Armour, known as barkarmour, over the course of a Long Rest. The barkarmour you create is tailored specifically to connect with your druidic power; only you can wield it. As you advance in levels, the potency of your barkarmour increases, as shown in the Druidic Armourcraft table below.

subclassFeature.name: Nature's Knight
entries: You can use your barkarmour as a spellcasting focus for your Druid spells. Additionally, you can perform the Somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a {@item Shield|PHB} in one or both hands.

subclassFeature.name: Nature's Fortification
entries: The magic of your barkarmour extends beyond mere physical protection, vitalising your body with an endless flow of energy in synchronicity with your druidic magic. When you cast a spell that requires {@status concentration}, and at the start of each of your turns while you are concentrating on a spell, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Nature's Valor
entries: The magic that flows through your barkarmour energises your body ever further. While you are wearing barkarmour, your speed increases by 10 feet and you gain proficiency in Dexterity saving throws.

Additionally, when you take the Magic action, you can make one weapon attack or cast a druid cantrip as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once) regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Tenacity of Ironthorn
entries: The immutable abjuration magic of the Ironthorn Forest gleams across your armour. While wearing barkarmour, you resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of the Dragon Rider
entries: The Oath of the Dragon Rider calls to paladins who harness a connection with their steeds to inspire hope and courage on the battlefield. A common choice for holy cavalry, these paladins form deep bonds with their warrior mounts, forging a path of glory through the thickets of bloody combat.

To these paladins, a steed is more than a mere tool of war. They see great spiritual value in the preservation, study and defense of beasts and nature. Fiercely protective of their companions, Oath of the Dragon Rider Paladins train ceaselessly in mounted combat, and take pride in treating their mounts with the same respect and dignity as any other warrior. They are more than transport, a steed is one's first and last ally, and most powerful weapon.

entries.name: Tenets of the Dragon Rider:
entries: A paladin who takes this oath commits these tenets to memory.

{@b Strength in Unity:} The one who fights alone is the first to fall. Against the terrible forces of darkness and chaos, only together can those who stand against them prevail. Be thankful for all allies where you can find them. Strength is numbers.

{@b Loyalty unto Death:} Once trust is earned, it is kept forever. To abandon one's people, or betray one's Oath, is the most terrible crime one can commit. Better to die standing with honor alongside your allies than to flee alone and live as a coward.

{@b Discipline:} In the heat of battle, it is discipline which cuts through the terror and the blood. Only through vehement training and order can one develop the skills to survive. Do not trust to instinct; trust to discipline.

{@b Friendship:} It is the bonds formed between friends and family that will save us at the last. There is little point to fighting if not to protect those whom you love. The best path to resolving conflict is to find ways to forge bonds and understand one another. Rarely is lasting peace forged with the sword.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain Oath Spells at the Paladin levels listed in the Oath of the Dragon Riders table.

entries.caption: Oath of the Dragon Rider Spells

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity
entries: When you take this Oath at 3rd Level, you gain the following channel divinity options:

items.name: Lead the Charge!
entries: As a bonus action, you can use your Channel Divinity to empower a furious, headlong assault on the enemy. You or your mount can move up to 30ft, and then you can immediately make a single melee weapon attack against a creature within range.

items.name: Primal Command
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to utter a primal command that beasts can understand. As an action, you present your holy symbol, and each beast of your choice within range that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the beast is {@condition charmed} by you for 1 hour or you or your companions deal damage to it.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of The Rider
entries: Starting at 7th level, your emanate an aura of command while you are not {@condition incapacitated}. The aura extends 10 feet from you in every direction, but not through total cover.

Friendly creatures in your aura that you have summoned (through a spell such as {@spell Find Steed} or {@spell Find Familiar}) gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier at the start of each of their turns, and may use your Spell Save DC when they force another creature to make a saving throw.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Draconic Steed
entries: Also at 7th level, you can summon a spiritual dragon with the spell {@spell Find Steed}. Use the {@creature Copper Dragon Wyrmling} stat block for this creature's statistics, except its size is large, not medium, and it's alignment changes to match yours, and its fly speed is equal to half your walking speed while a creature is mounted on it.
In addition, if you are mounted on an independent creature that takes its own turns, when you move on your turn, you may choose to move your mount, using their movement speed, instead.

subclassFeature.name: True Dragon Rider
entries: Starting at 15th level, you can summon a powerful spiritual dragon with the spell {@spell Find Greater Steed|XGE|Find Greater Steed}. Use the {@creature Red Dragon Wyrmling} stat block for this creature's statistics, except its size is large, not medium, and its alignment changes to match yours.

subclassFeature.name: Master of the Mount
entries: From 20th level, your mastery of combat imbues you with divine power while mounted. As an action while mounted, you gain the following benefits for one minute:

items: You and your mount gain a +2 bonus to your AC.
Your mount gains resistance to all damage.
The first time your mount would fall to 0 hit points while you are conscious, it falls to 1 hit point instead.
You may treat any roll for your mount to regain a recharge action as a 6.

race.name: Castanoot
entries: There are three main variants: The {@race Castanoot (Caescean)|DMSecretWeapon|Caescean}, {@race Castanoot (Dentata)|DMSecretWeapon|Dentata}, and {@race Castanoot (Sativan)|DMSecretWeapon|Sativan}.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Most Zu-Zoi stand a little shorter than a typical human, at around 5 feet. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Zu-Zoi have shorter lifespans than humans, laying eggs that hatch and mature in a single year, and go on to live for roughly half a century. They show few internal or external signs of age, as healthy and intelligent in their second year as in their last.

entries.name: Many Eyes
entries: You gain proficiency in either {@skill Insight} or {@skill Perception} (your choice).

entries.name: One with the Land
entries: You gain proficiency in either {@skill Nature} or {@skill Survival} (your choice).

entries.name: Steadfast Spirit
entries: You have advantage on saving throws to resist {@condition exhaustion}.

sizeEntry.name: Small:
entries: Feytroll are around 3 feet tall and weigh between 50-60 pounds. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Age
entries: New Feytroll are born from the earth after two fully matured Feytroll engage in a magical courtship ritual under the gentle glow of dawn's first light, while both the sun and moon share the sky. They grow to adulthood over the course of 30 years, and then go on to live for several centuries.

entries.name: Fey
entries: Your creature type is Fey, rather than humanoid.

entries.name: Woodland Being
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Stealth}, {@skill Animal Handling}, or {@skill Nature}.

entries.name: Sunborn
entries: You can spend 10 minutes bathing in the light of the sun. If you do, you gain the benefits of a short rest. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Moonborn
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern colour in darkness, only shades of grey.

entries.name: Natural Illusionist
entries: You know the {@spell minor illusion} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the spell {@spell disguise self} without components with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the spell {@spell invisibility} without components with this trait. Once you cast {@spell disguise self} or {@spell invisibility} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Lostanta vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Lostanta age incredibly slowly, reaching physical maturity after about 50 years, and going on to live for up to a millenia.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Lostanta are as variable in character as any other humanoid, but generations in the Ethereal Plane have shifted their outlook towards an apathetic, distant view of morality. They tend towards Neutral alignment.

entries.name: Timeless
entries: You have advantage on Constitution saves to resist the {@condition exhaustion} condition.

entries.name: Long Lived
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill History} and {@skill Survival} skills.

entries.name: Born of the Void
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as though it were bright light, and in darkness as though it were dim light. In addition, you can use a bonus action to focus your ethereal powers and grant yourself 10 ft. of blindsight until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Ancient Training
entries: You learn a {@filter fighting style|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=FS:F} of your choice from the fighter class, or you learn a {@filter cantrip|spells|class=sorcerer|level=0} of your choice from the sorcerer class. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this race).

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: The typical Cyclod adult stands around 7ft tall. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Longstriders
entries: Your base walking speed is 35 ft.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Natural Aptitude
entries: You gain proficiency with one tool, one skill, and one martial weapon of your choice.

entries.name: Magic Eye
entries: You can see up to 500 ft. away without difficulty, able to discern even fine details as though looking at something no more than 100 feet away from you. In addition, you can see in dim light within 120 ft. of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Cyclod Regeneration
entries: As a bonus action, you can spend one hit die to heal yourself. Roll the die, add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of hit points equal to the total (minimum of 1). You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: You are the same size as your original race, or your size can be Medium or Small.

entries.name: Clagborne Traits
entries: Clagborne are formed by a brainless ooze melding with a humanoid corpse. You may choose the humanoid race your Clagborne melded with, and use some of its statistics in your stat block. At your DMs discretion, you may become a Clagborne after your player character dies and melds with the ooze.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write any languages your original race knew in life, or you can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 30 feet. Even if your base race had a natural flying or swimming speed, you do not.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries: You don't need to breathe and you do not age.

entries.name: Clagborne Legacy
entries: If you replace a race with this lineage, you can retain any skill proficiencies you gained from it. If not, you gain proficiency in two skills of your choice. In addition, if your original race could take a feat with a racial prerequisite, you can still take it as a Clagborne.

entries.name: Ooze
entries: You have a climb speed equal to your walking speed, and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Constitution modifier. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

entries.name: Malleable Form
entries: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size equal to or larger than yours.

entries.name: Translucency
entries: As a bonus action, you can alter the translucency of your ooze body, potentially frightening an enemy by revealing the skeleton within. When you do so, one creature of your choice with 15 ft. who can see you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) or become {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries: Whenever you roll a hit dice to recover hit points, treat any number rolled on that dice as the maximum. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Age
entries: You do not age. Westurai are created fully formed, and have no concept of childhood, youth, or old age.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Westurai tend towards lawful good alignments, but those free of their creator's influence may drift towards more neutral and chaotic outlooks.

entries.name: Speed
entries: You have a base walking speed of 30ft, and a flying speed equal to your walking speed. In order to sustain your heavy body in flight, you require maximum maneuverability. You can't fly while wearing medium or heavy armor.

entries.name: From Stone
entries: Your body was hewn from stone before being imbued with magic. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 12 + your Constitution modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

entries.name: Stone Form
entries: As an action, you can shift into a being of pure stone. You and all objects you are holding turn to stone. Your movement speed becomes 0, attack rolls against you are made at advantage, and you auto fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws. In addition, you resist all damage, you have advantage on Constitution and Wisdom saving throws, and you can't take any actions, except to use an action to return to normal. You are indistinguishable from a true statue. Only a creature who succeeds on an Investigation check ({@dc 13}) can identify you as a Westurai.

entries.name: Divine Impetus
entries: You have advantage on saving throws to resist the {@condition charmed} condition, and you gain proficiency in the {@skill Religion} skill.

entries.name: Divine Magic
entries: You know the {@spell mending} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell sanctuary} spell with his trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell calm emotions} spell with this trait. Once you cast {@spell sanctuary} or {@spell calm emotions} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Aemyr stand between 2 and 3ft tall. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Age
entries: Aemyr mature slower than humans, reaching adulthood in their third decade. On average, they live for about 80 years.

entries.name: Speed
entries: Your base walking speed is 30ft, and you have a fly speed equal to your walking speed while you aren't wearing medium or heavy armour.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Ichorborne vary wildly in size, from as small as 3 feet all the way up to 8 feet tall. Your size is Medium or Small.

entries.name: Age
entries: Ichorborne come into being at sites of great bloodshed. They have no childhood and show no signs of ageing. Their bodies last roughly a century before breaking down.

entries.name: Ichoral Intuition
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Medicine} skill.

entries.name: Humoural Tampering
entries: Once per turn, when you come into physical contact with a creature, you can force that creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, that creature is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Bloodmist
entries: As an action, you can shift your form and any everything you are wearing and carrying into a misty cloud of red vapour.

While in this form, your only method of movement is a flying speed of 10 ft. You can enter and occupy the space of another creature. You resist nonmagical damage, and can pass through small holes, narrow openings, and even mere cracks, but you treat liquids as though they were solid surfaces. While in this form you can't fall, and remain hovering in the air even when {@condition stunned} or otherwise {@condition incapacitated}.
While in Bloodmist form, you can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects you were carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. You can't attack or cast spells.

This transformation lasts for 10 minutes, or until you use a bonus action to end it. It ends early if you are knocked {@condition unconscious}. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Augmegnome stand taller than humans, at around 7 feet high. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Augmegnome mature at the same rate as humans and other gnomes, and are expected to settle into adult life at around 40. They typically have shorter lifespans than other gnomes, living for around three centuries.

entries.name: Gnomish Vitality
entries: You have advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saving throws against magic.

entries.name: Lunging Reach
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Augmented Aura
entries: When you cast a spell with the range of touch, you can make the range of that spell 30 feet. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Augmegnome Magic
entries: You know the {@spell thaumaturgy} cantrip. Starting at 5th level, you can cast the spell {@spell fly} with this trait, targeting only yourself. Once you cast {@spell fly} with this trait, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest. You can also cast {@spell fly} with any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Augmegnome Talents
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Perception}, {@skill Persuasion}.

entries.name: Age
entries: Firmakin reproduce asexually, and a young Firmakin roams with its parent until it is fully grown, after which time it leaves to beat its own path in the wilds. Firmakin reach adulthood at around 30, and go on to live for up to five centuries.

entries.name: Terrain Link
entries: You have {@sense tremorsense} in a 5 ft. radius while standing on the natural ground, or a surface constructed from stone or wood. This range increases to 10 ft. when you reach level 9, and 15 ft. when you reach level 17.

entries.name: Natural Magic
entries: You know the {@spell druidcraft} cantrip.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Superior Synthesis
entries: While in direct sunlight or moonlight, you can take a short rest in 10 minutes. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

entries.name: One With The Earth
entries: Starting at 5th level, you can use your action to gain a burrow speed equal to your movement speed until the end of this turn.

entries.name: Language
entries: You speak Primordial and Common.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Caridae are famously variable in size, even within the same family. Grown Caridae range from 3 feet to 7 feet tall. Your size is Small or Medium (your choice).

entries.name: Age
entries: Caridae reach adulthood in their early teens, and go on to live for around half a century.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You have a swim speed equal to your walking speed, and you can hold your breath for up to four hours.

entries.name: Natural Adhesive
entries: You are naturally sticky. You have advantage on any skill checks you make to climb or hold onto something, and other creatures have disadvantage on any skill check they make to escape being {@condition grappled} by you.

entries.name: Claws
entries: Your claws are natural weapons. When you make an unarmed strike using them, you deal damage equal to {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Cacophonous Croak
entries: Caridae can speak at an incredible volume. At full intensity, your words can be heard and understood clearly from up to 1,000 feet away.

entries.name: Jungle Born
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Nature} skill.

entries.name: Caridae Type
entries: Choose one of the following types for your Caridae: {@race Caridae (Fire-Belly)|DMSecretWeapon|Fire-Belly}, {@race Caridae (Galvanic)|DMSecretWeapon|Galvanic}, {@race Caridae (Poison Dart)|DMSecretWeapon|Poison Dart}, or {@race Caridae (Kinetic)|DMSecretWeapon|Kinetic}. Each has an associated power. The Saving Throw DC for these effects is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Pelaggion adults stand between 6-7 feet tall. Females are typically a little larger than males. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Pelaggion have a similar lifespan to humans, reaching adulthood in their early 20s and living for about a century.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe in both water and air.

entries.name: Pelaggonian Niche
entries: Through diligent training to provide a service to your community, you are proficient in one skill and with one artisan's tool of your choice.

entries.name: Glimpse the Future
entries: You know the {@spell guidance} cantrip, and can cast it as a bonus action, without components, using this trait. You can cast {@spell guidance} in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Waterborn
entries: You resist fire damage.

entries.name: Hunter's Instinct
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception} and {@skill Survival}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks made to find or track a creature.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Pooka stand tall among other humanoids, reaching up to 8ft in height. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Pooka grow extremely slowly as larvae beneath the earth. They emerge from the ground fully formed after about a century, and go on to live for up to 500 years.

entries.name: Double Vision
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} and {@skill Insight} skills.

entries.name: Split Mind
entries: You have advantage on saving throws to resist the {@condition charmed} condition.

entries.name: Poison Claw
entries: As a bonus action, you can make one unarmed strike against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you deal {@damage 1d12} poison damage. At level 11, this damage increases to {@damage 2d12}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain all expended uses on a long rest.

entries.name: Symbiotic Pooka
entries: If you have never desynchronised, you know the {@spell druidcraft} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level you can cast the {@spell cure wounds} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell enhance ability} spell with this trait. Once you cast {@spell cure wounds} or {@spell enhance ability} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).
If you are ever desynchronised, you lose this ability.

entries.name: Desynchronised Pooka
entries: If you are currently or have ever been desynchronised, you know the {@spell thaumaturgy} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level you can cast the {@spell entangle} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell blindness/deafness} spell with this trait. Once you cast {@spell entangle} or {@spell blindness/deafness} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Powgarfoot are naturally beefy folk, reaching up to 8 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Powgarfoot mature quickly, and live slightly shorter lives than humans, reaching up to 70 years old.

entries.name: Delightful Appetite
entries: When you spend at least 5 minutes eating, you can expend a number of hit dice up to your proficiency modifier, roll them, add your Constitution modifier, and regain that many hit points.

entries.name: Strong Stomach
entries: You are immune to the negative effects of poisons, toxins, and other harmful substances that you ingest.

entries.name: Resolute Mind
entries: You are immune to the {@condition charmed} condition.

entries.name: Skilled Paws
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Cook's Utensils|PHB} and in one skill of your choice from among {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Chookardian vary in size from between three and five feet tall. Your size is Small or Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Chookardian mature quickly and live fairly short lives, reaching up to 40 years old.

entries.name: Horns
entries: Your horns are a natural weapon, and you can use them to make unarmed strikes. When you do, the unarmed strike deals {@damage 1d6} piercing damage plus your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Light Magic
entries: You know the {@spell light} cantrip, and Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

entries.name: Knack For Survival
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling} and {@skill Survival} skills, as well as with one type of {@item Artisan's Tools|PHB} of your choice.

entries.name: Expert Rider
entries: If you are mounted on a beast or a creature you have summoned with a spell, that creature's movement increases by 10 feet and it gains a bonus to its Armour Class and saving throws equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down).

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you gain this lineage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for the character. If you are replacing your race with this lineage, you retain any languages you had and gain no new languages.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: Though your spirit clings to life beyond its natural end, you are not a true undead. Your creature type is Humanoid.

entries.name: Ancestral Legacy
entries: If you replace a race with this lineage, you can keep any skill proficiencies you gained from it. If you do not, you gain proficiency in any two skills of your choice.

entries.name: Inured to Death
entries: When you take necrotic, cold, or poison damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to that damage type until the end of this turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain all expended uses on a long rest.

entries.name: Spectral Form
entries: You can temporarily enter a true spectral form. As an action, you can cast the spell {@spell etherealness}, without expending a spell slot, but the spell ends at the end of the current turn. Once you use this trait, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Spectral Touch
entries: Your unarmed strikes deal {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage, in place of the usual bludgeoning damage.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Mollopod reach maturity when their shell manifests, usually around the age of 20, and go on to live for up to three centuries.

entries.name: Bottomless Shell
entries: Your shell is a gateway to an extra-dimensional space. You can store any number of objects in that space that are small enough to fit through the entrance to your shell, which is around 1 foot in diameter. Only objects can enter this extra-dimensional space, and the only manner in which you can enter it is to use an action to reach in and place or retrieve something from inside. You can picture the object you wish to retrieve from your shell, and so long as it has been stored in the extra-dimensional space that object will appear in your hand as you withdraw it.

entries.name: Divination
entries: You are blessed with an innate sense of things to come. You know the {@spell guidance} cantrip. You also know the {@spell detect magic} spell or one other 1st-level Divination spell of your choice, and you can cast that spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot. You can also cast that spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Sturdy Shell
entries: When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 12 + your Constitution modifier. You can use this feature to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you calculate your AC with this feature.

entries.name: Viscous Climber
entries: You can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. If you move across a surface leaving your hands free in this way, treat that surface as difficult terrain.

entries.name: Viscous Grip
entries: You have advantage on ability checks made to grapple a creature and on ability checks and saving throws to avoid being moved against your will, disarmed, or knocked {@condition prone}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Gree are born between 3-4 feet tall and do not naturally grow across their lives. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gree are born fully sized, hatched from eggs that magically appear in gree communities where resources are plentiful enough to facilitate population growth. They are swift learners, considered adults from age 14, and live to be up to 50 years old.

entries.name: Lantern Bearer
entries: You know the {@spell produce flame} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Trick-or-Treat
entries: As a bonus action, you can attempt to frighten or support a creature you can see within 30 feet of you.

If you choose to frighten that creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Charisma or Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) or become {@condition frightened} of you for the next minute. A creature surprised by you makes this save at a disadvantage. The target can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
If you choose to support a creature, it gains a bonus to the next attack roll, ability check, or save throw it makes before the start of your next turn equal to your proficiency bonus.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Utilitarian Fashion
entries: When you came of age, you crafted a costume that is significant and personal to you, and harbours some innate magical properties. You can don or doff your costume as an action, even if you are wearing armour or other clothing. In addition, while wearing your costume, you have expertise in one skill (choose when you pick this race), and you have advantage on saving throws to resist or end the {@condition frightened} condition.
If your costume is destroyed, you can make another one over the course of a week's work and with 50gp worth of materials. You can only have one costume at a time.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: You are Medium or Small. Chiropine sizes vary greatly, even within the same family.

entries.name: Age
entries: Chiropine grow rapidly, reaching adulthood at around 12. They typically live up to 80 years old.

entries.name: Chiropine Vigor
entries: If you take the {@action Dash} action on your turn, you can use your bonus action on that turn to make a single weapon attack or take the {@action Dash}, {@action Dodge}, or {@action Disengage} action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest. If you have no uses remaining you can still use this trait, but you gain one level of {@condition exhaustion} at the end of the turn.

entries.name: Echolocation
entries: As a bonus action, you can let loose an ultrasonic shriek and listen to the echo. Doing so allows you to identify your immediate surroundings for a moment. You have {@sense blindsight} until the end of this turn, as long as you are not {@condition deafened}.

entries.name: Sensitive Sight
entries: You have disadvantage on {@skill Perception} checks while in direct sunlight.

entries.name: Ultrasonic
entries: You can produce and hear sound waves with a frequency above the upper limit of typical Humanoid hearing. You can hear creatures that produce ultrasonic sounds, and communicate simple signals to such creatures at a frequency undetectable to most Humanoids. Your ultrasonic vocalisations are crude, and cannot form words or the verbal components of spells.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for your character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: You are Medium. Lamnite are larger than humans, with long arms and four legs, typically standing around 7 feet tall.

entries.name: Age
entries: Lamnite are able to walk within minutes of birth, and reach maturity within a decade. They typically live for up to a century.

entries.name: Ice Walker
entries: You ignore difficult terrain imposed by ice and snow.

entries.name: Fur Coat
entries: You resist cold damage.

entries.name: Pocket Darkness
entries: As a bonus action, you can conjure magical darkness. The darkness appears in a 10-foot cube within 60 feet of you. When you conjure it, you can choose for it to appear as an area of translucent dim light or opaque blackness which heavily obscures the area. You can see through any magical darkness you create with this trait as if it were normal darkness. The darkness lasts for 1 minute, or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

entries.name: Skulking Survivalist
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects while in magical darkness.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for your character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Your size is Medium. Fully grown centovis stand between 6 feet tall.

entries.name: Age
entries: Centovis mature slower than humans, reaching adulthood at around 25. They can go on to live for up to 300 years.

entries.name: Fluffy
entries: Your woolen coat grants you a measure of protection from the elements. You resist cold damage.

entries.name: Hooves
entries: You can use your hooves to make unarmed strikes, which deal {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage on a hit. You have advantage on unarmed strikes using your hooves made against {@condition prone} creatures.

entries.name: Shared Vitality
entries: A bipedal, medium-sized creature can ride you as a mount, if you are willing. When it does so, you share a bond of vitality. On its turn, a rider can transfer its energy to you. You move as it dictates, if you are willing, using its movement speed.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag.

entries.name: Willing Mount
entries: A willing creature mounted on you has a bonus to its attack rolls and saving throws equal to half your proficiency bonus while you are concious.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for your character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Fully grown dyenoia can reach up to 7 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Dyenoia reach adulthood at 13 years of age, and can live for up to 60 years.

entries.name: Chlorophyll
entries: While you are not in darkness, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws and when you roll Hit Dice.

entries.name: Maw
entries: The maw atop your head is a second mouth and a fanged weapon that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, you deal piercing damage equal to {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Clamp
entries: When you hit a creature that is no more than one size larger than you with your maw, you can forgo dealing damage to grapple the target instead. While grappling a creature in this way, you cannot make further unarmed strikes with your maw, and the {@condition grappled} creature takes {@damage 1d6} acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If this acid damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to that creature's Challenge Rating or Level.

entries.name: Ferocity
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Hit Die. Roll the die; the target takes additional damage to the result. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Ouroborus Warrior
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Swift Growth
entries: You regain one expended Hit Die when you finish a short rest.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Dragonborn are taller and heavier than humans, standing well over 6 feet tall and averaging almost 250 pounds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Young dragonborn grow quickly. They walk hours after hatching, attain the size and development of a 10-year-old human child by the age of 3, and reach adulthood by 15. They live to be around 80.

entries.name: Breath Weapon
entries: When you select this race, choose one damage type from among acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. When you take the attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of destructive energy of the damage type you chose in a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot line. Each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) taking {@damage 1d8} damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. This damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}). You can use this breath weapon a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

entries.name: Draconic Lineage
entries: The blood of dragons runs through your veins, and can confer many incredible benefits. Choose two traits from the following options that you inherit from your draconic ancestors.

items.name: Aquatic
entries: You can breathe underwater, and you have a swim speed equal to your walking speed.

items.name: Hardened Scales
entries: While you aren't wearing armour, you can calculate your AC as 13 + your Dexterity modifier. A shield's benefits apply as normal.

items.name: Damage Resistance
entries: You have a resistance to the damage type you selected for your Breath Weapon trait.

items.name: Dragon's Maw
entries: Your teeth are long and vicious, and you can use them to make unarmed strikes. When you hit an unarmed strike using your bite, it deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

items.name: Draconic Mind
entries: You have advantage on saves against the {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} conditions.

items.name: Draconic Talent
entries: You have proficiency in two skills from among the following: {@skill Deception}, {@skill History}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Nature}, {@skill Persuasion}, {@skill Stealth}, and {@skill Survival}.

items.name: Natural Warrior
entries: You have proficiency with light armour and with two martial weapons of your choice. If you already have proficiency with light armour from another source, such as a class feature, this trait confers proficiency with medium armour instead.

items.name: Swiftfoot
entries: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

entries.name: Draconic Magic
entries: All dragons possess an element of natural magic. Choose one trait from the following options to determine how your magic manifests.

items.name: Blindsight
entries: You can use a bonus action to quiet your mind and enhance your senses. Until the start of your next turn, you have {@sense blindsight} out to 15 feet.

items.name: Draconic Resilience
entries: When you make a saving throw to resist a spell or magical effect, before you make the save, you can choose to make that roll at advantage. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

items.name: Gift of the Bloodline
entries: You gain two additional benefits of your choice from your Draconic Lineage trait.

items.name: Innate Sorcery
entries: You learn one cantrip of your choice from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}. You also learn one first level spell from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}, and you can cast it without a spell slot once per long rest. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability when you cast these spells (choose when you gain this trait).

items.name: Limited Flight
entries: As an action, you can grant yourself a flying speed equal to half your walking speed and can hover for the next minute. You can't use this trait if you are wearing medium or heavy armour. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

items.name: Superior Breath Weapon
entries: The damage dice you roll when calculating the damage of your breath weapon increases from a d8 to a d12, and the area of effect increases to a 30-foot cone or a 60-foot line.

race.name: Half-Orc (Variant)
entries: As a half-orc, you have the following traits:

entries.name: Age
entries: Half-orcs mature a little faster than humans, reaching adulthood around age 14. They age noticeably faster and rarely live longer than 75 years.

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Dual Lineage
entries: Choose one of the following lineages and gain the associated benefits: {@race Half-Orc (Variant; Human)|DMSecretWeapon|Human}, {@race Half-Orc (Variant; High Elf)|DMSecretWeapon|High Elf}, {@race Half-Orc (Variant; Halfling)|DMSecretWeapon|Halfling}, {@race Half-Orc (Variant; Gnome)|DMSecretWeapon|Gnome}, {@race Half-Orc (Variant; Tiefling)|DMSecretWeapon|Tiefling}, {@race Half-Orc (Variant; Dwarf)|DMSecretWeapon|Dwarf}, {@race Half-Orc (Variant; Dragonborn)|DMSecretWeapon|Dragonborn}, or {@race Half-Orc (Variant; Centaur)|DMSecretWeapon|Centaur}.

race.name: Cloudian

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Cloudian's vary greatly in size, with adults ranging anywhere between 3-8 feet tall. Your size is Medium or Small.
As a cloudian, you have the following traits:

entries.name: Atmospheric Adaptation
entries: You resist lightning damage.

entries.name: Into Vapour
entries: You have the power to shift your body, along with what you are wearing and carrying, into vapour. You can cast the spell {@spell gaseous form} with this trait, but it can only target yourself. Once you cast {@spell gaseous form} with this trait, you can't cast it with this trait again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

entries.name: Fogmask
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by fog, rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Skyborne Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Nature} and {@skill Perception} skills.

entries.name: Silver Lining
entries: Whenever you roll natural 1 on a saving throw, you immediately gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier.
In addition, your melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes are considered silvered for the purpose of overcoming damage immunities and resistances.

race.name: Myod
entries: As a Myod you have the following traits:

entries.name: Grasping Tentacles
entries: You have advantage on {@skill Athletics} checks made to grapple creatures, and you can grapple creatures using your tentacles, leaving both arms free.

entries.name: Ink Cloud
entries: In place of one attack when you take the attack action, you can release a blast of ink, which behaves differently depending on whether or not you are underwater.

items: If you are underwater, a 10-foot-radius cloud of ink extends all around you. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, you can take the {@action Dash} action as a bonus action.

If you are not underwater, one creature within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} by the ink for 1 minute, or until they use an action to wipe the ink away. After releasing the ink, you can take the {@action Dash} action as a bonus action.

entries: You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Many Brains
entries: You have advantage on Intelligence saving throws.

entries.name: Oceanborne
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Your character can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Avestrosian gnolls typically reach 5-6 feet in height. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

entries.name: Bite
entries: You have a fierce jaw that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Iron Composure
entries: Avestrosian gnolls have evolved to overcome their innate, ferocious temperament through incredible self-discipline. This iron composure gives you {@bold advantage} on Wisdom saving throws.

entries.name: Goblinoid Guile
entries: You have proficiency in two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Perception}, {@skill Persuasion}, {@skill Stealth}, {@skill Survival}.

entries.name: Pack Attack
entries: In place of one of your attacks when you take the Attack action, you can let loose a primal roar. One creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear you can use its reaction to move up to half its movement speed and make a single weapon attack. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Rampage
entries: When you score a critical hit, or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with an attack roll on your turn, you can use your bonus action to move up to half your speed and make a single Bite attack.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Your character can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Aggrataurian grow to an impressive height, often reaching 8 feet by adulthood. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Adrenaline Burst
entries: On your turn, immediately after you hit a creature with a weapon attack roll, you can take one additional action. This action can only be used to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Hide}, or {@action Use an Object} action. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Determined
entries: When you roll a natural 1 on an attack roll against a hostile creature, you gain a point of inspiration.

entries.name: Eager Combatant
entries: You have {@bold advantage} on Initiative rolls.

entries.name: Fierce Peck
entries: Your beak is a fierce weapon that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage. Thanks to your long neck, your reach is increased by 5 feet when making unarmed strikes with your beak.

entries.name: Hardy Survivor
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Intimidation}, or {@skill Nature}.

entries.name: Heavy Feathers
entries: You resist cold damage.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Your character can speak, read, and write Auran, Common, and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for your character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Arcardae have a humanoid torso that sits atop a large, arachnid abdomen. Reaching up to 8 feet tall fully grown, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Many Limbs
entries: You have two humanoid arms and six insectoid legs. You can grapple up to six creatures at a time.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: You have the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

entries.name: Spider's Cunning
entries: Arcardae's arachnid physiology manifests in a variety of curious powers, which vary among individuals. Choose one of the following legacy options for your arcardae.

items.name: Spider Senses
entries: You are able to detect minute vibrations through the earth at your feet. You have {@sense tremorsense} out to 10 feet, and you have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill. While you are in contact with a web, your tremorsense extends across the entire area of that webbing.

items.name: Stinger
entries: You have a venomous stinger, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. If you roll a 6 or above on the damage roll for an attack made with your stinger, the target is also {@condition poisoned} until the end of your next turn.

items.name: Webweaver
entries: You have the ability to create webbing to ensnare and restrain enemies. You can cast the spell {@spell web} with this trait. You can cast a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest. You can also cast it with any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability when you cast {@spell web} with this trait (choose when you select this race).

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Terrifying Form
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Intimidation} skill.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Your character can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Gnomes are small, even relative to other species of short stature. Fully grown, they can reach up to 3 feet tall. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gnomes mature at the same rate humans do. They can live for up to five centuries.

entries.name: Gnomish Fortitude
entries: You have {@bold advantage} on all Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Your character can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for the character.

entries.name: Gnomish Lineage
entries: Choose one of the following gnomish lineages: {@race Gnome (Avestrosian; Frost)|DMSecretWeapon|Frost Gnome} or {@race Gnome (Avestrosian; Shadow)|DMSecretWeapon|Shadow Gnome}; whichever you choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Dryads vary greatly in size. Your size is Small or Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Dryads mature slower than humans, reaching adulthood at around 30 years of age. They can live for up to 300 years.

entries.name: Chlorophyll
entries: If you start your turn in direct sunlight, your base walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

entries.name: Nature's Magician
entries: You know one cantrip of your choice from the {@filter Druid spell list|spells|class=Druid}. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you select this species).

entries.name: Possess Plant
entries: As an action, you can possess a non-magical plant within 5 feet of you, meddling your body and gear into the body of the plant. While possessing it, you cannot move or talk, but you can hear and see as normal. You can't take actions, except to use a bonus action to leave the plant, at which time you appear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

While possessed, the plant gains the {@creature awakened shrub} stat block, except its size changes to match the size of the plant you possessed, and it shares your place in initiative and obeys your mental commands (no action required).
If the plant is reduced to 0 hit points, you are ejected from it, landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Your character can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for the character.

entries.name: Dryad Lineage
entries: There are many types of Dryad. Choose your lineage from one of the following lineages and gain its benefits: {@race Dryad (Woodland)|DMSecretWeapon|Woodland Dryad}, {@race Dryad (Desert)|DMSecretWeapon|Desert Dryad}, or {@race Dryad (Coastline)|DMSecretWeapon|Coastline Dryad}.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Tieflings are about the same size and build as humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Ancestral Flight
entries: Starting at 5th level, you can use a bonus action to call upon the magic of your ancestor. For the next minute, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Ancestral Gifts
entries: The values and character of your magical ancestor ripple across generations, granting you special power. You gain one boon from each table, depending on the alignment you decide from your ancestor. Some choices grant you the ability to cast a spell: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting modifier for these spells (choose when you select this species).

items.caption: Order Alignment
rows: Increase your Dexterity or Charisma score by 1.
Increase your Wisdom or Constitution score by 1.
Increase your Intelligence or Constitution score by 1.

items.caption: Moral Alignment
rows: Increase your Dexterity or Charisma score by 1.
Increase your Wisdom or Constitution score by 1.
Increase your Intelligence or Constitution score by 1.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Spellforged vary in size, but typically take a humanoid appearance, with two legs, two arms, and a head. Your size is Medium or Small.

entries.name: Into the Weave
entries: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport yourself or one willing creature within 5 ft. of you up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

entries.name: Magical Form
entries: As a being of energy, you have limited control over your form. You know the spell {@spell alter self} and can cast it without a spell slot. Once you cast it in this way, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Magical Resilience
entries: You are a being born from magic, which confers the following benefits:

items: You have proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} skill.
You are immune to disease and the {@condition poisoned} condition.
You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe.
You are immune to spells and effects that would dispel the magic that binds you together.

entries.name: Spellborne
entries: The magic that bound you together grants you access to elemental power. Choose one damage type from among acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder. You gain a resistance to the chosen damage type, and your unarmed strikes deal {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier of the chosen damage type.
You glow and pulse with magical energy that reflects your chosen elemental power. You might radiate heat as a fire spellforged, or crackle with a static energy as a lightning one.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read and write Common and Primordial.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Legionite are exactly 6ft tall. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Legionite are created fully sentient and able-bodied. They typically live about two centuries before the magic that binds them together breaks down and they die.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Legionite, by design, seek order. Although individuals may vary, the vast majority are of lawful alignment.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: Despite their earthen bodies, legionite possess souls and organic internal machinery. You are a Humanoid.

entries.name: Superior Design
entries: You gain one skill proficiency, one weapon proficiency and one tool proficiency of your choice. In addition, the amount of time you need to train to learn a new language or gain proficiency with a new tool is halved.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

entries.name: Legionite Class
entries: Choose one class of legionite from the following specialisations: {@race Legionite (Class S)|DMSecretWeapon|Class S}, {@race Legionite (Class D)|DMSecretWeapon|Class D}, {@race Legionite (Class C)|DMSecretWeapon|Class C}, {@race Legionite (Class I)|DMSecretWeapon|Class I}, {@race Legionite (Class W)|DMSecretWeapon|Class W}, or {@race Legionite (Class Z)|DMSecretWeapon|Class Z}. Each legionite class has its own unique aptitudes and abilities.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Spherian stand shoulder to shoulder with the tallest of humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Age
entries: Spherian mature slowly, reaching maturity after about a century, and go on to live to an incredible age. The oldest spherian can count their years to over 1,000 before passing away.

entries.name: Constellation Mark
entries: You carry a pattern of stars somewhere on your body, which carry magical significance. This power manifests when you reach 3rd level.

Choose one constellation from the options below and gain the traits associated with it. You can also invent your own constellation, and choose the trait of a given constellation mark that best fits your character.

items.name: Aquarius
entries: As a reaction when you roll for initiative, or as a bonus action on your turn, you can cast the spell {@spell bless} with this trait. Once you use this trait, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast the spell as normal using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

items.name: Cassiopeia
entries: As a reaction when you roll for initiative, or as a bonus action on your turn, you can summon icy, spectral chains that attempt to bind a creature you can see within 90 feet. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} cold damage and be {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn. The DC for this saving throw is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose when you select this species). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

items.name: Draco
entries: As a reaction when you roll for initiative, or as a bonus action on your turn, you can let loose a draconic roar that shimmers with magic in a 15-foot radius. Creatures of your choice within that area gain a point of Heroic Inspiration, and all other creatures in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of you until the end of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose when you select this species). Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

items.name: Gemini
entries: As a reaction when you roll for initiative, or as a bonus action on your turn, you can cast the spell {@spell mirror image} with this trait. Once you use this trait, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast the spell as normal using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

items.name: Orion
entries: As a reaction when you roll for initiative, or as a bonus action on your turn, you mark a creature you can see within 120 feet with a magical rune. You gain a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus on attack rolls against that creature for the next minute and cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls against it. Once you use this trait, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

items.name: Pegasus
entries: As a reaction when you roll for initiative, or as a bonus action on your turn, you can grant yourself the ability to magically fly. You gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed and can hover for the next 10 minutes. Once you use this trait, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Night Wanderer
entries: The nocturnal ways of the spherian make them potent nighttime hunters. You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} and {@skill Stealth} skills.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries: You don't need to eat or drink.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size
entries: Lumbrinth are long creatures, descended from colossal bestial worms, and reach almost 10 feet when stretched out. They carry themselves with the upper two-thirds of their body lifted over their tails, typically standing around 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

walk.condition: you can move at full speed while {@condition prone}

entries.name: Age
entries: Lumbrinth grow swiftly, and are considered adult at the age of 13. They can live for up to 60 years.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: Although lumbrinth can see perfectly well in light conditions, the gifts evolved by their blind ancestors remain. You have {@sense blindsight} out to 10 feet.

entries.name: Natural Armour
entries: Lumbrinth have a flexible, segmented carapace which offers natural defense from harm. While you aren't wearing armour, your base AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Tail Stinger
entries: The stinger at the base of each lumbrinth's tail is both a fierce natural weapon and a hive of bubbling chemical activity. You can use your tail to make unarmed strikes. When you do, it has a range of 10-feet and deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier piercing damage on a hit.

Additionally, once per turn when you hit a creature with your tail stinger, you can inject a potent poison into the target. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus), taking {@damage 2d8} poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. This damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 3d8}), 11th level ({@damage 4d8}), and 17th level ({@damage 5d8}). You can inject poison in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Worm Tactics
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth} and {@skill Survival} skills.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Neutral, Lawful

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: You have a thick, spiky hide. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 12 + your Constitution modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

entries.name: Wardens
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Nature} skill.

entries.name: Spiny Shell
entries: You may use your reaction to lean into your thick, spiny shell. Until the end of this turn, you gain advantage on Constitution saving throws. You may use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Greatberry
entries: You know the {@spell druidcraft} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you may also cast {@spell goodberry} once per long rest using this trait. Any {@spell goodberry} created using this trait is a Greatberry, and restores hit points equal to 1 + your proficiency modifier.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Lawful, Good

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: You have a thick, spiky hide. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 12 + your Constitution modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

entries.name: Survivalist
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Survival} skill.

entries.name: Spikey Shell
entries: When a creature within 5 ft. hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal piercing damage equal to your Constitution modifier to that creature. From level 6, the earthen power imbued in your shell has grown to the extent that this counts as magical damage for the purposes of overcoming resistances. From level 11, your skill at maximising your shell offensively allows you to add your proficiency modifier to any damage dealt with this trait.

entries.name: Tumbler
entries: You can use a reaction to halve any fall damage you would take. You may use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Chaotic, Good

entries.name: Rolliking Spirit
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance} skill.

entries.name: Vigorous Energy
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition stunned} or {@condition paralyzed}.

entries.name: Quick Footed
entries: Your base walking speed is 35 ft.

entries.name: Stop, Drop and Roll
entries: When you are dealt damage, you can use a reaction to fall {@condition prone} and move 35 ft. in any direction along the ground in a straight line. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or a long rest.

entries.name: Venom Blood
entries: You have resistance to poison damage and are immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition.

entries.name: Living Weapon
entries: As a bonus action, you can coat a single piercing or slashing melee weapon you are holding with your natural venom. Once applied, this venom remains potent for the next minute, or until the weapon hits another creature. A creature hit by this weapon must make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier) or take an additional {@damage 1d10} poison damage. This damage increases to {@damage 2d10} at level 5, {@damage 3d10} at level 11, and {@damage 4d10} at level 17. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier per long rest.

entries.name: Hard Earned Freedom
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

entries.name: Adaptive Carapice
entries: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to grant yourself resistance to that damage type for the next minute. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a short rest.

entries.name: Hasty Response
entries: You have advantage on initiative rolls.

entries.name: Strong of Heart
entries: You have advantage on Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Forest Dweller
entries: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice from among {@skill Nature}, {@skill Survival}, {@skill Perception} and {@skill Animal Handling}.

entries.name: Flaxfoot Magic
entries: You know the {@spell dancing lights} cantrip, and can choose to cast it without verbal or somatic components a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Lowstone Resistance
entries: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition poisoned} condition, and you resist poison damage.

entries.name: Strength of Mind
entries: You have advantage on Intelligence saving throws.

entries.name: Sturdy Wings
entries: You can fly while wearing medium armour.

entries.name: Mountain Dweller
entries: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice from among {@skill Nature}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Medicine} and {@skill Insight}.

entries.name: Lowstone Magic
entries: You know the {@spell mending} cantrip, and can choose to cast it with a casting time of one action, rather than one minute, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Fire-Belly
entries: When you take the attack action, you can use one of your attacks to belch a burning, green flame. All creatures in a 10-foot cone must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} fire damage. This damage increases to {@damage 2d6} at level 5, {@damage 3d6} at level 11, and {@damage 4d6} at level 17. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Galvanic
entries: You can use a bonus action to galvanize your body with a powerful, reactive, electric charge. Until the start of your next turn, any creature within 10 feet of you that hits you with a melee weapon attack immediately takes {@damage 1d10} lightning damage. This damage increases to {@damage 2d10} at level 5, {@damage 3d10} at level 11, and {@damage 4d10} at level 17. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

entries.name: Poison Dart
entries: When you take the attack action, you can use one of those attacks to spout a viscous, purple poison at a creature within 30 feet of you.
