spell.name: Dimensional Pocket Sand
entries: You reach into the void and pull forth a handful of glistening, sharp, white sand to blow into the eyes of a creature within 5 feet.
The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of its next turn.

spell.name: Superior True Strike
entries: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses.
The next time you make an attack against that creature, the attack hits. You do not make an attack roll, and this attack cannot crit.

spell.name: Superior Illusory Script
entries: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration. To you and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell, the writing appears normal, written in your hand, and conveys whatever meaning you intended when you wrote the text.
To all others, the writing appears as if it were a message that they would interpret in a manner that would encourage them to deliver the parchment to its intended recipient.

For example, a guard might read an illusory script with a message for an assassin reading "Your next target is the King", and see the message as: "Please deliver the following message to the intended recipient. They are to accompany a member of the Royal Guard to the Royal Court for urgent business". The illusion is incapable of replicating or forging sigils and other official means of authentication.

If a creature chooses to do so, they can attempt an Arcana check (DC 20) to identify if the parchment carries an illusion. On a success, they become aware that the parchment bears magic, but still cannot read the original message.
Should the spell be dispelled, the original script and the illusion both disappear. A creature with truesight can read the hidden message.

spell.name: Superior Grease

components.m: A bit of pork rind or butter

entries: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration.

When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

The grease is also an object that is highly flammable. If it is dealt fire damage, or a creature or object in its area is dealt fire damage, it ignites. All creatures and objects in the area of the grease take {@damage 2d8} fire damage, and the spell ends.

spell.name: Superior Arcane Sword

m.text: A miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp

entries: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration.

When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword, at advantage. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d10} force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack against the same target or a different one.

If the sword is within 5 feet of you, and another creature hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attempt to parry that blow with the sword. Add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

spell.name: Superior Weird
entries: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice becomes {@condition frightened} for the duration.

The illusion calls on the creature's deepest fears, manifesting its worst nightmares as an implacable threat. The danger appears to surround the creature, rendering it unable to move while {@condition frightened}.
At the end of each of the frightened creature's turns, it takes {@damage 4d10} psychic damage, and then can attempt a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.

spell.name: Serpent Appendage
entries: This spell transforms the arms or forelimbs of a creature you can see within range into hissing snakes under their control. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect.
The transformation lasts for the duration of the spell, or until the target falls to 0 hit points or dies.

With snake arms, the target drops anything it is holding. In addition, it can use its action to make two unarmed strikes with the snake arms. These attacks have a reach of 10 feet, use your spellcasting modifier to hit, and deal {@damage 2d6} + the target's Strength modifier piercing damage on a hit. These snake unarmed strikes have advantage on any attack rolls made against a {@condition poisoned} creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher, the number of attacks the target creature can make with the snake arms as an action increases by 1 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

spell.name: Shark Head
entries: This spell transforms the head of a humanoid you can see within range into that of a shark. The transformation does not alter the target's brain or mind, and they can still speak. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect.
The transformation lasts for the duration of the spell, or until the target falls to 0 hit points or dies.

With a shark head, the target can breathe underwater, gains a swim speed equal to its walking speed, and has disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks and advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks.

In addition, it can use its bonus action to make a bite attack against a creature within 5 feet. This attack uses your spellcasting modifier to hit, and deals {@damage 3d4} + your spellcasting modifier piercing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for every slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Spiked Carapace
entries: This spell transforms the body of a creature you can see within range, causing them to grow a hard, thick and spiky shell. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect.
The transformation lasts for the duration of the spell, or until the target falls to 0 hit points or dies.

The target gains a +3 bonus to their AC, and when they are hit by a melee weapon attack, they can use their reaction to take the blow on their spiked shell, dealing {@damage 1d8} piercing damage to the attacker.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for every slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Ghostrain
entries: You conjure a spectral torrent of foul, undead spirits, bursting from your outstretched hands and charging through enemies. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d6} necrotic damage and is {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 2d6} for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Eobard's Friendly Critters
entries: You conjure three small, spectral beasts in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. You can decide their appearance. They cannot attack, are immune to all damage and conditions, and are friendly to you and your allies.

They take their turn immediately after yours, and can use that turn to move up to 30 feet in any direction and take the {@action Help} action, assisting an ally. They cannot take actions other than the {@action Help} action.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you conjure one additional beast for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Leaden Weight
entries: You attempt to magically densify a creature within range. That creature must make a Constitution Saving Throw (they can choose to fail).

On a failed save, that creature's weight is doubled, it has advantage on {@skill Athletics} checks and on saving throws to resist being forcibly moved or knocked {@condition prone}, and its Strength-based damage rolls deal an additional {@damage 1d8} damage.

In addition, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, its movement speed is reduced by 10 feet, and its Dexterity-based melee weapon attack rolls deal {@dice 1d8} less damage (but no less than 1).

spell.name: Gaze of the Demon Prince
entries: You invoke the abyssal fury of a dominating, demonic entity. When you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on each of your turns, you can focus your gaze on one creature you can see within 120 feet. That creature must make a Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw (your choice). On a failed save, it suffers one of the following effects, based on the saving throw you chose.

entries.name: Constitution
entries: The target is {@condition stunned} until the start of your next turn or until they are no longer within your line of sight.

entries.name: Wisdom
entries: The target suffers the effects of the {@spell Confusion} spell until the end of their next turn or until they are no longer within your line of sight.

entries.name: Charisma
entries: The target is {@condition charmed} by you until the end of your next turn or until they are no longer within your line of sight. This effect ends early if you deal damage to that creature.

If you drop {@status concentration} on this spell as a result of taking damage, roll a d20. On a 13 or lower, you take {@damage 6d6} psychic damage and are corrupted by darkness for the next minute. While corrupted, you can't differentiate friend from foe, can't understand what other creatures say, can't read, can't cast spells, and speak only gibberish.

A creature can use its action to attempt to help you regain yourself. If they do, roll a d20. On a 13 or higher, you return to your senses. A {@spell Greater Restoration} spell cast on you also ends the corruption effect.

spell.name: Curse of Orcus
entries: You attempt to curse a creature within range with unlife. That creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (they can choose to fail), or become an undead, in addition to its current creature type.
While undead, it resists cold damage, necrotic damage, and bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage from nonmagical weapons.
In addition, it cannot regain hit points, and it can be targeted by spells and other effects that exclusively target undead creatures.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the spell lasts for the duration, without requiring {@status concentration}.

spell.name: Orcus' Dread Command
entries: You brutally seize control of an undead that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you for the duration. If you or the creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

While the target is {@condition charmed}, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general couse of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive any further direction from you, it takes no actions and does not move until it receives a new order or this spell ends.

You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well.
Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or above, you can target one additional undead for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Telekinetic Push
entries: You attempt to telekinetically hurl a Large or smaller creature you can see within range through the air. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be pushed 30 feet away from you in a straight line, stopping early if it impacts against a solid surface. If it moves into the space of another creature, that creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid it. On a failed save, the target of this spell impacts that creature and stops moving, and both creatures fall {@condition prone}. When the creature you pushed strikes something, both the creature and what it strikes each take {@damage 1d10} bludgeoning damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the spell can target creatures that are Huge or smaller. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, it can target any creature, regardless of size.

spell.name: Explosive Ultimatum

m.text: a ruby worth at least 200 gold pieces

entries: In addition to the spell slot you use to cast this spell, you can expend two additional spell slots of any level.

You detonate an explosive burst of force around a creature you can see within range. That creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage #$prompt_number:min=1,title=Enter a Number!,default=123$#d12|Xd12} force damage, where X is the total number of slot levels you expended to cast this spell, on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. For example, if you expend one 5th level spell slot and two 3rd level spell slots, this spell would deal {@damage 11d12} force damage.

spell.name: Shadow Fortification
entries: You wreath yourself in a regenerating armour of shadows. You gain 5 temporary hit points, your AC increases by 2, and you gain 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you gain an additional 5 temporary hit points at the start of each turn for every second spell level you cast it at above 2nd.

spell.name: Dutch Courage
entries: This spell temporarily intoxicates a creature you can see within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw to resist the effect. The target becomes {@condition inebriated|DMSecretWeapon} for the next 10 minutes.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Heroes' Banquet
entries: You magically conjure a spectacular banquet of alcoholic drinks. The banquet takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don't set in until this hour is over. Up to six other creatures can partake of the banquet.

A creature that partakes of the banquet becomes {@condition inebriated|DMSecretWeapon} for the next {@dice 1d4} hours, and gains proficiency on Constitution saving throws and resists bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage while it is {@condition inebriated|DMSecretWeapon} in this way. When the inebriation condition ends for a creature who partakes in this banquet, they gain one point of {@condition exhaustion}.

spell.name: Frigid Gust
entries: An icy gust of blistering wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 4d8} cold damage and becoming {@condition freezing|DMSecretWeapon} on a failed save, or taking half as much damage and not becoming {@condition freezing|DMSecretWeapon} on a success. A creature can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition freezing|DMSecretWeapon} effect on a success.

The icy gust also disperses gas and vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a 50 percent chance to extinguish them.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the spell can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Vicious Calling
entries: Through a vicious calling of necromantic magic, you weave a curse that spirals through the air and tears into the soul of a victim. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose must succeed on a Charisma saving throw, or become cursed for the next minute.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet for each slot above 4th.

spell.name: Evocation Roulette
entries: Choose up to three creatures within range, one of which must be you. Each creature makes an {@skill Arcana} check. The creature with the lowest result takes {@damage 12d6} force damage. If the caster takes the damage from this effect, it ignores any resistance or immunity, and cannot be prevented or redirected in any way.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell with a spell slot of 5th level or above, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Double or Nothing

time.condition: which you take when you miss with an attack roll

entries: When you miss with an attack roll, you can call upon a surge of magic to improve your odds. Roll the attack again. On a hit, the attack deals an additional {@damage 2d8} force damage. On a miss, you take {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage, and your maximum hit point total is reduced by the same amount until you finish a long rest. This necrotic damage ignores resistances and immunities, and can't be prevented or redirected in any way.

spell.name: Chaos Roller
entries: When you cast this spell and at the start of your turn, roll {@dice 1d8}. The result on the die determines the effect that takes place.

entries.caption: Chaos Roller
rows: Your AC is reduced by 2 until the start of your next turn.
Your AC increases by 2 and your walking speed increases by 20 feet until the start of your next turn.
Up to one creature of your choice within 60 feet of you must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage.
Up to one creature of your choice within 60 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d8} lightning damage.
You can add {@dice 1d6} to the next ability check, or saving throw you make before the start of your next turn.
You gain one point of {@condition exhaustion}, you take {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage, and you can take one additional action this turn. This spell ends.

spell.name: Echidna Armour
entries: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin bristles with pointed, rough quills, and the target's AC can't be less than 19, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing. In addition, a creature grappling the target takes {@damage 1d12} piercing damage at the start of its turn, and a creature that hits the target with a melee attack takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage.

spell.name: Punch Out
entries: You imbue your body with frenetic energy and make an unarmed strike against one creature within your reach. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects and then takes {@damage 1d10} force damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: At 5th level, the unarmed strike deals an extra {@dice 1d10} force damage to the target on a hit ({@damage 2d10}), and the distance the target is pushed back increases by 5 feet (15 feet). The damage and distance pushed increases by 1d10 and 5 feet at 11th level ({@damage 3d8} and 20 feet), and again at 17th level ({@damage 4d10} and 25 feet).

spell.name: Prophecy

m.text: a glass orb or mirror worth 1,000 gp

entries: You wield divination magic to catch a glimpse of the future. Roll one {@dice d20} and record the number rolled. You can replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check made by you or a creature that you can see with that prophesied roll. You must choose to do so before the roll, and you can only have one prophesied roll at a time.
Casting this spell again causes the previous prophesied roll to be rewritten.
When you finish a long rest, you lose your unused prophesied roll, as your glimpse of the future fades from memory.

spell.name: Icicle Lancer
entries: Roll {@dice 1d4}. You conjure a number of icicles equal to the result on the die, which you can hurl at targets you can see within 30 feet. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack roll for each icicle. On a hit, the icicle deals {@damage 2d4} cold damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a spell slot of 3rd-or-4th level, the size of the die you roll to determine how many icicles you conjure and the damage dice of each icicle increase to a d6. These dice increase to a d8 if you cast it with a 5th-or-6th level spell slot, a d10 if you cast it with a 7th-8th level spell slot, and a d12 if you cast it with a 9th level spell slot.

spell.name: Charge
entries: You fortify yourself with magic, building power in preparation for an explosive burst. When you cast this spell, and at the start of each of your turns, you gain {@dice 1d4} Temporary Hit Points.

When you cast a levelled spell using an action, you can choose to stop concentrating on this spell. If you do, treat that spell as if it were cast at one level higher than the level of the spell slot you expended to cast it.

spell.name: Trace

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet casts a spell

entries: You attempt to trace the somatic and verbal components of a spell you can see being cast. If that spell is of a level lower than the slot level you used to cast this spell, and does not require Material components with a monetary value (e.g. a gem worth at least 50 gp), you successfully trace it, and you can cast that spell using this reaction without expending a further spell slot or requiring material components. Your casting of the spell happens immediately after the initial spellcaster casts it. If the spellcaster is casting a spell level equal to or higher than the slot level you used to cast this spell, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, you successfully trace the spell.

spell.name: Life Resurgence
entries: With a burst of radiant power, you revitalise creatures on the brink of death. Choose up to two creatures within 30 feet of yourself with 0 hit points. Those creatures gain hit points equal to your level, and can immediately use a reaction to stand up from {@condition prone} and make a single weapon attack, or stand up from {@condition prone} and move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a spell slot of 5th or 6th level, the maximum number of creatures you can target increases to three. It increases to four when you use a spell slot of 7th or 8th level, and to five when you use a spell slot of 9th level.

spell.name: Collective Power
entries: Your spirit swells with power and unity, forming a potent magical connection with up to two willing creatures within 30 feet of you that you can see (minimum 1). You and the creatures you choose gain temporary hit points equal to twice your spellcasting modifier.

In addition, creatures with temporary hit points granted by this spell have advantage on their first attack roll each turn, and on saving throws to resist or end the {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} condition for the duration. This advantage on attack rolls and saving throws ends early if any creature granted temporary hit points by this spell loses those temporary hit points or falls {@condition unconscious}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a spell slot of 3rd level or above, the maximum number of creatures you can target increases by two for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Shared Fate
entries: You tether your life-force to that of a willing creature you touch. The target gains +2 AC and has advantage on saving throws. In addition, while you are conscious, any damage the target takes that would reduce it to 0 hit points reduces it to 1 hit point instead, and any excess damage is dealt to you in its place.

The spell ends early if you fall to 0 hit points, or if you and the target are no longer on the same plane of existence. It also ends if the spell is cast again on either of the connected creatures, or if either of the connected creatures dismiss the connection as a bonus action.

spell.name: Petrificus
entries: A beam of orange light shines from you onto a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or it takes {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage and its speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d10} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d10}), 11th level ({@damage 3d10}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d10}).

spell.name: Karmic Pendulum
entries: You magically borrow a brush of luck from your future to aid you in the present. Roll {@dice 1d6} and record the result. You receive a blessing of fortune in the form of a bonus to the next attack roll you make this turn equal to the result. In addition, you have a penalty to the next attack roll or ability check you make after making that blessed attack roll equal to the result. Once you cast this spell, you can't cast it again until you have made a penalised attack roll or ability check from the previous casting of it.

spell.name: Gumdak's Arcane Foot
entries: You create a Large, crystalline foot of translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The foot lasts for the duration, and it moves at your command.
The foot is an object that has AC 18 and Hit Points equal to your Hit Point maximum. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends. The foot doesn't fill its space.
When you cast the spell and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can move the foot up to 60 feet and cause one of the following effects with it.

entries.name: Stomp
entries: The foot stomps down on a creature or object within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack for the foot using your game statistics. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage, and if it is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

entries.name: Boot
entries: The foot attempts to kick a creature or object within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack for the foot using your game statistics. On a hit, a Huge or smaller target is moved up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice. If the target is Tiny, the distance you can move it is doubled.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage from the Stomp increases by {@dice 1d6} and the distance a creature can be moved by the Boot increases by 5 feet for every level above 3rd.

spell.name: Osmose
entries: You weave a sapping tendril of magic around a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or take {@damage 3d10} necrotic damage. In addition, if the target fails the saving throw and can cast spells, or has the innate ability to produce a magical effect (such as a chain devil's Animate Chains action), you regain one expended spell slot of a level equal to half the slot level you used to cast this spell (rounded down).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or above, it deals an additional {@dice 1d10} damage for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Power Word Terror
entries: You utter a word of power that instills dreadful terror in the mind of a creature you can see within range. If the creature has 100 hit points or fewer, it drops whatever it is holding and is {@condition frightened} of you for the next minute. Otherwise, the spell fails. At the end of each of its turns, a creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

spell.name: Power Word: Hope
entries: You utter a word of power that nurtures hope in one creature you can see within range those who hear it. That creature gains {@dice 5d10} temporary hit points, if it is {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, the condition ends, and it is immune to the {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} conditions for the next minute.

spell.name: Power Word Pacifism
entries: You utter a word of power that compels a creature you can see within range not to harm others. If the creature has 150 hit points or fewer, it cannot take any action that deals damage to another creature. Otherwise, the spell fails. At the end of each of its turns, a creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on a success.

spell.name: Deanimate
entries: You attempt to steal the vitality of a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or its speed falls to 0 until the end of its next turn. If it fails this save by 5 or more, it is also {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or above, you can target one additional creature for each slot level you cast it at above 2nd.

spell.name: Disapparate
entries: You attempt to magically hurl a creature through space. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 90 feet of you that is on the ground or a surface that can support them. If it fails this save by 5 or more, the chosen space can be any unoccupied space you can see, instead.

spell.name: Discombobulate
entries: A blast of concussive force bursts from your body, barreling into a creature you touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} bludgeoning damage. If you beat the target's AC by 5 or more, or you score a critical hit, the target is also discombobulated until the end of its next turn. While discombobulated, a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and it falls {@condition prone} if it misses an attack roll or fails an ability check.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or above, this spell deals an additional {@dice 1d8} bludgeoning damage for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Regular Missile
entries: You conjure an ordinary, non-magical, theater ballistic missile. If you conjure it on the ground, it detonates immediately. If you conjure it in the air, it emits a piercing whistle and falls at a rate of 500 feet per round, detonating upon contact with the ground or another surface.

When the missile detonates, each creature and object in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on the point of detonation takes {@damage 20d12} bludgeoning damage. Creatures within 250 feet of the detonation that can see it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} until the end of their next turn.

spell.name: Mental Mathematics
entries: You babble a string of numbers at a creature within 30 feet of you that can hear you.
Start a 30 second timer.

Roll {@dice 1d4} and record the result. Roll a number of d4s equal to that result. Add those d4s together, and multiply that result by your Intelligence modifier. Then subtract from this total the number you initially rolled on the d4, plus a number equal to the number of feet the target is away from you divided by 5. The target takes psychic damage equal to the final result.

If the timer runs out before you complete the calculations for this spell, or you perform the calculations with the aid of another person or digital tool, you take {@damage 1d6} psychic damage, the spell fails, and you do not expend the spell slot used to attempt its casting.

spell.name: Countercounterspell

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting counterspell

entries: You interrupt a creature in the process of casting {@spell counterspell}. This spell cannot be countered by {@spell counterspell}.

spell.name: Dice Tower
entries: Start a 30 second timer.
You have until the timer runs out to stack a d4, a d6, a d8, a d10, a d12, and a d20 on top of each other, in any order. The dice must start unstacked.

If the timer goes off with every dice stacked, unsupported by anything other than each other and the surface they are stacked on, you regain all your hit points. If you are {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}, the condition ends. If you are {@condition prone}, you can use your reaction to stand up.

spell.name: Anti-Shield

time.condition: which you take when you miss a creature with a melee weapon attack roll

entries: When you make a melee weapon attack roll and miss, you can use a reaction to give yourself +5 to all melee weapon attack rolls you make against the target of that attack until the start of your next turn. This bonus applies to the triggering attack, potentially turning a miss into a hit.

spell.name: Silvery Flowers

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself fails on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw

entries: You magically encourage the triggering creature and turn its momentary support into a distraction for another creature. The triggering creature can reroll the d20 and use the higher roll.

You can then choose a different creature you can see within range (you can choose yourself). The chosen creature has disadvantage on the next attack roll or ability check it makes within 1 minute. A creature can be disempowered by only one use of this spell at a time.

spell.name: Mr. Stark, I Don't Feel So Goodberry
entries: One berry appears in your hand, infused with deadly magic. It appears identical to an ordinary {@spell goodberry}. A creature can use its action to eat the berry. Alternatively, you can attempt a melee attack roll using the berry (with which you are proficient) against an unwilling creature no more than one size larger than you to force the berry into its mouth, causing it to swallow it (this attack deals no damage). A creature that swallows the berry takes {@damage 10d6+40} force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated.

spell.name: Unhealing Word
entries: Start a 1 hour timer.

Name a word. For the duration of this spell, anytime a player says that word, they lose one hit point. If the GM says the word, one creature currently under their control loses one hit point (if possible).

spell.name: Fly (Not that Fly)
entries: Conjure one ordinary fly in a space you can see within range. It does not obey your commands.

spell.name: Fold Person
entries: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. For the duration of the spell, the target cannot stand up. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Strength saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target. When the spell ends on a target, it can use its reaction to stand up.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 1st. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

spell.name: Power Swap
entries: Magic surges through your body, radically bolstering your strength. You gain proficiency with martial weapons and your Strength modifier becomes equal to your spellcasting modifier.
In addition, if you hit a creature with a weapon attack, roll {@dice 2d8}. The creature takes additional force damage equal to the result, and you gain temporary hit points equal to the result.
When this spell ends, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 9 or less, you gain 1 point of {@condition exhaustion}.

spell.name: Gooify
entries: You attempt to reduce a creature you can see within range into goo. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 10d12} acid damage on a failed save. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it dies, and its corpse is transformed into an {@creature ochre jelly}. The ochre jelly takes its turn immediately after yours and obeys your commands (no action required). If you do not issue a command, the ochre jelly does nothing. The ochre jelly remains for the next 8 hours, after which it fully dissolves into nothingness and vanishes.
A {@spell greater restoration} spell cast on an ochre jelly created by this effect within 8 hours restores the creature to its original form.

spell.name: Sputter of Hope

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range falls to 0 hit points

entries: As a reaction, you can snatch a creature from the brink of death and fuel them with your own vitality. You take {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage, and the target gains hit points equal to the damage you took. If {@condition prone}, the target can immediately use its reaction to stand up.

spell.name: Giant Weapon
entries: One weapon you are touching grows larger for the duration, doubling in size and weight. Only creatures with a Strength score of 17 or above can wield it, otherwise the weapon falls from their grasp.
The reach of the weapon increases by 5 feet, and it deals an additional {@damage 2d6} damage on a hit.

spell.name: Chaos Light
entries: You conjure a chaotic helix of light that spirals towards a creature within range. That creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of your next turn.
The colour of the light is random, and also impacts the spell. Roll on the Chaos Light table to determine the colour of the light and its bonus effect:

entries.caption: Chaos Light
rows: You turn {@condition invisible} until the start of your next turn.
The target takes {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage on a failed Constitution save, or half as much on a success.
You can use your bonus action this turn to cast a cantrip with a casting time of 1 action.
Both you and the target take {@damage 2d6} fire damage.
Both you and the target regain {@dice 2d10} hit points.
You can choose to take {@damage 1d12} necrotic damage, which cannot be reduced or prevented in any way. If you do, you regain the spell slot used to cast this spell.

spell.name: Vicious Strike
entries: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d12} necrotic damage and is wounded as foul magic courses through its body. The wounded condition ends early if this spell ends.

spell.name: Squish
entries: You attempt to crush a creature you can see within range with overwhelming gravitational force. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@damage 10d6} force damage and have their size category reduced by 1 for the next minute (from Medium to Small, for example).
Multiple castings of this spell can reduce a creature's size multiple times. A creature that would have its size category reduced below Tiny by the effect of this spell instead falls to 0 hit points.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Fury Surge
entries: Your body becomes inflamed with furious magical energy, which tears into the body of any creatures you are grappling. Creatures you are grappling or grappled by must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 4d10} force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, it deals an additional {@dice 1d10} force damage for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Prepwork

m.text: 1gp of paper and fine ink, which the spell consumes

entries: You carefully inscribe a glyph into a scroll, sealing the magic of one of your prepared spells within. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action, and you expend a spell slot of that spell's level when you seal it in this way. The scroll disintegrates harmlessly after 8 hours.

While holding the scroll, a creature can cast the spell stored within it as a bonus action. Once it does, the scroll disintegrates immediately. The spell uses your slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability, but is otherwise treated as if the creature that activated the scroll cast the spell.

spell.name: Weave Discord
entries: You place an enchantment of discord on a creature you can see within 60 feet. The target becomes {@condition Goaded|DMSecretWeapon} for the next minute.

When you cast this spell, you can also choose one other creature both you and the target can see within range of the spell, and force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target believes the other creature to be the one goading it, rather than you. Creatures immune to the {@condition charmed} condition automatically succeed on this saving throw. When the spell ends, the target becomes aware you were the one goading it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature to goad with this spell for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Heartening Word
entries: You call out a few heartening words to a creature that can see and hear you, imbuing it with courage and support. Until the end of your next turn, the creature is {@condition bolstered|DMSecretWeapon}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Terrorize
entries: In a befuddling haze of fey magic, you take on a terrifying, phantasmal form in the mind of an enemy within 30 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or be {@condition frightened} of you for the duration, and take an additional {@damage 1d8} psychic damage whenever you hit it with an attack roll. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Stolen Glory

time.condition: which you take when both you and another creature simultaneously roll a d20

entries: As a reaction, when you and another creature you can see within 60 feet of you simultaneously roll a {@dice d20} (such as when you both roll for initiative, or you each roll a d20 as part of a contested {@skill Athletics} check, or roll against the same saving throw), you can swap your results on the d20.
The target receives your result, and you receive theirs, before adding any ability score modifiers.
You can cast this spell after seeing the results on the dice, but before success or failure is declared.

spell.name: Homing Teleportation
entries: Name up to ten creatures within 1,000 feet of you. If a named creature is willing and within range, it is teleported to the nearest unoccupied space within 30 feet of you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th-or-7th level, you can assemble creatures from up to 10 miles away. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th-or-9th level, you can assemble creatures from anywhere on the same plane of existence.

spell.name: Razor Leaf
entries: You create a stream of vicious, spinning leaves that fly from your outstretched palm and barrel into a creature within 60 feet. Make a ranged attack roll against the target. This attack scores a critical hit on a d20 roll of 18, 19, or 20. If the attack hits, the creature takes {@damage 3d10} slashing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, it deals an additional {@dice 1d10} damage for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Rock Smash
entries: Your body ignites with frenetic energy, which you channel into a magically charged, shattering strike. Make an unarmed strike or melee weapon attack against one creature or object within your reach. If the target is an object or a Construct, you have advantage on the attack roll. On a hit, the target suffers the strike's normal effects, and its AC is reduced by 1 until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: At 5th level, the strike imposes an additional penalty of -1 to the target's AC (-2 AC). The same applies at 11th level (-3 AC) and 17th level (-4 AC).

spell.name: Hyper Beam
entries: A devastating beam of pure energy bursts from your body in a direction you choose, forming a line 90 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 15d10} force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. After you cast this spell, a wave of lethargy sweeps through you, and you can't take actions until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, and you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with the beam, you can take actions as normal on your next turn.

spell.name: Rock Slide
entries: Heavy rocks fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 10-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the area of the spell must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes {@damage 7d6} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is also {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the radius of the cylinder increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Magnitude

components.m: a pinch of dirt, a piece of rock, and a lump of clay

entries: You create a chaotic, seismic tremor that ripples through the earth from a point on the ground that you can see within range. The area of ground within a 30-foot-radius circle centered on that point becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in contact with the ground or up to 30 feet below within that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. Creatures below ground make this save at disadvantage.

Roll {@dice 2d4} to determine the strength of the tremor you create. On a failed save, creatures take Xd8 bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}, where X is the result on the 2d4. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone.

spell.name: Ancient Power
entries: You conjure an ancient, illusory, primal force that barrels into a creature you can see within range. You decide the illusory form that this force takes, such as falling meteors, crushing water, or leaping flames. Make a spell attack roll against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 10d8} force damage. If you score a critical hit, you gain a +3 to all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws for the next minute, as the primal force engulfs and enhances your body and spirit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level, the threshold required to score a critical hit on the attack roll is reduced by 1, letting you score a critical hit on a d20 roll of 19 or 20. The same is true for 8th level (scoring a critical hit on a 18, 19, or 20) and 9th level (scoring a critical hit on a 17, 18, 19, or 20).

spell.name: Trineedle
entries: You conjure three poisoned tipped barbs that spiral into a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, they take {@damage 3d6} poison damage. If the result on any of the d6s is a 1, the creature is also {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A creature can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition poisoned} condition on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Flash Counter

time.condition: when you take bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage from an attack

entries: When you take bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage from an attack, you can conjure a brilliant flash of radiant light, which captures some of the force and sends it barreling back towards the attacker. You have resistance to the triggering damage type until the end of this turn, and the attacker must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take force damage equal to twice the amount you took from the triggering attack.

spell.name: Leeching Sap
entries: An undulating helix of green and white light lurches towards a creature you can see within range, forming a sustained link between you and the target. Make a ranged spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d12} necrotic damage, and you regain Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.
At the start of each of your subsequent turns, the target takes {@damage 1d12} necrotic damage, and you regain Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.
The spell ends if the target is ever outside the spell's range or if it has total cover from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the initial damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Slime Puddle
entries: You conjure a pool of writhing slime on ground you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the puddle covers the ground in a 5-foot square.

Any creature in the puddle's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} acid damage and fall {@condition prone}. A creature must also make the saving throw when it enters the puddle's space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d4}), 11th level ({@damage 3d4}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d4}).

spell.name: Torrent of Slime
entries: Until the spell ends, a deluge of bubbling slime falls in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. The area is heavily obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused.

The ground in the area is covered with slime, making it difficult terrain. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 6d4} acid damage and becomes coated in slime for 1 minute, or until it or another creature uses an action to shake off the coating. A creature coated in slime's speed is halved and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or above, the acid damage increases by {@dice 2d4} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Summon Ooze
entries: You conjure forth an oozing spirit of slime, which manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This creature uses the Ooze Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose Fungal or Caustic. Your choice determines the creature's traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge} action and uses its move to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, use the higher level whenever the spell's level appears in the stat block.

spell.name: Ghostify
entries: This spell transforms a creature you can see within range into a spectral, ghostly form. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw to resist the effect.

The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the creature drops to 0 hit points or dies. While transformed, the creature, along with everything it is wearing, turns {@condition invisible}. It cannot physically interact with other creatures (though it can still speak), its attacks deal no damage, it cannot cast spells, and it is immune to all damage. It gains a 10 foot fly speed and can hover, and it can move through objects and creatures, but cannot end its turn inside them. If it would do so, it is instead pushed to the nearest unoccupied space at the end of its turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Pledge of True Fellowship
entries: You forge an incredible bond of power, fortified by fellowship, between two willing creatures. For the duration, as long as the targets are within 10 feet of each other and are both conscious, if either would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, they fall to 1 hit point instead. When this effect takes place, a string of golden light flashes between the two bonded creatures.

spell.name: Animate Weapon
entries: With a burst of silver and crimson sparks, you throw a melee weapon you are holding into the air, where it hovers beside you for the duration. While the weapon hovers, you can use a bonus action to telepathically command it to fly up to 30 feet and attack one creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. The weapon uses your attack roll and ability score modifier to damage rolls, and deals magical damage. If the weapon is within 30 feet of you, you can recall it to your open hand and make a single attack with it as a bonus action, after which the spell ends.
You can also cast this spell targeting a shield. If you do, the shield hovers in place by your side for the duration, conferring its benefit while leaving your hands free.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the weapon you animate can make two attacks as a bonus action, rather than just one, and the shield confers an additional +1 bonus to your AC.

spell.name: Summon Object

m.text: a sphere of silver worth 100 gold pieces

entries: By weaving together wisps of conjuration magic, you conjure a Large or smaller wondrous item or weapon of Common rarity in an unoccupied space within range. The conjured object lasts for the duration before vanishing into mist, or until you lose concentration. If the item or weapon requires attunement, it attunes a willing creature you designate within range.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the object conjured can be of Uncommon rarity or below. When you cast it using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, it can be of Rare rarity or below. When you cast it using a spell slot of 9th level, it can be of Very Rare rarity or below.

spell.name: Primal Might
entries: The ancient strength of a slumbering monstrosity ripples through your body, magnifying your strength and heightening your senses. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your Strength score becomes 23 if it is lower.
You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.
Once per turn, on your turn, you can expend 10 feet of movement to leap up to 30 feet.
Your Unarmed Strikes can deal bludgeoning damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your Strength modifier on a hit.
You can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn. You ignore this benefit if you already have a feature, like Extra Attack, that gives you extra attacks.

spell.name: Draconic Soul
entries: You invoke the power of dragons, becoming wreathed in elemental energy. Choose one damage type from among acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. You are immune to that damage type for the duration. In addition, until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed, and you can hover.
If you are not wearing heavy armour, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier (shields' benefits apply as normal).

When you take the {@action Attack} action, you can replace one attack with an exhalation of draconic energy in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in that area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d10} damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. The damage type you deal is the same as the type you choose when you cast this spell.
You have blindsight out to 10 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage dealt by your draconic exhalation increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Spell Taxation

components.m: a scroll of indecipherable, magical legalese

entries: You weave a spell of magical taxation over a creature you can see within 90 feet. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw, taking {@damage 3d10} psychic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. A creature who fails the save is also cursed for the duration of this spell. While cursed, any time it casts a spell using a spell slot while you are within 90 feet of it, it takes a further {@damage 1d10} psychic damage, and you regain one spent spell slot of your choice of a level up to half of the level of the spell slot they expended (rounded down).

spell.name: Creeping Exhaustion
entries: Undulating tendrils of smoke spiral from your outstretched palm towards a creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be wracked with a curse of lethargy. For the duration, a cursed creature must choose whether it moves, takes an action, or takes a bonus action on each of its turns; it can only perform one of the three without penalty. If the creature performs more than one of the three on a single turn, it takes a point of {@condition exhaustion} for each one beyond the first. When this spell ends, any levels of {@condition exhaustion} it caused go away as the curse lifts.

spell.name: Time Inversion

m.text: a pocket watch worth at least 100 gp

entries: You attempt to subtly subvert the flow of time in your immediate area. At the end of initiative count 0 of this round, if you are concentrating on this spell, the spell ends and initiative order is reversed (creatures with lower initiative act before those with higher). This new initiative order continues for the rest of the encounter.

spell.name: Pillar of Salt
entries: When you cast this spell, you target a creature within 60 feet and magically forbid an Action or behaviour. For example, you might forbid the {@action Attack} action, {@action Dodge} action, the Magic action, or a behaviour such as telling a lie or donning a shield. The creature magically understands the forbidden Action or behaviour, even if it does not speak your language.

For the duration of the spell, if the target willingly performs the forbidden Action or behaviour under their own power, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, they take {@damage 20d12} force damage. On a failed save, they are turned into a pillar of salt, dying instantly. A creature killed in this way can only be resurrected by the {@spell Wish} spell.

The creature is exempt from punishment if the declared behaviour is necessary to prevent it from immediate harm. For example, a creature ordered not to move can move without penalty to avoid being crushed.

spell.name: Focused Resilience
entries: You place two fingers to the temple of a willing creature that is concentrating on a spell and fortify its mind with magical resilience. For the next minute, that creature has advantage on concentration checks made to maintain concentration on that spell. This spell ends early if that creature loses concentration.

spell.name: Sure Strike
entries: A weapon or piece of ammunition you touch becomes blessed with dancing enchantment magic, infusing it with golden light and aiding it striking true. The next attack roll made with that weapon or piece of ammunition deals an additional {@damage 3d8} force damage on a hit, and scores a critical hit on a 19 or 20. After it has been used to make an attack, the weapon or ammunition returns to normal and this spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the force damage increases by {@dice 2d8} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Wall of Necrosis
entries: You create a wall of shadow and corrosive necrotic energy on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a circle up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall is pitch black, opaque, and lasts for the duration.
Creatures and objects can move through the wall; it is composed entirely of magical energy. Creatures are {@condition blinded} while within the wall.

Each creature within the wall when it appears, or who enters the wall for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d12} necrotic damage and its speed falls to 0 until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its speed isn't reduced.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Lil Lightnin' Bolt
entries: A flash of blue light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d6} thunder damage. and the creature is deafened until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

feat.name: Dagger Master
entries: Your mastery of the dagger grants you certain benefits.

items: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, if you make a melee attack with a dagger, you can make one additional melee or ranged attack with a dagger as a part of that action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) per long rest.
When you make an off-hand attack with a dagger as your bonus action, you can add your proficiency bonus to any damage rolled.
If you score a critical hit with a dagger, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage.

feat.name: Whip Master
entries: You have trained many hours with the {@item whip|PHB}, granting you the following benefits:

items: When you make a melee attack with a {@item whip|PHB}, the range of that attack increases to 15ft.
Your damage die for {@item whip|PHB} attacks increases to a d6.

Once per turn, when you hit a large or smaller enemy with a {@item whip|PHB}, you can attempt to pull them off their feet. The target must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) or fall {@condition prone}.

feat.name: Elemental Armourist
entries: When you take this feat select two of the following damage types: Acid, lightning, fire, cold, poison, thunder

Damage you take of the chosen types is reduced by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, you make that saving throw with advantage if the damage type of that effect is one of the types chosen with this feat.
You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Shield Fighting
entries: You have focused your training around the mastery of the {@item shield|PHB}, granting the following benefits:

items: You can benefit from wielding two shields simultaneously (one in each hand) to further increase your AC.
You can use your {@item shield|PHB} as a weapon. It has a range of 5ft and deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.
You can don or doff a {@item shield|PHB} as a bonus action.

feat.name: Superior Shield Fighting
entries: You have invested great effort and training into the mastery of the {@item shield|PHB}, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain an additional +1 to your Armor Class, and your Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saving throws while wielding a {@item shield|PHB} in each hand.
Your melee attacks that use a {@item shield|PHB} now deal {@damage 1d8} + your Strength modifier.

When you score a critical hit when making an attack with a {@item shield|PHB}, your target makes a Constitution saving throw equal to 10 + your Strength modifier. On a failed save, they are {@condition stunned} until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: Cantrip King
entries: You learn an additional three cantrips of your choice from your class's spell list.

items: When you score a critical hit when making an attack roll with a cantrip, add an additional damage die when calculating damage.
At the end of a short rest, you can substitute one cantrip you know with another from your class's spell list.

feat.name: Storm's Wrath
entries: Once per turn, when you make an attack roll, you can switch the damage type of that attack to lightning damage.

Once per turn, when you score a critical hit with an attack that deals lightning damage to a creature, that creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: After Image
entries: When you take the {@action Dash} action, an illusory duplicate of you appears in your space. It lasts for one minute or until destroyed. The duplicate moves with you and mimics your actions, shifting position and making it impossible to tell which one is real. Your duplicate has an AC equal to 10 + your Dexterity modifier.

Each time a creature targets you for an attack, roll a {@dice d20} to see if it hits you or your duplicate. With a roll of 11 or above, the attack targets your After Image. Your duplicate is destroyed only by an attack that hits it. It ignores all other damage and effects.
An attacking creature is unaffected by this ability if it can't see, or if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight.
Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you take a long rest.

feat.name: Big Pecks
entries: While you are unarmored and not carrying a shield, your AC increases by 1. In addition, you may roll for {@skill Persuasion} and {@skill Intimidation} skill checks using your Strength modifier, rather than your Charisma modifier.

feat.name: Ingenious Trickster
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Deception} and {@skill Performance} skills. In addition, you learn the spell {@spell suggestion} and one cantrip from the enchantment school of magic. You can cast {@spell suggestion} without expending a spell slot. Once cast in this way, you can't cast it using this trait again until you finish a long rest.
Spellcasters may use their normal spellcasting modifier and spell save DC for these spells.
For non-spellcasters, your spellcasting modifier for these spells is Charisma, and your save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

feat.name: Quick Draw
entries: If you drew a weapon this turn, you can make your first melee weapon attack with that weapon with advantage. This attack crits on an 18, 19, or 20, and your reach for this attack is increased by 5 feet. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short rest or long rest, or until you next roll for initiative.

feat.name: You're Already Dead
entries: When you make a melee weapon attack against a surprised enemy, you score a critical hit on an 18, 19, or 20.
In addition, whenever you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack against an enemy, they take force damage equal to your level at the start of their next turn.

feat.name: Finesse Fighting Master
entries: You have mastered the art of elegant and dexterous fighting while using {@itemProperty F||finesse} weapons.

Whenever you make an attack with a {@itemProperty F||finesse} weapon on your turn, you can take a -5 penalty on your attack roll. If you hit, you gain +5 AC until the start of your next turn. You can benefit from this AC boost only once per round.
In addition, if you score a critical hit with a melee {@itemProperty F||finesse} weapon attack, you can forgo rolling the extra damage dice to {@action Dodge} instead.

feat.name: Swift Striker
entries: Whenever you would roll for initiative, as long as you are not surprised, you can choose to make a single ranged weapon attack or melee weapon attack immediately before making your roll. If you do so, make your initiative roll with disadvantage.

feat.name: Spell Sprinter
entries: You have mastered the art of sustaining a magical bombardment whilst manoeuvring yourself in the heat of battle.
On your turn, if you take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Dash} action, you can cast a cantrip using your bonus action.

feat.name: Sparring Partner
entries: While you are within 10ft of an allied player character with the Sparring Partner feat who isn't {@condition incapacitated}, increase your attack rolls, saving throws, and armour class by 1.

feat.name: Choke Out
entries: You have trained fiercely in the art of grapple fighting, maximising the impact of your pins and choke holds.
While you are grappling a creature, you can use your bonus action to crush it.
At the end of the crushed creature's next turn, if it is still {@condition grappled} by you, it gains a point of {@condition exhaustion}.
If the grappled creature breaks free, it loses one point of {@condition exhaustion} that it has accrued from this effect at the end of each of its turns that it isn't {@condition grappled}.

feat.name: Advanced Sparring Tactics
entries: While you are within 10ft of an allied player character with the Advanced Sparring Tactics feat who isn't {@condition incapacitated}, make all melee attack rolls at advantage, and no creature can make a melee attack roll with advantage against you.

feat.name: Unpredictable Enhancement
entries: You embrace a chaotic burst of magical power, enhancing yourself in unpredictable ways.

items: Increase a randomly determined ability score by 2, and decrease a randomly determined ability score by 1.
You gain proficiency in a randomly determined saving throw that you don't already have proficiency in.
Whenever you roll a natural 1 on a saving throw or skill check that you are proficient in, you can reroll that saving throw or skill check. You must use the new roll.

feat.name: Worldly
entries: Across a life of adventuring you have seen many incredible things and met many people, learning and growing from new experiences and cultures all the while.

items: Choose a background. You gain all skill proficiencies and other bonuses associated with that background, in addition to your current one.

feat.name: Light Armour Master
entries: You have trained extensively with Light Armour, learning to maximize the benefits it offers.
While you are wearing light armour, you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your AC by 1.

Whenever you make a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that you can see, such as a trap or a spell, you may roll {@dice 1d6} and add that number to the roll. To gain this benefit, you can't be {@condition incapacitated}. You can use this ability a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency modifier.

feat.name: Colossal Strength
entries: Increase your Strength-based attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks by 1.
When you make a Strength saving throw, you can choose to make that save at advantage. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

feat.name: Inner Courage
entries: You learn the {@spell heroism} spell and you can cast it without using a spell slot. You may cast it at a level equal to your proficiency bonus or below. Once you cast it in this way, you cannot do so again until you finish a short rest.
You can also cast the spell with any spell slots you have. The stat you increased with this feat is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

feat.name: Mesmeriser
entries: You learn one 1st level spell from the enchantment school of magic and you can cast it at its lowest level without using a spell slot. Once you cast it in this way, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you take this feat).

Whenever you cast a spell or use an ability that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist the {@condition charmed} condition, roll {@dice 2d4} and subtract that number from the creature's roll. Once you use this trait, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Unassailable
entries: Increase your Dexterity-based attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks by 1.
When you make a Dexterity saving throw, you can choose to make that save at advantage. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Fighting Spirit
entries: You gain a number of Ki Points equal to your Wisdom modifier. These ki points are added to your existing pool, and recharge after a short rest.

feat.name: Practiced Grappler
entries: You have advantage on {@skill Athletics} checks made to grapple another creature, and creatures have disadvantage on checks made to escape your grapple.
While you are grappling a creature, you can make a single weapon attack against that creature as a bonus action.

feat.name: Professional Coward
entries: Your movement speed increases by 10ft.

As long as you don't cast a spell or take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can take the {@action Dash} or {@action Dodge} action as a bonus action, and your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

feat.name: Cunning Intellect
entries: Increase your Intelligence-based attack rolls, damage rolls, and skill checks by 1.
When you make an Intelligence saving throw, you can choose to make that save at advantage. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Pledge of Intervention
entries: When you roll initiative, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
In addition, you gain one Divine Favour from a powerful, celestial being.

Once, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, you are instead teleported to a safe, familiar location on the material plane. You instantly gain the full benefits of a long rest, and then gain points of {@condition exhaustion} until you have five.
Once this favour has been called upon, you cannot use it again.

feat.name: Stalwart
entries: Your body has grown remarkably tough and unyielding.
Whenever a creature scores a critical hit against you, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to one damage type of that attack until the end of this turn.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws to resist or end the {@condition poisoned} condition.

feat.name: Acrobat
entries: You gain proficiency in {@skill Performance} and {@skill Acrobatics}. If you already have proficiency in any of those skills, you gain expertise in that skill instead, doubling your proficiency bonus for any ability check you make with it.
In addition, you learn the {@spell jump} spell, and can cast it with any spell slots you have.

You can also cast {@spell jump} without any components, targeting yourself, as a bonus action, without using a spell slot. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Cursed Form
entries: As a bonus action, you can take on a terrifying, monstrous form. It may be that bestial fur sprouts over your body, your teeth grow to form large fangs, your eyes turn jet black, your skin turns milky white, or some other physical transformation. This transformation is visual only, has no impact on your abilities, and lasts for one minute, or until you fall {@condition unconscious}.
While in your Monstrous Form, you gain the following benefits.

items: You gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus at the start of each of your turns. When the transformation ends, you lose any temporary hit points gained from this effect.
You have advantage on {@skill Intimidation} checks.
You resist necrotic, cold or poison damage (choose when you transform).
The first attack you make each turn deals an additional {@damage 1d8} necrotic, cold or poison damage (the same damage type as your resistance) on a hit.

entries: Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Levitation
entries: As a bonus action, you can grant yourself a fly speed of 10ft and you can hover. These effects last for the next minute, after which time you float gently to the ground if you are still aloft.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

feat.name: Glimpse of Infinity
entries: You learn the {@spell guidance} cantrip, and gain proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} and {@skill History} skills.
In addition, you can read all writing and understand any spoken language, but you cannot speak languages you do not know.

feat.name: Devastating Glamour
entries: Increase your Charisma based attack rolls, damage rolls, and ability checks by 1.
When you make a Charisma saving throw, you can choose to make that save at advantage. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Quick Thinking
