entries: As a reaction, you can add half your Intelligence score, rounded up, to an initiative roll or a Dexterity saving throw.

feat.name: Savage Soul
entries: When you reduce a hostile enemy Humanoid, Fiend, Celestial, Dragon, Aberration, Ooze or Monstrosity to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

feat.name: Versatile Weapon Master
entries: Your weapon attacks made with {@itemProperty V||Versatile} weapons use the larger damage die, even when wielded with only one hand.

In addition, if you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn and hit a creature while wielding a {@itemProperty V||Versatile} weapon with both hands, you may use your bonus action to make a single attack against a different creature with that same weapon.

feat.name: Natural Bond
entries: You gain the ability to communicate and influence certain types of creatures. Choose one: flying speed or swimming speed.

Beasts and Monstrosities with the chosen type of movement speed can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return. You have advantage on all Wisdom and Charisma checks you make to influence them.

feat.name: Furious Strikes
entries: Whenever you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn and score a critical hit with a weapon attack, double your damage modifiers when calculating the damage for that attack.
In addition, when you score a critical hit against a creature on your turn, you can make a single weapon attack this turn as a bonus action.

feat.name: Overchannel
entries: As a bonus action, you can channel your body with magical energy. The next levelled spell you cast this turn is treated as being cast with a spell slot of one level higher than the spell slot you expend to cast it.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Aerial Tactician
entries: While you are flying, if you make a melee weapon attack against a creature who is not flying, your attack rolls score a critical hit on a 19 or a 20.
In addition, if you are flying and score a critical hit against a creature, that creature cannot make opportunity attacks against you until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: Shimmer
entries: If you take the {@action Dash} action on your turn, your AC increases by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: One With The Shadows
entries: While in dim light or darkness, you can take the {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.
While in darkness, you have advantage on all {@skill Stealth} checks.

feat.name: Trampler
entries: When you reduce a creature's hit points to 0 with a melee weapon attack, you gain a bonus to your next attack roll equal to that creature's challenge rating or level.
In addition, any excess damage you dealt to that creature (that would theoretically reduce a creature to negative hit points) is added to your next damage roll.

feat.name: Double Jump
entries: Through mastery of magic or incredible athleticism, you can perform leaps that seem to defy the laws of physics.
As a reaction, after jumping, when you reach the height of your jump, you can immediately jump again, as if you were standing on the ground.
In addition, you can halve any falling damage you would take from landing after you have jumped, and you do not fall {@condition prone} upon taking fall damage.

feat.name: Wily Positioning
entries: While you are behind cover, you can take the {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.
In addition, while you are behind half cover or three-quarters cover, you gain a further +1 to your AC.

feat.name: Indomitable Fortitude
entries: You gain a +2 to your Constitution and Death Saving Throws.
When you make a Constitution saving throw, you can choose to make that save at advantage. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

feat.name: Jump Slam
entries: When you fall, if you would land in a space occupied by another creature, you use your reaction to attempt to slam into them. That creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you land on the creature, knocking them {@condition prone}. Any fall damage you would have taken from your fall onto that creature is then split equally between the two of you.
You then land in the nearest unoccupied space, and the momentum of your collision increases your movement speed by 10 feet until the end of this turn.

feat.name: Explosive Fury
entries: On your turn, if you are raging, you can expend one use of your rage to channel that energy into an explosive onslaught.
This turn, you can take an additional action and bonus action.
Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short rest.

feat.name: Magical Transference
entries: As an action, you can place your hand on a willing creature and expend two or more sorcery points.

That creature regains an expended spell slot of a level equal to or less than half the number of sorcery points you expended, and you both gain temporary hit points equal to twice the number sorcerer points you expended.
If you expended 6 or more sorcery points to use this feature: you both also gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing and Piercing damage for the next 10 minutes.

If you expended 20 or more sorcery points to use this feature: you both also return to full hit points, are cured of the {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified} and {@condition stunned} conditions, and have advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws for the next minute.

feat.name: Ki Blast
entries: As an action, you can expend any number of ki points to channel that mystical energy into a devastating blast.

You let loose a beam of force 5 feet wide and 30 feet long. Any creatures in the area of effect must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. For each ki point you expended beyond the first, increase the damage dealt by {@damage 1d6}.

If you expended 6 or more ki points to use this feature, you can increase the size of the effect. Either the size of the beam increases to 10 feet wide and 60 feet long, or you can let loose the energy as a pulse that strikes all other creatures in a 15-foot radius.

If you expended 20 or more ki points to use this feature, those in the area of effect automatically fail the Dexterity saving throw, and are also {@condition paralyzed} until the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Vassal of the Demon Prince
entries: On your turn, when you take the {@action Attack} action, you can replace one of those attacks with an attempt to frighten one creature within 30 feet of you that you can see. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, that creature is {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn or until they are no longer within line of sight.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

feat.name: Contract with the Archdevil God
entries: You cannot have disadvantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) or Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks.
When you take fire damage, you can use your reaction to halve that fire damage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

feat.name: Blessing of the Celestial Dragon
entries: On your turn, when you take the {@action Attack} action, you can replace one of those attacks with a brilliant burst of restorative light that exudes from your form. One creature of your choice within 30 feet of you regains hit points equal to your level.
If this healing restores a creature to full hit points, they gain any leftover points of healing from this ability as temporary hit points.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

feat.name: Conduit of the Tarrasque
entries: The furious power of the Tarrasque echoes within you, granting the following benefits.
You cannot have disadvantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks.

There is no size restriction on creatures you can attempt to shove. In addition, when you shove a creature no more than one size larger than you, you can choose to push it up to 15 feet away, not just 5 feet.

feat.name: Conduit of the Kraken
entries: The rumbling power of the Kraken surges through you, granting the following benefits.
You can breathe in air and water.
When a hostile creature moves out of your reach, you can use your reaction to attempt to grapple the provoking creature. This grapple occurs right before the creature leaves your reach.

feat.name: Conduit of the Beholder
entries: The tyrannical magic of the Beholder burns within you, granting the following benefits.

When you make an attack roll against one creature, you can imbue that attack with magic. The target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier). If the creature fails that saving throw, roll on the table below and apply that effect.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus per long rest (rounded down), but no more than once per turn.

rows: The target is {@condition charmed} by you until the end of your next turn.
The target is {@condition paralyzed} until the start of your next turn.
The target is {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn.
The target's speed is halved and it can't take reactions until the end of your next turn.
The target takes {@damage #$prompt_number:min=2,max=9,title=Enter a Number!,default=2$#d6|Xd6} necrotic damage, where X is equal to your proficiency bonus.
You telekinetically move the creature up to 30 feet in any direction.
The creature falls asleep and remains {@condition unconscious} until the start of your next turn, or until it takes damage or another creature uses an action to wake it.
The creature is {@condition restrained} until the end of your next turn.
The creature takes {@damage #$prompt_number:min=2,max=9,title=Enter a Number!,default=2$#d8|Xd8} force damage, where X is your proficiency bonus.

The creature takes {@damage #$prompt_number:min=2,max=9,title=Enter a Number!,default=2$#d10|Xd10} necrotic damage, where X is your proficiency bonus. It dies if this damage reduces it to 0 hit points.

feat.name: Earthshaker
entries: Making full use of your colossal strength and the weight of your weapon, you can destroy the earth at your feet. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you take the {@action Attack} action while wielding a heavy weapon, in place of one attack you can slam that weapon into the earth at a point within your reach, releasing a shockwave of force in a 5 foot square centered at the point you strike. That area becomes difficult terrain.

In addition, any creatures other than you standing in the area of the shockwave must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) or take {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}.

feat.name: Stealth Shooter
entries: You are adept at shooting from positions of safety without sacrificing accuracy. You gain the following benefits:

items: Being {@condition prone} does not impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

feat.name: Close-Range Tactics
entries: You have trained for the worst, and can hold your own in close range fighting, even while wielding a ranged weapon that requires ammunition. You gain the following benefits:

items: If your weapon has the ammunition property, such as the {@item longbow|PHB} or {@item hunting rifle}, you can wield it as a {@item club|PHB} at close range. It has a reach of 5 feet, it deals {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage on a hit, and you can use your Strength or Dexterity modifier for attack and damage rolls you make with it.

While you are wielding a weapon with the ammunition property, you can use your reaction to increase your AC by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus until the end of that turn when you are hit by a melee weapon attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

feat.name: Cunning of the Chromatic Green Dragon
entries: You possess the cunning mind and deadly poison of the green chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: As a bonus action, you coat one slashing or piercing weapon with a poison you magically conjure. The poison remains potent until the end of this turn. The first time you hit a creature with that weapon this turn, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) taking Xd8 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success, where X is equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

feat.name: Deftness of the Chromatic Blue Dragon
entries: You possess the grace and blistering speed of the blue chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: As a bonus action, you move up to 30 feet in a straight line in any direction as a bolt of lightning, ending your movement on a surface that can support you. You can move through creatures (but not objects thicker than 5 feet), and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Creatures you move through in this way take {@damage 1d6} lightning damage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

feat.name: Fury of the Chromatic Red Dragon
entries: You possess the blazing fury of the red chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: As a bonus action, you can exhale a 15-foot cone of flame. Creatures in that area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) or take Xd6 damage, where X is equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

feat.name: Terror of the Chromatic Black Dragon
entries: You possess the terrifying aura of the black chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: As a bonus action, you can wield your draconic power to let loose a ferocious roar. Creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) or become {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

feat.name: Savagery of the Chromatic White Dragon
entries: You possess the unyielding ferocity and freezing magic of the white chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: You can make a single weapon attack as a bonus action. If you do so using this feature, you do not add your ability modifier to the damage. In addition, you can choose for that attack to deal cold damage instead of the weapon's normal damage type. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and regain all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

feat.name: Vassal of the Chromatic Dragon God
