entries: You are a living vortex of turbulent, chromatic energy. Your incredible draconic power offers the following benefits.

items: On your turn, you can take one additional bonus action. You can use this feature only once per turn, and up to a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.
You have a resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage.
You have a flying speed, swimming speed, and climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
You have Blindsight out to 60 feet, and Darkvision out to 120 feet.
You have a Legendary Resistance. Once per long rest, if you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.

feat.name: Blessing of the Forge
entries: At the end of a long rest, you can infuse one nonmagical simple or martial weapon with a spark of magical energy. Until the end of your next long rest, the object becomes a magic item, granting a +1 bonus to attack rolls or damage rolls (your choice). This bonus increases to +2 when you reach level 9, and +3 when you reach level 17.

feat.name: Blessing of the Storm
entries: You learn the {@spell thaumaturgy} cantrip. In addition, when you use an action to cast the spell {@spell thaumaturgy}, or a spell that deals cold, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use a bonus action that turn to generate a whirling eddy of elemental winds about you. Doing so allows you to fly up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regain all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

feat.name: Blessing of the Celestial
entries: You learn the {@spell sacred flame} and {@spell spare the dying} cantrips. In addition, as bonus action, you can use your own life force to heal others. Expend a number of Hit Dice up to your proficiency bonus, roll them, and add your Constitution modifier. You can then heal a one willing creature within 5 feet of you (excluding yourself) for a number of hit points equal to the result. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

feat.name: Breath of the Brass Dragon
entries: You possess the magical, sleeping breath of the brass metallic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: As a bonus action, you can exhale sleep gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier) or fall {@condition unconscious} for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Courage of the Bronze Dragon
entries: You possess the stalwart courage of the bronze metallic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: You are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition. In addition, you can use a bonus action to touch an allied creature and impart a magical energy of courage and vitality, ending one of the following conditions affecting it: {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition stunned}. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Form of the Gold Dragon
entries: You possess the power to take on an aspect of the gold metallic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: As a bonus action, you can manifest spectral, golden wings on your body. These wings last for 1 minute. For the duration, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. If you already have a flying speed, your fly speed is instead increased by 15 feet. Once you manifest your wings using this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Transformation of the Silver Dragon
entries: You possess the shapeshifting powers of the silver chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits.

items: You know the spell {@spell alter self}, and can cast it as a bonus action using this trait. Once you cast {@spell alter self} with this trait, you can't cast it again with this trait until you finish a long rest. You can also cast {@spell alter self} with any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence your spellcasting ability for this spell when you cast it with this trait.

feat.name: Wit of the Copper Dragon
entries: You possess the stinging wit and provocative humour of the copper metallic dragons, granting you the following benefits:

items: As a bonus action, you can hurl a magically-infused insult at a creature within 60 feet of yourself that can hear you (it need not understand you). The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or it has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you until the start of your next turn. The DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Vassal of the Metallic Dragon God
entries: You are a roiling typhoon of divine, draconic energy. Your incredible power offers the following benefits.

items: On your turn, you can take one additional bonus action. You can use this feature only once per turn, and up to a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.
You have a resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage.

You have a breath weapon attack. As an action, you can exhale a 30-foot cone of energy of one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Creatures in that cone must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) or take {@damage 8d6} damage of the type you chose, or half as much on a success. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.
You have Blindsight out to 60 feet, and Darkvision out to 120 feet.
You have a Legendary Resistance. Once per long rest, if you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.

feat.name: Heavy Metal
entries: You have trained to wear heavy armour, it's cumbersome weight no longer restricting your abilities. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have proficiency with Heavy Armour, and ignore any restrictions wearing Heavy Armour places on your Barbarian features (with the exception of Unarmoured Defence), such as your ability to Rage.

feat.name: Knockback Blow
entries: The power of your fists is akin to magic. You learn the {@spell punch out|DMSecretWeapon} cantrip. In addition, you can spend 1 ki point to cast {@spell punch out|DMSecretWeapon} as a bonus action. If you do, you make the melee attack roll as a part of that spell at advantage.

feat.name: Fundamental Boon
entries: Your patron favours you with increased magical power. You learn two cantrips of your choice from any spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting modifier for these spells. In addition, as a bonus action, you can expend a Pact Magic slot to cast {@spell eldritch blast}.
If you are multiclassed, or multiclass at any time, you lose all benefits of this feat. Instead, you increase one ability score of your choice by 2, to a maximum of 20.

feat.name: Infiltration Warrior
entries: You have trained to wield heavier and more cumbersome armour, without restricting your stealthy capabilities. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with Medium Armour and Shields.
Wearing Medium Armour doesn't impose disadvantage on your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

feat.name: All's Well That Ends Spell
entries: You are well practiced in the art of battling other spellcasters, granting you the following benefits.

items: If a spell you cast is countered, you regain the spell slot used to cast that spell, and can use the same action, bonus action, or reaction you used to cast the countered spell to cast a cantrip in its place.
A creature damaged by a spell you cast has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain its {@status concentration}.

If you lose {@status concentration} on a spell as a result of taking damage, you can use your reaction to deal force damage equal to 5 times that spell's level to one creature you can see within 30 feet of you.

feat.name: Ki Thief
entries: Your command of ki is so great that you have the power to manipulate the life force of others, granting you the following benefits.

items: Your unarmed strikes and monk weapons score a critical hit on a 19 or a 20.
When you score a critical hit against a creature with an unarmed strike or monk weapon, you regain 2 ki points.

feat.name: Hunter's Mastery
entries: Your focus in battle is nigh-unshakable, granting you the following benefits.

items: You learn the spell {@spell hunter's mark}. It counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.
When you roll for initiative, you can use your reaction to cast {@spell hunter's mark}. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status concentration} on your ranger spells.

If the target of your {@spell hunter's mark} 0 hit points before the spell ends, you can use a reaction to mark a new creature. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Deadly Hunter
entries: Your battlefield focus is unmatched. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the spell {@spell hunter's mark}, or one other 1st level Ranger spell of your choice.
The damage you deal through {@spell hunter's mark} increases from {@damage 1d6} to {@damage 1d8}.
When you cast {@spell hunter's mark} using your bonus action, if you take the {@action Attack} action on that turn, you can make one additional weapon attack as a part of that attack action.

feat.name: Union Shape
entries: The magic of the natural word flows through your body and into others. You gain the following benefits:

items: As an action, you can touch a willing creature and expend a use of your Wild Shape. That creature Wild Shapes into a Beast of its choice that you could Wild Shape into using your Wild Shape feature for the next hour. The transformation ends early if the target uses its action to revert to its true form, if you Wild Shape, or if you use this feature again.

feat.name: Savant
entries: You are prodigious in the art of spellcasting. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn two cantrips from the {@filter Wizard spell list|spells|class=Wizard}.
You learn one 1st-level spell from the {@filter Wizard spell list|spells|class=Wizard}.
Once per short rest, you can cast one 1st-level spell without expending a spell slot.

feat.name: Simple Life
entries: You prefer to keep things simple, dedicating your full attention to a single action and making it count.

items: At the start of your turn, you can choose to forgo taking a bonus action, reaction, or using your movement until the start of your next turn. If you do, you gain a bonus equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to all attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws you make until the start of your next turn.

feat.name: Razor's Edge
entries: You revel in danger and the thrill of battle.

items: While your hit points are lower than half your hit point maximum, you have advantage on attack rolls.
While you have exactly 1 hit point, you score a critical hit on an attack roll of 18-20.

feat.name: Untarnished
entries: You are a fearsome combatant, able to push yourself beyond typical limits while at full strength.

items: While you are at full hit points, you can add +1 to your attack rolls, damage rolls, ability checks, and spell save DC.

feat.name: Soul-Fueled
entries: You can push beyond your normal limitations to enhance your spells at the cost of your own body. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can enhance a spell with metamagic even if you have no sorcery points available. If you do, expend a number of hit dice equal to the number of sorcery points you wish to expend to enhance a spell, roll them, and you take force damage equal to the result. This force damage can't be reduced, prevented, or redirected in any way. The spell then takes effect as normal with the metamagic applied as if you expended sorcery points to enhance it. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Battle Tactician
entries: You are swift of mind and body on the battlefield, inspiring allies and striking down foes with your natural combat virtuosity. You gain the following benefits.

items: You have a +5 bonus to initiative rolls.

Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can target one ally within 30 feet that can see or hear you. That target gains a bonus to the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes within the next minute equal to the ability score modifier of the ability you increased with this feat.

feat.name: Pact Tactics
entries: You have entered into an additional pact as a means to enhance your power. Choose one Warlock pact. You gain the benefits of that pact in addition to those of your current pact.
You can take this feat multiple times.

feat.name: Smite to Ruin
entries: Your tenacity and ferocity as a magical warrior is unmatched.

items: You learn the spell {@spell branding smite}, or one other 1st-level "smite" spell of your choice.
If you cast a "smite" spell using a bonus action, you have advantage on the next attack roll you make that turn.
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status concentration} on your smite spells.

feat.name: Invoked Divinity
entries: Your connection to the divine spans multiple faiths and allegiances.

items: Choose a Cleric subclass other than your current one. You can use the Channel Divinity feature of that subclass once per long rest, expending a use of your Channel Divinity as normal.

feat.name: Self-Affirmation
entries: Your self-confidence and determination empower your magic.

items: When you use your Bardic Inspiration, you can choose yourself as the beneficiary of the feature.

When you score a critical hit on an attack roll, or a creature rolls a natural 1 when making a saving throw to resist the effect of a spell you cast, you regain one expended use of your Bardic Inspiration.

feat.name: Soul Gift
entries: The power of your magic ripples out beyond your body and into others. Spells you cast with a range of self (such as {@spell alter self}) can target a willing creature you can see within 5 feet of you in place of yourself. The spell still uses your spellcasting ability modifier.

feat.name: Fiend Touched
entries: Your exposure to the magic of fiends has changed you, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell scorching ray} spell and one 1st-level spell of your choice. The 1st-level spell must be from the Evocation or Transmutation school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feat.name: Hypnotist
entries: You have trained in the subtle art of hypnosis to gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell command} spell, and can cast it without expending a spell slot. Once you cast it in this way, you can't cast it in this way again until you finish a long rest. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

Over the course of a short rest, you can use your skills on a willing ally to temporarily bolster their mental fortitude. Choose one ability from among Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma. That creature can add {@dice 1d4} to saving throws that use that ability for the next 8 hours. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Magical Conduit
entries: Your body is unique attuned to magic, granting you the following benefits:

items: When you fail a saving throw against a spell, you can use a reaction to roll {@dice 1d4} and add the result to that save, potentially turning a failure into a success.
When a spell attack roll hits you, you can use a reaction to roll {@dice 1d6} and add the result to your AC for that attack, potentially causing that attack to miss.
You gain {@dice 1d6} temporary hit points when you cast a spell of 1st-level or higher with the range of self.

feat.name: Aerial Acrobat
entries: You are a master of flight, granting you the following benefits.

items: Increase your flying speed by 10 feet.
While flying, ranged attack rolls against you can't have advantage.

While flying, you can take the {@action Dodge} or {@action Dash} actions as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

feat.name: Gish Warrior
entries: In battle, you entwine spellcasting and weapon fighting, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn one cantrip of your choice from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}.

If you take the {@action Attack} action, you can cast a cantrip with the casting time of 1 action as a bonus action that turn. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
If you cast a spell using an action, you can make a single weapon attack as a bonus action that turn. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

feat.name: Battlefield Commander
entries: You are a natural born leader, with a gifted, tactical mind. In battle, you create opportunities to undermine enemies and engineer the flow of combat to lead allies to victory. You gain the following benefits:

items: As a bonus action, you can focus your senses to perfectly track the movements of one creature you can see within 30 feet, readying yourself to respond to its every action. Until the start of your next turn, that creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can forgo one of your attacks to direct one of your allies to strike instead. When you do so, choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you and who is within 30 feet of you. That creature can immediately use its reaction to make a single weapon attack. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.

feat.name: Survivor
entries: You are a battle-hardened, tough-as-nails survivor, able to shrug off punishment that would fell a lesser warrior. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to your level. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by 1 point.
Whenever you take bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage, you can use a reaction to expend one hit die and roll it. The damage taken is reduced by an amount equal to the number rolled.

feat.name: Mystic Reserves
entries: Your well of arcane power runs deeper than most, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn one 1st-level spell of your choice.
You gain two additional 1st-level spell slots. These spell slots can only be used to cast spells you know or have prepared. You regain these spell slots after a long rest.

feat.name: Comradery
entries: You are a stalwart inspiration to your allies—gentle as a rising wind beneath them, and as sturdy as an iron anchor in their defence. You gain the following benefits.

items: You learn the spell {@spell heartening word|DMSecretWeapon}, and can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to the modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a long rest.
When an ally you can see falls to 0 hit points, you gain the benefits of the bolstered condition until the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Bouncer
entries: You are both hardy and bouncy. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you are hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against one creature within your reach. You can make an attack in this way a number of times equal to the modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
When you are knocked {@condition prone}, you can use your reaction to stand up.

feat.name: Minimizer
entries: As an action, or as a reaction when hit by an attack, you can shrink yourself and everything you are currently wearing or carrying to ¼ size. Your size category is reduced by 2 (to a minimum of Tiny), your AC increases by 2 (potentially turning a hit into a miss), you have disadvantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks and Strength saving throws, and you have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics} and {@skill Stealth}) checks and Dexterity saving throws.

This transformation lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose {@status concentration} (as if concentrating on a spell), at which time you revert to normal size. If there isn't room for you to return to your normal size, you are shunted directly to the nearest unoccupied space where there is room for you to revert, taking {@damage 1d10} bludgeoning damage for every 5 feet you are shunted.

feat.name: Brewer
entries: You are adept at brewing potions, granting you the following benefits.

items: You gain proficiency with {@item brewer's supplies|PHB}, or with one set of artisan's tools of your choice.

Over the course of a long rest, you can brew a number of common potions (such as {@item potion of healing}) equal to your proficiency bonus. Each potion requires 30 gold's worth of materials, which are consumed in the brewing process.

Upon reaching 9th level, you can instead craft a single uncommon potion (such as a {@item potion of greater healing}) over the course of a long rest. The potion requires 200 gold's worth of materials, which are consumed in the brewing process.

Upon reaching 17th level, you can instead craft a single rare potion (such as a {@item potion of superior healing}) over the course of a long rest. The potion requires 1,000 gold's worth of materials, which are consumed in the brewing process.

feat.name: Swagger
entries: Your swaggering confidence is equally irresistible and infuriating, granting you the following benefits.

items: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}.

As an action, you can make a Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check contested by a creature's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. If you succeed on the check, and the creature is not hostile to you, it becomes {@condition charmed} by you for 1 minute, or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. If you succeed on the check, and the creature is hostile to you, it becomes {@condition goaded|} by you for 1 minute. It has advantage on attack rolls against you, and disadvantage on attack rolls made against any other target. If a target succeeds on its check, it is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. Once you succeed on your check using this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

feat.name: Savage Strikes
entries: You masterfully leverage your weapon's size and weight to thwart your foes.
Whenever you roll maximum damage on the damage roll you make using a {@itemProperty H||heavy} weapon, the target of the attack falls {@condition prone}.

feat.name: Undauntable
entries: Your courage in the face of adversity is undauntable, granting you the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws to resist or end the {@condition frightened} condition.
Whenever you roll a natural 1 on a saving throw, you gain a point of inspiration.

feat.name: Relentless Ferocity
entries: Your tenacity in the face of death is second to none.

items: When your Relentless Endurance trait activates, after dropping to 1 hit point, you can expend any number of available Hit Dice, roll them, and gain hit points equal to the result + your Constitution modifier.

feat.name: Transient Meditation
entries: In moments of peaceful rest, you find magic as well as tranquility.

items: When you finish a long rest, if you spent those hours in a trance-like meditation, you can choose one 1st-level spell from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}. Until your next long rest, you know that spell and have it prepared, and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can also cast that spell with any spell slots you have.

feat.name: Fortune Blessed
entries: Ever blessed, your natural good fortune is startling.

items: You can use your Lucky trait to reroll a D20 test when the result on the die is a 1 or a 2. You must use the new result.

feat.name: Ancient Speech
entries: The well of draconic power within you can take on many forms.

items: You can expend one use of your Breath Weapon to let loose a magically infused word of draconic power, directed at a creature within 30 feet that can hear you. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) or become {@condition charmed} by you for the next minute, or until you do something harmful to it. When the effect ends, the creature knows it was {@condition charmed} by you, unless it failed its initial save by 5 or more, in which case it is unaware anything happened.

feat.name: Iron Metabolism
entries: Your mighty stomach is chief among your greatest assets.

items: You have advantage on saves to resist or end the {@condition poisoned} condition.
If you would gain hit points from ingesting something (such as a {@item potion of healing} or a {@spell goodberry}) you regain that many hit points plus your Constitution modifier instead.

feat.name: Unarmored Mastery
entries: While others place their faith in the tools of war, yours is steadfast in your own body.

items: While you aren't wearing armour and all your hands are free, your AC increases by 1.

feat.name: Elemental Virtuoso
entries: You have a particular affinity for the primal magic of the multiverse. Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder.

items: Add +2 to damage rolls you make that deal the chosen damage type.
You resist the chosen damage type.

entries: You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different damage type each time.

feat.name: Outmuscle
entries: You wield your size and strength to an impressive advantage over those smaller than you.

items: When you hit a creature your size or smaller, you can take a bonus action this turn to take the {@action Shove} or {@action Grapple} action targeting that creature.

When you successfully {@action Shove} or {@action Grapple} a creature, that creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier. Creatures {@condition grappled} by you take this damage again at the end of each of their turns.

feat.name: Tinyfication
entries: Your innate magic lets you take your small size to the extremes.

items: As an action, you can shrink yourself and objects you are wearing or carrying. This reduction decreases your size by one category—from Small to Tiny, for example. While reduced, your AC increases by 2, and you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws and {@skill Stealth} checks. You also have disadvantage on Strength saving throws, and while your weapons are shrunk, they have a -{@dice 1d4} penalty to damage rolls (this can't reduce the damage below 1).
This size reduction lasts for 1 hour, or until you choose to end it as an action. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feat.name: Natural Magician

prerequisite.other: a species that grants the ability to cast a levelled spell

entries: Magic flows through your blood, its potency sizzling in your very soul.

items: You can cast levelled spells granted by your species a number of times per day equal to your proficiency bonus using the trait that confers them.
When you cast a levelled spell granted to you by your species, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat.

feat.name: Sling Master
entries: In your capable hands, the simple {@item sling|PHB} is a terrifying and lethal weapon. Your mastery grants you the following benefits:

items: Attacking at long range with a {@item sling|PHB} doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls.
Attacking a {@condition prone} creature at range with a {@item sling|PHB} doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls.

Once per turn, when you roll maximum damage on an attack made against a creature using a {@item sling|PHB}, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus) or fall {@condition prone}.

feat.name: Scourge Master
entries: You have mastered the {@item whip|PHB}, granting you the following benefits:

items: The damage die of the {@item whip|PHB} increases from {@damage 1d4} to {@damage 1d6} when you attack with it.

Once per turn, when you damage a creature with an attack roll using a {@item whip|PHB}, you can also attempt to strike another creature within your reach as part of that same attack. If your initial attack roll is sufficient to hit the second target, it takes damage equal to half the damage dealt to the initial target.

Once per turn, when you hit a creature that is no more than one size category larger than you with an attack using a {@item whip|PHB}, you can forgo dealing damage to instead knock that creature {@condition prone} or pull it up to 10 feet closer to you.

feat.name: Blowgun Expert
entries: You are an expert in the subtle and deadly art of applying poison to {@item blowgun|PHB} ammunition, granting you the following benefits:

items: You ignore the {@itemProperty LD||loading} property of the {@item blowgun|PHB}.
You gain proficiency with the {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}.

As a bonus action, you can coat a number of {@item blowgun needle|PHB|blowgun darts} equal to your Dexterity modifier in a simple poison. The poison remains potent for 1 minute once applied, or until it strikes a creature. When you hit a creature with a poisoned dart, the target takes an additional {@damage 1d6} poison damage. If you score a critical hit with a poisoned dart, the target is also {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

item.name: Essence Capture Vessel
entries: Made from simple wood and bearing only a basic runic inscription, the Essence Capture Vessel does not appear outwardly powerful. A creature who puts an ear to the locket can hear a gentle swirling sound.

As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet of you dies, you can make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check with a DC equal to that creature's CR or level + 5. On a success, a fragment of the creature's essence is bound to the Essence Capture Vessel.
The Vessel can only house one creature's essence at a time, and cannot be opened while housing a creature's essence.
The bound creature cannot be restored to life by any means shorter than a {@spell wish} spell.

In addition, while attuned, the Essence Capture Vessel grants you one Special Trait or damage resistance of the captured creature, at the DM's discretion. For example, the captured essence may grant you a hezrou's Magic Resistance, a white dragon's Ice Walk, a giant hyena's Rampage, or a water elemental's resistance to acid damage.

As an action, you can release the fragment of essence stored within the Essence Capture Vessel, at which point it loses all abilities associated with the captured creature and cannot be used to seal another essence for {@dice 1d8} days.

item.name: Countercharm Locket
entries: This tiny locket has the symbol of an open palm etched on the surface, and holds a small mirror inside.
If you fail a saving throw against either the {@condition frightened} or {@condition charmed} condition, you instead succeed, and the Countercharm Locket crumbles to dust.

item.name: Jack's Magical Music Box
entries: This tiny music box plays a delicate and sorrowful tune when open and echoes out in a 30-foot radius. The music plays for 10 minutes, after which the box automatically closes and cannot be reopened until the next dawn.

A creature within 30 feet of the open box can understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when it speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

Creatures within range of the open box have advantage on any ability check to interact socially with any creature also within range that isn't immune to the {@condition charmed} condition or {@condition deafened}.

Up to one creature can choose to concentrate on the box for the full 10 minute duration of the music. If it does so, it gains the benefits of a short rest. It cannot benefit from this effect of Jack's Magical Music Box again for {@dice 1d4} days.

item.name: Vibranite Shield
entries: While holding this shield, when you take the Attack action, you can use one of your attacks to hurl the shield at a creature within 60 feet. Make a ranged attack roll against that target using either Strength or Dexterity. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked {@condition prone}.

On a critical hit, the shield ricochets off the creature it strikes and towards another creature within 30 feet of your choice. Make a new ranged attack roll against the new target, treating all rolls and damage as a part of the same Attack action.
As a bonus action, if you have at least one hand free and the shield is within 90 feet of you, you can speak a command word to cause the Vibranite Shield to animate and fly into your empty hand.

item.name: Moonblessed Shield
entries: As a reaction, if an enemy hits you with a melee attack, you can activate the Moonblessed Shield to let loose a burst of blinding, radiant light. All creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 10 + your proficiency bonus) or be {@condition blinded} until the start of their next turn.
Once you use this property of the Moonblessed Shield, you cannot do so again until the next dawn.

item.name: Familiar's Brooch
entries: This magical brooch strengthens the bond between a familiar and their summoner. While both of you are attuned to the brooch, you gain the following benefits:

items: You can see through your familiar's eyes and hear what it hears as a bonus action, rather than an action.
You can communicate telepathically with your familiar across a number of miles equal to your proficiency bonus.
When you cast a spell that targets only you, you can choose to target your familiar as well.

If within 5 feet of both you and a hostile enemy, your familiar can use its reaction to feint or otherwise distract your foe, giving them disadvantage on their next melee attack roll made against you.

item.name: Fated Coin (Heads)
entries: This silver coin bears the head of a dragon on both sides. As an action, you can roll it across your fingers to cast the spell {@spell longstrider} at 3rd level. Once used in this way, the Fated Coin (Heads) cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Fated Coin (Tails)
entries: This silver coin bears the tail of a dragon on both sides. As an action, you can roll it across your fingers to cast the spell {@spell pass without trace}. Once used in this way, the Fated Coin (Tails) cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Fey Longbow
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to damage and attack rolls made with this weapon.

This bow has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 - 1} charges each dawn. As a bonus action, you can infuse an arrow with the Fey Longbow's energy. Until the end of this turn, if you shoot that arrow from the Fey Longbow to a point within the weapon's normal range, a willing creature within 10 feet of you can use its reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of where the arrow landed.

item.name: Eldritch Chaos Hat
entries: This tattered, frayed hat whispers dark promises of power to its wearer.
When you make a ranged spell attack that targets only one creature, the Eldritch Chaos Hat sends a flood of eldritch energy through you, granting the following effects:

items: You gain a +1 to your spell attack roll.
The spell deals an additional {@damage 2d8} force damage on a hit.
If the spell misses, the Eldritch Chaos Hat deals {@damage 1d8} force damage to you. Damage dealt to you by the Eldritch Chaos Hat can't be prevented or reduced in any way.

item.name: Chaos Boots
entries: While you wear these boots, you can use a bonus action and click the boots' heels together. If you do, the boots impart the following effects:

items: Your walking speed increases by 20 feet.
You can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down, while leaving your hands free.
You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

Your body shimmers with pale blue light, emits a gentle humming sound, and releases a faint scent of burning. You make Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks with disadvantage and gain no benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

entries: If you click your heels together again, you end these effects. When the boots' property has been used for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Chaos Shield
entries: You gain an additional +1 bonus to AC while wielding this shield.
Whenever a melee attack aimed at you misses by 3 or less, the Chaos Shield blasts the attacker with a burst of force. They take force damage equal to half your AC, rounded down.

Whenever an enemy scores a critical hit against you with a melee weapon attack, the Chaos Shield vanishes into the Ethereal Plane, and you lose any benefit from wielding it. It reappears on the ground in front of you {@dice 1d10} minutes after disappearing.

item.name: Funny Bone
entries: A seemingly innocuous human radius bone.

As an action, you can use the Funny Bone to cast the spell {@spell tasha's hideous laughter||hideous laughter}, replacing the spell's material components with the Funny Bone. Once you use this feature of the Funny Bone, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.
At the DM's discretion, the bone may also speak jokes aloud periodically.

item.name: Gambler's Boots
entries: While you wear these boots, you can use your bonus action to click the heels together once, twice, or three times to activate them for 10 minutes or until you use a bonus action to end the effect.
For each time you clicked your heels, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and your armor class decreases by 1.
When the boots' property has been used for 60 minutes, the magic ceases to function until the next dawn.

item.name: Saddle of the Zoologist
entries: This simple leather saddle will shift in size and dimensions to accommodate any form or shape. While a creature is willingly wearing the saddle, it can be mounted by any other creature of size equal to or smaller than its own, regardless of whether their anatomy is appropriate.
In addition, a creature wearing the saddle increases their base walking, swimming, climbing, and flying speeds by 10 feet while mounted (if they have them).

item.name: Bag of Colding
entries: This bag functions as a normal {@item bag of holding}, with the following benefits:

items: Organic matter stored in the Bag of Colding is preserved perfectly. A corpse placed in the Bag of Colding is treated as being dead for only as long as the amount of time it has spent outside of the Bag of Colding.
You can withdraw a 5-foot cube of ice from the Bag of Colding each day. This ice does not count against the carrying capacity of the Bag of Colding.

As an action, you can open the Bag of Colding, aim it at a target, and speak a command word. A blast of freezing wind shoots from the bag in a 30-foot-long line. Any creature in this line must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Once you use this feature, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Hat of all Fashions
entries: While attuned to this hat, you can attempt to read and activate spell scrolls from any spellcasting class, not just your own. When you do so, make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check (DC = 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell takes effect.

item.name: The Bard's Boom Box
entries: This simple music box has a dial that can be turned from numbers 0–11.
If the dial is set to 0, no music can be heard.
If the dial is turned to 1, an incredibly faint melody emanates from the box.
As the dial is turned higher, the volume increases. At 10, the music is deafeningly loud.

If the dial is turned to 11, the music instantly stops, and the Bard's Boom Box explodes one round later. All creatures within 15 feet of the Boom Box when it explodes must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 12d6} thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

item.name: Bijou of the Banshee
entries: A beautiful, ornately fashioned jewel, housing the magical essence of a banshee.
As an action, you can throw the jewel up to 60 feet, whereupon it shatters on contact with the ground or an object or creature.

From the point where the Bijou shatters, a mournful wail is released. This wail has no effect on constructs and undead. All other creatures within 30 feet that can hear the wail must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

item.name: Bijou of the Sphinx
entries: A beautiful, ornately fashioned jewel, housing the magical essence of a sphinx.

As an action, you can throw the jewel up to 60 feet, whereupon it shatters on contact with the ground or an object or creature. When you hurl this Bijou, choose a number of creatures you can see equal to your proficiency modifier. Those creatures are immune to its effects.

From the point where the Bijou shatters, a deafening roar is released. All other creatures within 100 feet that can hear the roar must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10|8d10}) thunder damage and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

item.name: Bijou of the Gold Dragon
entries: A beautiful, ornately fashioned jewel, housing the magical essence of a gold dragon.
As an action, you can throw the jewel up to 60 feet, whereupon it shatters on contact with the ground or an object or creature.

From the point where the Bijou shatters, a translucent, white gas is released in a 30-foot-radius sphere. All other creatures in that area must make a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature has disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

item.name: Bijou of the Hezrou
entries: A beautiful, ornately fashioned jewel, housing the magical essence of a hezrou.
As an action, you can throw the jewel up to 60 feet, whereupon it shatters on contact with the ground or an object or creature.

From the point where the Bijou shatters, a translucent, green gas is released in a 30-foot-radius sphere. All other creatures in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

item.name: Bloodwell Claws
entries: These black, fingerless gloves are patterned with a sprawling, crimson, jagged design.
As a bonus action, you can activate the Bloodwell Claws for 1 minute. The gloves grow to form vicious, long claws, granting you the following benefits:

items: Your AC increases by 2.
You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks.
Any sorcerer cantrips with the ranged property also become melee spell attacks with a range of 15 feet.
When you strike a creature with a melee weapon cantrip, you can add your Charisma modifier to any damage you roll.

entries: Once the Bloodwell Claws have been activated, they cannot be used again until the following dawn.

item.name: Cursed Vial
entries: Any liquid stored in this vial is imbued with foul, necrotic magic. This cursed liquid is indistinguishable from its normal form. Once the Cursed Vial corrupts a liquid in this way, it cannot do so again until the next dawn.

Any creature who ingests the cursed liquid becomes {@condition poisoned} and takes {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns until the curse is lifted by {@spell remove curse} or other similar magic.

You can also use an action to apply the cursed liquid to any piercing weapon, though when you hit a target with an attack the curse reacts differently. That target must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, or take {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage and become {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Scroll of Kraken's Favour
entries: Using an action to read this scroll causes it to disintegrate as a magical tear in the fabric of space appears at a point you choose within 30 feet. The portal is one way only; you can choose to create it as an entrance or exit to your current location when you use the scroll.

entries.name: Entrance
entries: Three gargantuan tentacles emerge through the gateway, and each immediately strikes out at creatures you designate within 30 feet of the portal's opening. Make an attack roll for each tentacle: {@h} 17 to hit, dealing {@damage 3d6 + 10} bludgeoning damage each.

On a hit, if the target is a Large or smaller creature and that tentacle isn't already grappling a creature, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is also {@condition restrained}.
You can use an action on each of your turns to command three attacks with the tentacles. The portal closes after {@dice 1d4 - 1} rounds, and the tentacles vanish.

entries.name: Exit
entries: You, and any number of creatures within 30 feet that you designate when you use this scroll, can pass through the gateway and emerge at a random, safe location on the Material Plane. When a creature passes through the portal in this way, they gain temporary hit points equal to their level multiplied by their Constitution modifier.
If a creature you didn't designate attempts to pass through the portal, they take {@damage 4d10} lightning damage and fall {@condition prone}.
The portal closes after {@dice 1d4 - 1} rounds.

item.name: Cantrip Cube
entries: This small, magical box contains one random stored cantrip from the following list:

items: {@spell dancing lights}
{@spell druidcraft}
{@spell light}
{@spell minor illusion}
{@spell mold earth}
{@spell Rainfall|DMSecretWeapon}
{@spell prestidigitation}
{@spell thaumaturgy}

entries: Any creature can use a bonus action to activate one effect the held cantrip can produce, or you can set the box to repeat one effect the held cantrip can produce automatically every minute, until you use an action while holding the box to end this effect. If a spell requires {@status concentration}, it lasts for 1 minute.
If the box would force a creature to make a saving throw, the DC for that saving throw is 13.

item.name: Pumpkinhead Cowl
entries: While wearing this cowl, your AC increases by 1, you become immune to the {@condition frightened} condition, and you can see in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.
In addition, while wearing the cowl, you can cast the spell {@spell phantom steed} as a ritual once per dawn, except the duration of the spell increases to 8 hours.

Finally, while wearing the cowl, you can use an action to remove your head from your shoulders and hold it. In this form, you continue to see through your head and can control your body as normal. Your head cannot move on its own, shares your body's AC, has 13 hit points, and remains conscious while your body takes a long rest or is knocked {@condition unconscious}.

If you cast a spell that targets yourself, it targets both your head and your body, even if they are apart. If a spell or ability would change the form of your body, only your body changes, and your head remains the same within the Pumpkinhead Cowl.
If your head is destroyed while separated from your form in the Pumpkinhead Cowl, only the cowl is destroyed, and your head instantly, magically reforms on your body.
You can reattach your head to your form by using an action to hold it to your neck.

item.name: Pendant of Life & Death
entries: This glistening pendant shifts in colour, reflecting how close its wielder strays to the land of the dead. It has 4 charges, and regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges each dawn.

As a bonus action while wearing this pendant, you can expend 1 charge to grant another creature within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. You can use this ability only if your remaining hit points are over half that of your hit point total.

As a bonus action while wearing this pendant, you can expend 1 charge to curse another creature within 60 feet. That creature takes {@damage 1d8} + your Constitution modifier necrotic damage. You can use this ability only if your remaining hit points are below half that of your hit point total.

item.name: Cloak of the Winds
entries: This billowing cloak gives +5 to movement speed and +1 AC while attuned.

entries.name: Hidden Potential
entries: If this cloak is attuned to by a character with a movement speed of 50 feet or above, they gain a flying speed equal to their walking speed and an additional +1 AC.

item.name: Bag of Sleeping Darkness
entries: This item behaves as an ordinary {@item bag of holding}. Attuning to the Bag of Sleeping Darkness does nothing, unless you are of the chaotic evil alignment.

entries.name: Hidden Potential
entries: If this bag is attuned to by a creature with the chaotic evil alignment, it acts as a {@item bag of devouring} if used by anyone other than them.

item.name: Colossal Greatsword
entries: This enormous sword shrinks when attuned to, becoming the appropriate size and weight for the user.
Small characters can wield this weapon as if it didn't have the heavy property.
In addition, melee attacks made with this weapon deal an additional {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Hidden Potential
entries: If this sword is wielded by a creature with a Strength score of 20 or above, it grows to be one size larger, becoming oversized for the user. They are able to wield it without penalty. It gains the reach property, and deals an additional {@damage 1d6} damage on attacks.

item.name: Beast Bomb
entries: As an action you can hurl this glowing red orb up to 30 feet. When it touches the ground, it bursts open and is destroyed, and conjures a fey spirit in the form of a beast. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the table below to determine the beast that appears. If you roll a 6, two spirits appear in that form. The spirit uses that beast's statistics, and vanishes after 24 hours, or when it reaches 0 hit points.

The spirit is friendly to you and your companions, and it acts on your turn. You can use a bonus action to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, or to give it general orders, such as to attack your enemies. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.

item.name: Zombie Bomb
entries: As an action you can hurl this glowing yellow orb up to 30 feet. When it touches the ground, it bursts open and is destroyed, and conjures a fey spirit in the form of an undead. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the table below to determine the undead that appears. If you roll a 6, two spirits appear in that form. The spirit uses that undead's statistics, and vanishes after 24 hours, or when it reaches 0 hit points.

The spirit is friendly to you and your companions, and it acts on your turn. You can use a bonus action to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, or to give it general orders, such as to attack your enemies. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.

item.name: Monstrosity Bomb
entries: As an action you can hurl this glowing purple orb up to 30 feet. When it touches the ground, it bursts open and is destroyed, and conjures a fey spirit in the form of a monstrosity. Roll a {@dice d6} and consult the table below to determine the monstrosity that appears. If you roll a 6, two spirits appear in that form. The spirit uses that monstrosity's statistics, and vanishes after 24 hours, or when it reaches 0 hit points.

The spirit is friendly to you and your companions, and it acts on your turn. You can use a bonus action to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, or to give it general orders, such as to attack your enemies. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.

item.name: Powder of Scrying
entries: This small packet contains {@dice 1d6 + 4} pinches of silver powder.
You can use an action to sprinkle a pinch over a basin of water or a puddle, and cast the spell {@spell scrying} without any other components.
You can use an action to consume one pinch of the silver powder. If you do, you cannot be detected by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors for the next {@dice 1d4} weeks.

item.name: Bracers of Unyielding Fury (+1)
entries: To attune to these bracers, you must rage while wearing them. The bracers then painlessly bind to your flesh, and cannot be parted from you without your consent.
While attuned to the bracers, your unarmed strikes deal {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage and you gain a +1 bonus to your melee attack and damage rolls.
In addition, if you would be killed or reduced to 0 hit points while raging, your rage ends and you fall to 1 hit point instead. This property of the bracers can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Bracers of Unyielding Fury (+2)
entries: To attune to these bracers, you must rage while wearing them. The bracers then painlessly bind to your flesh, and cannot be parted from you without your consent.
While attuned to the bracers, your unarmed strikes deal {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage and you gain a +2 bonus to your melee attack and damage rolls.
In addition, if you would be killed or reduced to 0 hit points while raging, your rage ends and you fall to 1 hit point instead. This property of the bracers can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Bracers of Unyielding Fury (+3)
entries: To attune to these bracers, you must rage while wearing them. The bracers then painlessly bind to your flesh, and cannot be parted from you without your consent.
While attuned to the bracers, your unarmed strikes deal {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage and you gain a +3 bonus to your melee attack and damage rolls.
In addition, if you would be killed or reduced to 0 hit points while raging, your rage ends and you fall to 1 hit point instead. This property of the bracers can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Ring of Fortuity
entries: While attuned to this ring, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

entries.name: Hidden Potential
entries: If you missed an attack since the start of your turn, all your attack rolls score a critical hit on a natural 1.

item.name: Sword of the Final Hour
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls while using this weapon.

entries.name: Hidden Potential
entries: If you have less than 10% of your total hit points, you make attack rolls with this sword with advantage, and it deals an additional {@damage 1d6} damage on a hit.

item.name: Bow of Blasting
entries: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a ranged attack roll using this bow, you can add {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage to the damage roll.

entries.name: Hidden Potential
entries: If you hit a creature within 5 feet of you with a ranged attack roll using this bow, they are also pushed back 20 feet away from you in a straight line.

item.name: Incineration Trident
entries: When you deal damage to a creature with this trident, you can choose to replace the piercing damage with fire damage.

entries.name: Trial
entries: Reduce 20 different, worthy, hostile enemies to 0 hit points with fire damage while attuned to this weapon.

entries.name: Hidden Ability
entries: If you have completed the Incineration Trident's trial, add {@damage 1d6} fire damage to all damage rolls made with this weapon.
In addition, if you throw the weapon or drop it, you can speak a command word to cause it to reappear in your open hand in a flash of flame.

item.name: Gravity GreatAxe
entries: You have advantage on attack rolls made with this weapon against creatures that are at least one size smaller than you.

entries.name: Trial
entries: Shove 10 different, worthy, hostile enemies {@condition prone} while attuned to this weapon.

entries.name: Hidden Ability
entries: If you have completed the Gravity Axe's trial, as a bonus action, you can grow one size larger. This change lasts for the next 10 minutes. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a short rest.
In addition, once per turn, if you hit a creature that's smaller than you with this weapon, they fall {@condition prone}.

item.name: Demon Soul Sword
entries: You have advantage on saving throws to resist the spells and magical effects of fiends.

entries.name: Trial
entries: Reduce 5 hostile demons to 0 hit points while attuned to this weapon.

entries.name: Hidden Ability
entries: If you have completed the Demon Soul Sword's trial, you can use an action to summon one {@creature quasit}. It takes its turn immediately after yours, is friendly to you and your companions, and obeys your commands (no action required from you).
The quasit exists for 10 minutes, or until it is reduced to 0 hit points, or until you drop {@status concentration} (as if concentrating on a spell). After that time, it vanishes.
Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Helm of The Terror Beast
entries: The Helm of The Terror Beast is a large, horned helmet that resizes to fit perfectly around the head of its wearer. It is coarse and rough to the touch.

While wearing the helm, you have advantage on all saving throws to resist magical effects, and have blindsight with a range of 120 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind total cover, even if you're {@condition blinded} or in darkness. Moreover, you can see an {@condition invisible} creature within that range, unless the creature successfully hides from you.

entries.name: Terror Beast Incarnate
entries: If you are attuned to the Helm of The Terror Beast, the {@item Sword of The Terror Beast|DMSecretWeapon}, and the {@item Shield of The Terror Beast|DMSecretWeapon}, you can use an action to summon a {@creature tarrasque}. It appears in an unoccupied space within 120 feet of you.
After you use this feature, the Helm, Sword, and Shield of the Terror Beast lose all their magical power for the next 100 years, functioning as ordinary, non-magical pieces of equipment.

item.name: Sword of The Terror Beast
entries: The Sword of The Terror Beast is a vicious, spiked blade that causes small tremors in the earth when clashing in combat.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, and you can make one additional attack with it when you take the {@action Attack} action. In addition, the Sword of The Terror Beast ignores resistance to slashing damage.
If you hit a creature twice in the same turn with the Sword of The Terror Beast, that creature falls {@condition prone}.

item.name: Shield of The Terror Beast
entries: The Shield of The Terror Beast is a vast, roughly hewn shield that bursts with a titanic roar of sound when struck.

While attuned to this shield, any time you are targeted by a {@spell magic missile} spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 1, the spell targets you as normal. On a 2 to 5, you are unaffected. On a 6, you are unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from you, turning the caster into the target.

item.name: Giant Blood Quill
entries: This quill is fashioned using the blood of a giant.
The Giant Blood Quill can be used when scribing a spell into a wizard's spellbook, or when creating a spell scroll. When it is used in this way, the spell that is scribed gains the following effects:

items: If this spell targets a giant with an attack roll, add {@dice 1d6} to that attack roll.
If this spell forces a giant to make a saving throw, subtract {@dice 1d4} from that saving throw.

entries: Once the Giant Blood Quill has been used to scribe a spell, it loses all magical properties and becomes a normal quill.
At the DM's discretion, other blood quills may exist or be crafted from the blood of different creature types to target them instead.

item.name: Rune of the Mighty
entries: This rune enhances its wearer's Strength. It can appear on a piece of jewellery, an item of clothing, an engraving on a weapon, or as a tattoo.
While wearing the rune, a Small creature with a Strength score of 15 or above can ignore the {@itemProperty H||heavy} property of weapons they wield.

item.name: Rune of the Swift
entries: This rune enhances its wearer's Dexterity. It can appear on a piece of jewellery, an item of clothing, an engraving on a weapon, or as a tattoo.
While wearing the rune, a creature with a Dexterity score of 18 or above can ignore the {@itemProperty L||loading} property of weapons they wield.

item.name: Detonation Potato
entries: A deadly, cursed potato. As an action, a creature can hurl the Detonation Potato in a straight line up to 60 feet, stopping early if it impacts against a solid surface. If the object would strike a creature, that creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the object strikes the target and stops moving, dealing {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage.

When the Detonation Potato hits a target, roll {@dice 1d6}, plus an additional {@dice 1d6} for each time the potato has been thrown since the last dawn. If the result on any die rolled is a 6, the potato explodes, and all creatures in a 15-foot radius must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, or take {@damage 4d8} fire damage.

item.name: Spark Gauntlets
entries: While wearing these gauntlets, you can cast the spell {@spell shocking grasp} as an action, and your first unarmed strike each turn deals an additional {@damage 1d4} lightning damage.

In addition, you can attempt to use the gauntlets to revive a creature that has died within the last minute. By touching the corpse with the gauntlets, you can administer a magical jolt of lightning. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check ({@dc 18}). On a success, the target returns to life with 1 hit point.

The Spark Gauntlets cannot revive a creature who has died of old age, nor can it restore missing body parts. Once this feature of the gauntlets has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Rune of Sight
entries: This rune empowers its wearer's sight. It can appear on a piece of jewellery, an item of clothing, an engraving on a weapon, or as a tattoo.
While wearing the rune, attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
In addition, if you have a Constitution score of 15 or above, the maximum range of your ranged weapons and cantrips increases by 100 feet.

item.name: Rune of Brawn
entries: This rune empowers its wearer's strength. It can appear on a piece of jewellery, an item of clothing, an engraving on a weapon, or as a tattoo.
While wearing the rune, if you have a Strength score of 20 or above, you can wield weapons with the {@itemProperty 2H||two-handed} property in only one hand.

item.name: Mega Mushroom
entries: This seemingly simple mushroom is bursting with transmutation magic. As an action, a creature can ingest the mushroom, doubling its size in all dimensions, and multiplying its weight by eight. This growth increases its size by one category—from Medium to Large, for example. If there isn't enough room for the target to double its size, the creature or object attains the maximum possible size in the space available. The target also has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and any bludgeoning damage it deals to other creatures as a result of falling on them is doubled. The target's clothing and weapons also grow to match its new size. While these weapons are enlarged, the target's attacks with them deal {@damage 1d4} extra damage. These effects last for 1 minute.

While under the effects of a mega mushroom, a creature can use its reaction when dealt damage to reduce that damage to 0. If it does so, the magical effects of the mega mushroom end instantly, and the creature, its clothing, and weapons return to their original size.

item.name: Fire Flower
entries: This spicy plant crackles with evocation magic. As an action, a creature can ingest the flower, gaining the ability to cast the cantrip {@spell fire bolt} as an action and a bonus action for the next minute. Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is the spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you ingest the flower).
While under the effects of a fire flower, a creature can use its reaction when dealt damage to reduce that damage to 0. If it does so, the magical effects of the fire flower end instantly.

item.name: Blue Shell
entries: This magical, flying shell is bursting with evocation magic, and is both feared and revered for its power to equalise the playing field in a one-sided battle. As an action, a creature can hurl this shell into the air, where it spirals and hovers 30 feet above them. On initiative count 20 of the following round, the blue shell dives at blistering speed towards the creature with the current highest hit points within 120 feet of it, detonating on contact. That creature must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d12} force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

item.name: 1-Up Mushroom
entries: This small, green mushroom hums and sings with necromancy magic. As an action, a creature can ingest the mushroom, gaining the power to recover from lethal damage.

The first time that creature would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, they instead roll any number of available Hit Dice, add their Constitution modifier, and drop to that hit point total instead. The effects of the 1-Up Mushroom then end. If the creature is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the effects of the 1-Up Mushroom end.

item.name: Ice Flower
entries: This freezing plant exudes a steady, rising mist that whispers with evocation magic. As an action, a creature can ingest the flower, gaining the ability to cast the cantrip {@spell ray of frost} as an action and a bonus action for the next minute. Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is the spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you ingest the flower).
While under the effects of an ice flower, a creature can choose to use its reaction when dealt damage to reduce that damage to 0. If it does so, the magical effects of the ice flower end instantly.

item.name: Super Star
entries: This tiny, gleaming star radiates incredible abjuration magic. As a bonus action, a creature touching the star can activate its power. The star dissipates into motes of golden light, and that creature gains immunity to all damage and radiates bright light in a 30-foot radius for the next minute.
In addition, the first time on each turn that a creature grapples or otherwise comes into direct contact with a creature empowered by the Super Star, it takes {@damage 6d10} radiant damage.

item.name: Ioun Stone of Speed
entries: An {@i Ioun stone} is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of {@i Ioun stone} exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you use an action to toss one of these stones into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of {@dice 1d3} feet and confers a benefit to you. Thereafter, another creature must use an action to grasp or net the stone to separate it from you, either by making a successful attack roll against AC 24 or a successful {@dc 24} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. You can use an action to seize and stow the stone, ending its effect.
A stone has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage. It is considered to be an object that is being worn while it orbits your head.
Your movement speed increases by 10 feet and you have advantage on initiative rolls while this silver stone rapidly orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone of Resistance (Legendary)
entries: An {@i Ioun stone} is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of {@i Ioun stone} exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you use an action to toss one of these stones into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of {@dice 1d3} feet and confers a benefit to you. Thereafter, another creature must use an action to grasp or net the stone to separate it from you, either by making a successful attack roll against AC 24 or a successful {@dc 24} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. You can use an action to seize and stow the stone, ending its effect.
A stone has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage. It is considered to be an object that is being worn while it orbits your head.

When you fail a saving throw while this stone orbits your head, you can choose to succeed instead. Once this property of the Ioun Stone of Resistance has been used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Ioun Stone of Beastcalling
entries: An {@i Ioun stone} is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of {@i Ioun stone} exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you use an action to toss one of these stones into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of {@dice 1d3} feet and confers a benefit to you. Thereafter, another creature must use an action to grasp or net the stone to separate it from you, either by making a successful attack roll against AC 24 or a successful {@dc 24} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. You can use an action to seize and stow the stone, ending its effect.
A stone has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage. It is considered to be an object that is being worn while it orbits your head.

While this jagged stone orbits your head, you can use an action to conjure a fey spirit in the form of a beast of your choice that is CR 1 or below. The beast is friendly to you and your companions, and obeys your commands. It disappears after 1 hour, or when it falls to 0 hit points. Once this property of the Ioun Stone of Beastcalling has been used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Ioun Stone of Superior Beastcalling
entries: An {@i Ioun stone} is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of {@i Ioun stone} exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you use an action to toss one of these stones into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of {@dice 1d3} feet and confers a benefit to you. Thereafter, another creature must use an action to grasp or net the stone to separate it from you, either by making a successful attack roll against AC 24 or a successful {@dc 24} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. A stone has AC 24, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage. It is considered to be an object that is being worn while it orbits your head.
