entries.caption: Battlefield Effects
rows: All attack rolls that hit are treated as critical hits.
Everyone loses 5 hit points at the start of their turn.
Ranged attack rolls are made with disadvantage.
All player character movement speeds are doubled.
Everyone's size is doubled. Melee attacks deal one additional weapon damage die on a hit.
Enemies can move through walls and objects, but cannot end their turn there.
All players swap characters with the player to their left.
A {@creature commoner||peasant} friendly to the players spawns each round.
All players gain a +2 bonus to AC while within 30 feet of another player character.
Concentrating on a spell requires a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the start of each turn. All conscious creatures take {@damage 2d10} bludgeoning damage at the start of each round.
Once per turn, players can insult an enemy they attack to gain advantage on their first attack roll against that target.
Creatures do not expend resources to use abilities (spell slots, ki, rage, Action Surge, sorcery points). Monsters regain recharge abilities and Legendary Resistances at the start of their turns.

entries.name: Suggested Challenges
entries: Challenges allow the DM to reward players for exceptional combat feats with short- or long-rest resources, spell slots, or boons.

entries.caption: Horde Challenges
rows: Kill four enemy creatures with a single spell.
Inflict three different status conditions on the same creature.
Suffer 5 critical hits in a single game.
Fall to 0 hit points and finish the wave with at least half hit points.
Force a single enemy to make three different types of saving throws.
Take the {@action Dash} action three times in a single turn.
Enter the game with no ability scores above 13.
Deal 3 different types of damage in one turn.
Cause an enemy to take at least {@damage 5d6} falling damage.
Cast {@spell see invisibility}, {@spell find traps}, {@spell true strike}, and {@spell blade ward} in a single game.
Stabilize or revive 3 different players in one game.
Find 6 pieces of loot in a single game.
Legally cast two leveled spells in one turn.
Frighten a creature, charm that creature, and then kill that creature.
Kill four creatures while {@condition prone} in a single wave.
Start a wave on 1 hit point, and finish without gaining hit points or falling unconscious.
Survive three consecutive full waves without taking damage.
Score 6 critical hits in a single game.
Kill the player character who turned into the {@creature Super Zombie|DMSecretWeapon}.
Keep a creature {@condition charmed} under your influence for two full waves.

entries.name: Non-Combat Rounds and Roleplay
entries: Although Horde Mode focuses primarily on combat, non-combat encounters can break up the action:

items: A {@creature gynosphinx} appears with a riddle for the party to solve in place of a battle.
A complex or lethal puzzle room replaces a combat wave.
A quirky traveling merchant visits during short rests, selling items in exchange for loot and coin gathered during previous waves.

variantrule.name: Signature Spellcrafting
entries: Offering players opportunities to craft their own magic gives them agency in their character progression, encourages creativity, and provides Game Masters with material for character-driven quests.

entries.name: What is a Signature Spell?
entries: A signature spell is a spell created by a player character. The player names the spell and describes its effects. Once successfully created, it is added to their spell list, is always prepared, and can be cast using spell slots as normal.
This spell is unique to that character; no other characters, monsters, or NPCs inherently know or can cast it unless taught.

entries.name: Crafting a Signature Spell
entries: Here are the core rules for crafting a signature spell:

items: Full spellcasting classes (Bards, Clerics, Druids, Sorcerers, Warlocks, and Wizards) can create one signature spell upon reaching 5th, 9th, and 15th level in that class.
Half-spellcasting classes (Paladins and Rangers) can create one signature spell upon reaching 9th level in that class.
A signature spell must be crafted at the highest spell level the character can currently cast (e.g., a 5th-level Wizard must craft a 3rd-level spell).
Crafting a spell requires special inks, incense, and components equal to 200 gp per level of the spell.
Crafting requires at least one special, quest-obtained ingredient tailored to the nature of the spell.
Players determine the spell's name, school, damage type, range, area, and visual flavour within the balance guidelines below.
The Game Master has the final say on any spell's balance and mechanics.

entries.name: Part 1: Damage Spells
entries: The baseline damage for a crafted spell depends on whether it targets a single creature via a spell attack roll (at a base range of 30 feet) or an Area of Effect (assumed to be a 20-foot-radius sphere centered within 60 feet, dealing half damage on a successful save).

entries.name: Modifications for Spell Attack Roll Spells

items: {@b Increased Range.} Subtract one damage die for every 30 feet added to the spell's range, up to a maximum of 120 feet.
{@b Decreased Range.} Add two damage dice if the spell has a range of touch.

{@b Multiple Targets.} Subtract damage dice for each target beyond the first: subtract two dice per extra target at 3rd level, three dice at 5th level, and five dice at 8th level. A separate attack roll is made for each target.
{@b Bonus Action Casting.} Reduce total damage dice to ⅓ (rounded down). Apply this reduction last after all other modifications.

{@b Reaction Casting.} For common triggers (e.g., taking damage, an enemy moving out of reach), reduce dice to ⅓ (rounded down). For uncommon triggers (e.g., failing a save, an ally dropping to 0 HP), reduce dice to ½ (rounded down). Apply this reduction last.

{@b Saving Throw Variations.} If replacing the attack roll with a saving throw where a success negates all damage: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom saves keep normal damage. Intelligence or Charisma saves subtract one damage die.
{@b Upcasting.} Add one damage die for each slot level used above the spell's base level.

entries.name: Modifications for Area of Effect (AoE) Spells

items: {@b Increased Range.} Subtract one damage die for every 60 feet added to the casting range, up to a maximum of 300 feet.
{@b Decreased Range.} Add one damage die if the casting range is reduced to 30 feet.
{@b Increased Radius.} Subtract one damage die for every 10 feet added to the radius, up to a maximum radius of 40 feet.
{@b Decreased Radius.} Add one damage die for every 10 feet the radius is reduced, down to a minimum radius of 10 feet.
{@b Saving Throw Type.} Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom saves use standard damage. Intelligence or Charisma saves subtract one damage die.
{@b Bonus Action / Reaction AoE.} Generally restricted. For 8th-level spells, a bonus action AoE may be permitted at ⅓ standard damage (rounded down).
{@b Upcasting.} Add one damage die for each slot level above the base level.

entries.caption: Suggested Special Ingredients
rows: Track down a  {@creature young green dragon} in the Dread Forest to barter with or slay for its venom.
Venture into haunted marshes infested with undead and aberrations to harvest rare algae.
Infiltrate a royal treasury or cure a monarch's afflicted heir to earn a storied gemstone.
Retrieve a relic from the heart of a lethal, trap-filled ruin.
Locate a weeping {@creature gynosphinx} in the desert and answer her riddles to obtain her tears.
Dive into the deep abysses of the Plane of Water to capture fire that burns beneath the sea.
Hunt and defeat an adult or {@creature young black dragon} in its swamp lair.
Perform a planar ritual at the heart of the Material Plane, permanently reducing the caster's maximum HP by {@dice 1d8} + Constitution modifier.
Extract shifting metal from a wandering sea guarded by iron and stone golems.

entries.name: Part 2: Debuff Spells
entries: Debuff spells enforce specific tactical conditions upon targets. All debuff spells adhere to the following defaults unless modified:

items: All debuff spells require {@status concentration}.
All debuff spells have a maximum duration of 1 minute.
All debuff spells have a casting time of 1 action.
All debuff spells have a base range of 90 feet.
The GM has final authority on balance.
{@b Target(s):} Specifies whether the spell affects a single creature or creates a spherical area of effect.
{@b Creature Restriction:} If present, the spell can affect only one specific creature type (chosen when crafting the spell).
{@b Early End Condition:} Additional criteria (such as taking damage) that immediately break the condition.
{@b Initial Save:} Whether targets make an immediate saving throw when the spell is cast.
{@b End of Turn Save:} Whether affected creatures can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns.
{@b Save Type:} "Common" saves are Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom. "Any" includes Intelligence and Charisma.
{@b Lingering AoE:} If marked Yes, the area remains hazardous for the full duration, forcing saves on creatures entering or starting their turn within it.

To add damage to a debuff spell, choose a debuff from a lower spell level. Add {@dice 1d8} damage for each level of difference between the debuff table used and the spell slot level crafted at (e.g., an 8th-level spell using a 5th-level debuff deals {@damage 3d8} damage).
Creatures take the damage whenever they fail an initial or end-of-turn saving throw against the spell.
A successful save negates the damage entirely.
Spells that impose the {@condition charmed}, Dominated, or {@condition petrified} conditions cannot deal damage.

entries.name: Design Example: Elisleo's Spectral Bat Swarm

variantrule.name: Superior Spells
entries: With the SRD likely becoming unavailable soon, it's time to crack out a new rules system that's been a long time coming.

entries.name: Terrible spells
entries: They suck, right? Well, introducing Superior Spells! Here's a rebalancing of weak spells to make them usable in game! The idea isn't to make bad spells "broken" but to make them fun and usable.

Consider swapping these into your games in place of the originals, to allow for players to explore some fun, new ideas that they should have been able to do all along (if the original spells weren't trash). There's a lot of spells that need an upgrade, today's selection focuses on lower level spells for players to enjoy!
Superior Spells offer rebalanced alternatives to underwhelming spells in the core rules, upgrading baseline utility without breaking combat balance.

entries.name: Optional Rule: Upgrading a Spell
entries: At the DM's discretion, characters can quest, spend gold, or study during downtime to permanently upgrade an existing known or prepared spell into its Superior counterpart.
Upgrading a spell typically requires specialized training, research materials, or rare components tailored to the spell's school.

variantrule.name: Potion Brewing
entries: This system offers a straightforward framework for brewing potions, from simple healing salves to lethal concoctions and wondrous enhancements, encouraging characters to harvest components from defeated creatures and forage in dangerous locations.

entries.name: The Basics of Potion Brewing
entries: All potion brewing requires a cauldron, simple ingredients, a magical ingredient, and time. If characters have sufficient materials, they can brew up to six potions simultaneously.

items.name: Simple Ingredients
entries: Common components such as salt, nettles, honey, and vials. These represent the gold cost of brewing and can be readily purchased from merchants.

items.name: Magical Ingredients
entries: Rare biological trophies such as a dragon's tooth, a hippogriff feather, ochre jelly residue, or a gorgon skull. These must be harvested from defeated creatures of the following types: aberration, celestial, dragon, elemental, fey, fiend, giant, monstrosity, ooze, plant, or undead. The strength of the resulting potion is dictated by the Challenge Rating of the source creature.

items.name: Time
entries: Brewing requires boiling the ingredients together in a cauldron without interruption for the full required duration. The brewer must remain attentive throughout the entire process.

items.name: Expiration
entries: Potions retain their potency for a limited duration before losing their magical properties, as detailed on the table below.

entries.name: Healing Potions
entries: Drinking a healing potion or administering it to another creature requires an action.

items.name: Weak
entries: Regain {@dice 2d4 + 2} hit points, or cure one of the following conditions: {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, or {@condition poisoned}.

items.name: Mild
entries: Regain {@dice 4d4 + 4} hit points, or cure one of the following conditions: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition poisoned}.

items.name: Strong
entries: Regain {@dice 8d4 + 8} hit points and cure all of the following conditions: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, and {@condition poisoned}. Alternatively, cure one of the following conditions: {@condition stunned}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition petrified}.

items.name: Very Strong
entries: Restore all hit points and cure all of the following conditions: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, and {@condition poisoned}.
{@b Legendary.} Gain the full benefits of a long rest.

entries.name: Damaging Potions
entries: Damaging potions harm creatures when ingested or introduced via an injury:

items.name: Ingested
entries: A creature must consume an entire dose (often disguised in food or drink). The target must make a Constitution saving throw against the potion's save DC, taking full damage and suffering any rider conditions on a failed save, or taking half damage and no rider on a success.

items.name: Injury
entries: Can be applied to weapons, ammunition, or traps that deal piercing or slashing damage. The coating remains potent for 8 hours or until delivered through a wound or washed off. A target taking piercing or slashing damage from the coated object must make a Constitution saving throw against the potion's save DC, suffering full damage and conditions on a failure, or resisting all effects entirely on a success.

entries.name: Damage Types
entries: The damage type matches any non-physical damage type present in the harvested creature's stat block (e.g., necrotic from a {@creature wraith}). If no special damage type is present, the potion deals poison damage. The brewer chooses the damage type and accompanying condition upon brewing.

items.name: Weak
entries: Takes {@damage 2d8} damage and suffers one of the following conditions for 1 minute: {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, or {@condition poisoned} (save ends at end of turn).

items.name: Mild
entries: Takes {@damage 4d10} damage and suffers one of the following conditions for 1 minute: {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, or {@condition poisoned} (save ends at end of turn).

items.name: Strong
entries: Takes {@damage 6d12} damage and is {@condition stunned} for 1 minute (save ends at start of turn).

items.name: Very Strong
entries: Takes {@damage 8d20} damage and is {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

items.name: Legendary
entries: Takes damage equal to its current hit point total.

entries.name: Optional Rule: Utility Potions
entries: When brewing utility potions, follow the standard rules for healing potions, but replace the restorative effect with one of the following benefits lasting for 1 hour upon consumption:

items: Gain one trait of the GM's choice from the harvested creature.
Gain one damage resistance or damage immunity possessed by the harvested creature.
Replace one ability score with the corresponding ability score of the harvested creature (e.g., brewing from a {@creature young white dragon} to gain Strength 18, Ice Walk, or cold immunity).

variantrule.name: Gambling Mini-Games
entries: These dice-based mini-games can be implemented as tavern games, gambling halls, or downtime diversions.

entries.name: Fireball
entries: {@b Buy-in:} 5 gp per player (any number of participants).
{@b Objective:} Guess how many d6s will roll a 6 when a {@spell fireball} spell is cast.

items: Players roll initiative, then in turn order guess how many d6s will show a 6 when cast at 3rd level ({@dice 8d6}).
Each player may optionally spend an extra 5 gp to "upcast" or "downcast" the spell, adding or subtracting {@dice 1d6} to the pool per modifier.
The DM rolls the modified dice pool.
Players who guessed the exact number of 6s receive 20 gp.
Players who guessed fewer than the actual number receive nothing.
Players who guessed higher than the actual number take {@damage 1d6} fire damage.

entries.name: Golden Rollies
entries: {@b Buy-in:} 20 gp (1 player versus the DM).
{@b Objective:} Roll a d20 and predict whether your result is higher or lower than the DM's hidden roll.

items: The DM rolls {@dice 1d20} behind the screen.
The player rolls {@dice 1d20} openly and declares whether their number is higher or lower than the DM's result.
The player may choose to purchase up to {@dice 3d6} at 10 gp each to modify the DM's total.
The DM rolls any purchased d6s and chooses whether to add or subtract their total from the hidden d20 roll.

The DM reveals their final result. If the player predicted correctly, they recover their bet plus 10 gp, and gain 20 gp for each purchased d6. If incorrect (including ties), the player loses their wager.

entries.name: Stacked Dice
entries: {@b Buy-in:} 10 gp (cooperative game for 4 players).
{@b Objective:} Roll four d20s in sequence such that each roll is strictly higher than the last.

items: The group agrees on their rolling order.
The group shares a single bonus dice pool containing {@dice 1d4}, {@dice 1d6}, and {@dice 1d8}.
Players roll their d20 in order. After rolling, a player may expend any remaining dice from the bonus pool, rolling them to add or subtract from their d20 result.
Each bonus die can be used only once per game.
If all four final values ascend strictly from lowest to highest, the party wins 30 gp; if any value is equal to or lower than the preceding roll, the game ends in defeat.

variantrule.name: PvP D&D
entries: D&D 5e is not inherently balanced for Player vs. Player combat. This rules expansion facilitates sporting, friendly knock-out bouts between players in a tournament structure.

entries.name: PvP D&D: The Core Rules
entries: These rules govern standard 1v1 bouts. The format works well as a round-robin tournament one-shot for 4–5 players.

items: {@b The DM's word is final.} Even if a ruling made in the moment is later discovered to be technically incorrect, the call stands for the match.
{@b Match Structure.} Each combat encounter consists of three bouts, each lasting up to four rounds (a maximum of 12 rounds total).

{@b Between Bouts.} At the end of each bout, 10 minutes of in-game time pass. Players recover from all conditions and can spend and roll Hit Dice to regain hit points. Players cannot cast or concentrate on spells between bouts, though non-concentration effects with durations exceeding 10 minutes (such as {@spell mage armor}) persist.
{@b Knockouts.} If a player drops to 0 hit points, they receive 1 KO point, and the current bout ends immediately.
{@b Elimination.} If a player enters a bout with 0 hit points (due to lacking Hit Dice to heal between bouts), they lose the match.
{@b Victory Condition.} At the end of bout 3, the player with the fewest KO points wins the match.
{@b Ties.} If players have equal KO points at the end of bout 3, the match is a draw, or the DM may call a sudden-death tiebreaker bout.
{@b Character Level.} Player characters are built at 5th level.
{@b Background Restrictions.} Backgrounds that grant feats or extra spells are banned.
{@b Free Feat.} Every player selects one free bonus feat at character creation.
{@b Racial Feat Limitation.} Lineages that grant a free feat at 1st level do not receive a second free feat from rule 8.
{@b Flight and Burrowing.} Unless the arena provides specific terrain or countermeasures for grounded combatants, flying and burrowing speeds cannot be used.
{@b Attributes & HP.} Use Point Buy for ability scores, and take the fixed average hit points for each class level.
{@b Banned Spells.} The following spells are banned: {@spell sleep}, {@spell command}, {@spell suggestion}, and {@spell rope trick}. The DM may ban additional spells deemed unsporting.
{@b Summon Limits.} A character can control only one summoned or conjured creature at a time. Spells that conjure multiple creatures summon only one creature of the highest allowed CR.
{@b Initiative.} Initiative is rolled once at the start of bout 1. The combatant who acts first in bout 1 acts second in bout 2, and first again in bout 3.
{@b No Precasting.} Characters enter the arena with no active spell effects or buffs running.
{@b Starting Distance.} Combatants start {@dice 2d6 * 5|2d6 x 5} feet apart (an average of 35 feet) at the beginning of each bout.
{@b Starting Equipment.} Characters enter with standard starting equipment and mundane gear. Other items require DM approval unless using the Item Chests optional rule.
{@b Battlemaps.} Maps should generally range between 50 and 120 feet square to avoid giving an insurmountable advantage to ranged or melee specialists.
{@b Entrance Music.} A player who prepares custom walkout music gains 1 point of inspiration at the start of bout 1.
{@b Sportsmanship.} Players are expected to maintain good humor, mutual respect, and sporting conduct.
{@b DM Discretion.} The DM may adapt, add, or omit rules as needed, provided all changes are communicated clearly before character creation.

entries.name: Item Chests
entries: Item chests can be scattered across the arena to introduce tactical risk-versus-reward decisions:

items: Opening a chest requires an action while within 5 feet of it.
Items requiring attunement attune immediately to the creature that opens the chest.
Items found in chests cannot be used between bouts and disappear at the end of the match.
Contents are rolled randomly when opened.
Defeating a chest that turns into a {@creature mimic} allows the player to roll three times on the loot table (rerolling results of 10).
Items cannot be looted from an unwilling or unconscious player.

entries.caption: Arena Chest Loot
rows: {@b Boon of +1.} Magically attunes to the player. +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.
{@b Boon of Minor Defense.} Magically attunes to the player. +1 bonus to AC.
{@b Boon of Speed.} Magically attunes to the player. Walking speed increases by 10 feet, and the player ignores difficult terrain.
{@b Eager Potion of Healing.} Can be consumed as a bonus action to regain {@dice 2d4 + 2} hit points.
{@b Universal Scroll of Shield.} Can be cast once as a reaction by any character to cast {@spell shield}.
{@b Universal Scroll of Guiding Bolt.} Can be cast once as an action by any character to cast {@spell guiding bolt} using Constitution as the spellcasting ability.
{@b Boon of Luck.} As a reaction, the player can add {@dice 1d6} to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Can be used twice, after which it vanishes.
{@b Polar Polymorph.} The user immediately casts {@spell polymorph} on themselves, assuming the form of a {@creature polar bear}.
{@b Mimic!} The chest transforms into a {@creature mimic} that immediately {@condition grappled||grapples} the player who opened it.

items: Up to three neutral monsters of CR 1 or lower spawn at initiative count 0 between the players' starting positions.
There can never be more than three NPC monsters active at once.
The creatures act impartially, attacking whichever combatant is closest to them.

entries.name: Hunt the Chicken
entries: An {@creature immortal chicken|DMSecretWeapon} wanders the arena. A player who reduces it to 0 hit points gains 1 point of inspiration, 10 temporary hit points, one roll on the Item Chest table (rerolling 10s), and regains two expended Hit Dice.

entries.name: Battle Royale
entries: When three or more players compete simultaneously:

items: A bout ends only when all combatants except one are reduced to 0 hit points.
Initiative is rolled normally at the start of each bout.
All combatants start equidistant from each other (rolling {@dice 2d6 * 5|2d6 x 5} feet apart).
If players tie after the final bout, they enter a sudden-death duel where the first player knocked to 0 hit points loses.

variantrule.name: Hyper Meta Magic
entries: These unorthodox, fourth-wall-breaking boons interact directly with player behaviors, physical materials, and out-of-game conditions. A GM can grant these directly as character boons or attach them to magic items.

entries.name: Yo Ho Ho!
entries: If any part of your character's subclass, equipment, feats, or spells comes from a supplement that neither you nor a member of your playgroup purchased, and is not public creative commons material, you gain proficiency with navigator's tools, vehicles (water), and the {@skill Intimidation} skill.

entries.name: Gift of Grub
entries: If you brought or prepared food for the entire playgroup for the current session, you begin the session with {@dice 2d10} temporary hit points and gain one Legendary Resistance: once during the session, if you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Weaponised Misfortune
entries: Track each time you roll a natural 1 or natural 20 on a d20. Whenever your running count of natural 1s exceeds your count of natural 20s, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, attack rolls, and saving throws, and advantage on ability checks.

entries.name: A–Z
entries: Choose one half of the alphabet: A–M or N–Z. You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures whose species or monster name begins with a letter from your chosen half. Creatures whose species name begins with a letter from the opposite half have advantage on attack rolls against you.

entries.name: Immersion Is Everything!!
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws while wearing an earnest, character-appropriate costume at the table, subject to GM approval.

entries.name: Grognard
entries: If you have played tabletop RPGs for more than 10 years, you gain the following traits:

items: Advantage on ability checks made to recall lore regarding creatures, spells, or items that appeared in earlier editions of Dungeons & Dragons.
You can take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action, provided it aids a player who has played tabletop RPGs for less than 1 year.
You take 1 psychic damage whenever you state that a game element was better in an earlier edition or another system.

entries.name: Curse of the Over Cautious
entries: Whenever you make an ability check to investigate whether an object is a {@creature mimic}, that object spontaneously transforms into a {@creature mimic}, provided it is nonmagical and not worn or carried.

entries.name: Grammarian Magic
entries: When you cast a spell, you can alter its name by changing a single letter. The spell's effect transforms to reflect its new title at the GM's discretion (e.g., casting "Power Worm Kill" to summon a {@creature purple worm}, or changing {@spell bane} to "Babe" to charm and alter the appearance of a target).

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The mimicule can use its action to polymorph into a tiny object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimicule can choose to adhere to anything that touches it. A Medium or smaller creature adhered to the mimicule is also {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 10}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimicule remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The mimiking can use its action to polymorph into an object or group of connected objects up to gargantuan in size or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimiking adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimiking is also {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 16}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimiking remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimiking has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Amorphous Grappler
entries: The mimiking can grapple up to 12 creatures at a time. If the mimiking is grappling more than one creature, it can make a bite attack as a bonus action, targeting a creature grappled by the mimiking.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the mimiking is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d8 + 6}) piercing damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Come to Life
entries: The mimiking grapples all surprised creatures within 5 ft. of it.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The Owlet has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The Owlbear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The Grizzlowl has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the Grizzlowl fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Grizzlowl makes three attacks: one with its beak and two with its claws.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Chucabyrant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Terror
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5ft of The Chucabyrant must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, or use its action to disengage and move its full movement speed away. Creatures immune to the {@condition frightened} condition are immune to this effect.

trait.name: Poison Fumes
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 15ft of the Chucabyrant, or moves within 15ft of it on their turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or else be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the Chucabyrant's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Chucabyrant makes two attacks, one with its horns and one with its hooves.

action.name: Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) magical piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) magical bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Poison Fumes {@recharge 5}
entries: The Chucabyrant exhales a wave of poison in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 49 ({@damage 11d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures with immunity to poison damage take this damage as though they were resistant to it, not immune.

trait.name: Vicious Hunter
entries: The Zabuccu has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if that creature is not at full hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Zabuccu makes two attacks with its claws:

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezinni has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the hezinni must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezinni's stench for 24 hours.

trait.name: Demonic Ally
entries: A willing hezinni may offer its master or ally a small portion of its own magical essence, granting them immunity to that specific hezinni's Stench ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d1}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrou's stench for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrath has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The hezrath's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the hezrath must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn and fall {@condition prone}. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrath's stench for 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrath makes four attacks: one with its bite and three with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) poison damage on a failed save.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Can't Kill What's Already Dead!
entries: The first time each round the Zombie Pirate would be reduced to 0 hit points, it falls to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Zombie Pirate has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Zombie Pirate's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Zombie Pirate makes two attacks between its Cutlass and Dagger Throw.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger Throw
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Braaaaains
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) piercing damage, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}), and the The Zombie Pirate can't use the Braaaaains attack again for as long as they are grappling that creature.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The spectral pirate captain has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Can't Kill What's Already Dead!
entries: The first time per round the spectral pirate captain would be reduced to 0 hit points, it falls to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Aura of Terror
entries: The spectral pirate captain has advantage on all attack rolls against frightened creatures.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the spectral pirate captain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Spectral Pirate Captain can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes four attacks between its Spectral Cutlass and Spectral Dagger, or uses its Soul Wrench ability.

action.name: Spectral Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) magical piercing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Spectral Dagger
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 6}) magical piercing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Soul Wrench (1/Day)
entries: All frightened creatures within 30 ft. of the Spectral Pirate Captain with more than 1 hit point fall to 1 hit point.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the Spectral Pirate Captain's choice that is within 60 feet of it and is aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the spectral pirate captain's frightful presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Gather the Spirit
entries: The spectral pirate captain regains {@dice 2d8} hit points.

legendary.name: Rebuke the Coward
entries: Any non-undead creatures within 60 ft. of the Spectral Pirate Captain cannot regain hit points until the start of the Spectral Pirate Captain's next turn.

legendary.name: Spectral Assault
entries: The Spectral Pirate Captain makes a Spectral Cutlass or Spectral Dagger attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Old Tom has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Can't Kill What's Already Dead!
entries: The first time per round Old Tom would be reduced to 0 hit points, he falls to 1 hit point instead.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Old Tom fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Old Tom can use his Commanding Presence. He then makes four attacks between his Captain's Cutlass and Captain's Dagger.

action.name: Captain's Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) magical piercing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) force damage.

action.name: Captain's Dagger
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) magical piercing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) force damage.

action.name: Curse ye, landlubbers! (1/Day)
entries: All non-undead creatures within 40 ft. of Old Tom fall {@condition prone} and have their movement speed reduced to zero until the end of Old Tom's next turn.

action.name: Commanding Presence
entries: Each creature of Old Tom's choice that is within 60 feet of him and is aware of him must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by him for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, or when it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Old Tom's commanding presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Gather the Spirit
entries: Old Tom regains {@dice 2d8} hit points.

legendary.name: Spectral Assault
entries: Old Tom makes a Captain's Cutlass or Captain's Dagger attack.

legendary.name: Turn, ye traitors! (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Any creatures {@condition charmed} by Old Tom use their reaction to move up to their movement speed and make a melee weapon attack against any creature of Tom's choice within range.

trait.name: Lightning Glow
entries: The serparvus charges itself with power and radiates a glow of vivid blue light. It shines bright light in a 20 ft. radius and dim light for a further 20 ft.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d1 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shock {@recharge 6}
entries: The serparvus deals 2 ({@damage 1d4}) lightning damage to any creature it is making contact with. This jolt can serve to jumpstart the mind and nervous system. Any creature hit by the serparvus' Shock while suffering the {@condition charmed}, {@condition stunned}, or {@condition paralyzed} condition immediately makes a Wisdom ({@condition charmed}) or Constitution ({@condition stunned} or {@condition paralyzed}) saving throw with advantage to resist that condition, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fulgir makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage. The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) if the fulgir isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is {@condition restrained} until this grapple ends.

action.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge 6}
entries: The fulgir exhales a line of lightning that is 15 ft. long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The behir makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) slashing damage. The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if the behir isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is {@condition restrained} until this grapple ends.

action.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 ft. long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 ({@damage 12d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 ft. of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Chronoabsurdity (2/Day)
entries: If the Iratasaur is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw, the chronomancy magic surrounding it bursts forth in a chaotic explosion. A fragment of time is undone. Reroll the attack roll or saving throw and use the new result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Iratasaur makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Leaping Jaws
entries: The Iratasaur jumps and attempts to attack a creature in the air. It leaps up to 40 ft. high and makes a single bite attack against a target. If the attack hits, the target is also knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The terraraptor has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the terraraptor's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The terraraptor makes three attacks, one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sphitten has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

trait.name: Hallowed Guide
entries: If the sphitten takes the help action to grant advantage on a skill check or attack roll, the creature it is helping can add the sphitten's proficiency modifier to the roll.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) magical slashing damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the felisphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The felisphinx has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The felisphinx makes two attacks between its claws and its lesser magic surge.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) magical slashing damage.

action.name: Lesser Magic Surge
entries: A surge of magic blasts from the felisphinx into the mind of a creature within 120 ft. of it. That creature must make an Intelligence saving throw ({@dc 16}), taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic, 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force, and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the abyssphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abyssphinx has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

trait.name: Plenty of Time to Kill
entries: The abyssphinx can take a reaction once per turn, rather than once per round.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abyssphinx makes two attacks between its claws and its lesser magic surge.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) magical slashing damage.

action.name: Lesser Magic Surge
entries: A surge of magic blasts from the sphinx into the mind of a creature within 120 ft. of it. That creature must make an Intelligence saving throw ({@dc 18}), taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic, 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force, and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

action.name: Greater Magic Surge (3/Day)
entries: The abyssphinx chooses up to 10 creatures it can see within 120 ft. of itself. They must make a Charisma saving throw ({@dc 18}), being subjected to one of the following effects (the abyssphinx chooses) on a failed save:

items: They take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) force damage and cannot make any attack rolls with advantage for the next minute.
They take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) radiant damage and cannot concentrate on spells for the next minute.
They take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) necrotic damage and cannot take reactions for the next minute.

reaction.name: Abyssal Cry
entries: When the abyssphinx is hit by an attack, it can use its reaction to deal 21 ({@damage 2d20}) thunder damage to all creatures within 15 ft. of it.

trait.name: Opportunist
entries: If the smoke bandit makes a weapon attack at advantage, they deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage on a hit. This ability triggers only once each turn.

bonus.name: Smoke Pellet
entries: The bandit detonates a smoke pellet at their feet, releasing a 5-foot cube of thick black smoke. That area becomes heavily obscured for the next minute, unless a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The smoke bandit makes two shortsword attacks or two Light Crossbow attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Smoke Bomb (1/Day)
entries: The smoke bandit hurls a poisonous smoke bomb at a point within 30 ft. It detonates upon striking an object or creature, exploding in a cloud of poisonous fumes. All creatures within a 20-foot radius of where it detonated must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. They take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) poison damage and are {@condition poisoned} on a failed save, or half as much damage and are not {@condition poisoned} on a successful one.

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The necro-planetar's weapon attacks are magical. When the planetar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage (ghost form) or 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage (zombie form). This damage is included in the attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The planetar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: (Ghost Form Only) Incorporeal Movement
entries: The necro-planetar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. When it moves through another creature's space for the first time each turn, that creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage.

trait.name: (Zombie Form Only) Relentless Undead
entries: The necro-planetar regenerates {@dice 3d10} hit points at the start of each of its turns unless it was dealt radiant or fire damage since the start of its last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The necro-planetar makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Necrosword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant or poison damage.

action.name: (Ghost Form Only) Ghastly Cry (1/Day)
entries: Each non-allied creature within 30 ft. of the necro-planetar must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or else take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage and become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on itself on a success.

action.name: (Zombie Form Only) Carcass Stench (1/Day)
entries: Each non-allied creature within 30 ft. of the necro-planetar must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or else take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) poison damage and become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition poisoned} condition on itself on a success.

hp.special: 10 + your Charisma modifier + 5 times your rogue level

trait.name: A Wise Guy, Eh?
entries: The Thug has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with a higher Intelligence score than they have.

action.name: Give 'Em One of These
entries: {@atk mw} your attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3 + PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: A Knife to a Fist Fight
entries: {@atk rw} your attack modifier to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4 + 4 + PB} piercing damage.

reaction.name: Sucker Punch
entries: The Thug makes a Give 'Em One of These attack at advantage immediately after a creature within range makes an attack against any target other than the Thug.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The hydroa can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Loud Cry (1/Day)
entries: If the hydroa takes damage but does not fall to 0 hit points, it lets out a piercing cry. If it is within 30 ft. of a body of water, two more hydroa emerge from the water and join it in battle.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.
Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Endless Heads
entries: The whydra has incalculable heads. It is immune to the {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, and {@condition stunned} conditions. It can hold its breath indefinitely and cannot be knocked {@condition unconscious}. Due to the weight of its endless heads, the whydra cannot move of its own accord.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: The whydra can take any number of opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Blessing of Hammurabi
entries: The whydra cannot be damaged or affected by any creature more than 10 ft. away from it. It is immune to any spell or other magical effect created by a creature for as long as that creature is more than 10 ft. away.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the whydra fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magical Resistance
entries: The whydra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Colossal Tangle
entries: The whydra is a frenzied mass of ever biting heads. Due to its immense size and lack of precision, whenever it attacks a creature and misses, that creature must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw (they can choose to fail) or else be knocked 30 ft. away from the whydra, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and falling {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The whydra can make any number of bite attacks a turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d10 + 9}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Always On Guard
entries: The whydra can make a single bite attack as a reaction whenever another creature moves or appears within 20 ft. of it.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The mechanical spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Limited Nanite Regeneration
entries: When the mechanical spider is reduced to 0 hit points, self-contained nanomachines automatically repair some of the damage, returning it to 1 hit point instead. This feature can only be used once per day.

action.name: Foreleg
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Synthetic Web {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a {@dc 12} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Enigmatic Origin
entries: The Invader's speech is impossible to decipher even with the use of magic. Its equipment is beyond the understanding of anyone of this world and cannot be used by them.

trait.name: Disintegration Ray
entries: Any creature that is reduced to 0 hit points by the Invader's Raygun is instantly killed and reduced to a pile of ash.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Invader fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Invader makes two Raygun attacks.

action.name: Raygun
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60/180 ft., 1 target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) fire damage.

action.name: OVERCHARGE {@recharge 5}
entries: The Invader fires a beam in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide from its Raygun. All creatures in the line must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw taking 22 ({@damage 5d8}) fire damage on a failed save and half as much on a successful one.

legendary.name: Holograms! (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Invader creates 2 Hologram copies of itself which appear in two unoccupied spaces it can see within 30 ft. They have a walking speed of 30 ft., AC 10, and disappear if they are dealt any damage or are more than 30 ft. from The Invader at the start of its turn. When the invader attacks, all the holograms attack simultaneously, targeting the same creature (the holograms do no damage).

legendary.name: Hologram Swap
entries: The Invader can switch places with one of its holograms. This switch is not discernible to other creatures.

trait.name: Necrotic Touch
entries: When the necrotic elemental hits a creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until the target completes a long rest or is removed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or other magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two touch attacks.

action.name: Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Necroshade {@recharge 4}
entries: Each creature within 10 ft. of the elemental must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) necrotic damage and is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Psychic Aura
entries: Any creature who targets the elemental with an attack or harmful spell must first make a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This ability doesn't protect the elemental from area effects, such as the explosion of a {@spell fireball}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two beam attacks.

action.name: Beam
entries: The psychic elemental shoots a beam at a creature it can see within 60 ft. of it. That target makes a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) psychic damage on a failed save.

action.name: Apathy Blast {@recharge 4}
entries: Each creature within 10 ft. of the elemental must make a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, they forget the elemental exists, it becomes {@condition invisible} to them, and the concept of its existence cannot form in their mind. This effect ends if the elemental attacks that creature, or they take damage.

trait.name: Radiant Blast
entries: Whenever the elemental is damaged by an attack or harmful spell, all creatures of the elemental's choice within 15 ft. of it must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Glow {@recharge 4}
entries: A 10-ft. radius, 40 ft. high beam of light shines down on a point of the elemental's choice within 60 ft. of it. Each creature in the light regains 9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) hit points. If a creature at full hit points would gain the benefit of this effect, they regain 9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) temporary hit points instead.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the Undead guard to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the Undead guard drops to 1 hit point instead. This ability can only be used once per long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The undead guard makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The skeleton giant doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the skeleton giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeleton makes two greataxe attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with its Enervating Stare.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Enervating Stare
entries: The skeleton targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) necrotic damage.

monster.name: Poison Mummy
languages: the languages it knew in life

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The poison mummy uses its Poison Blast and then makes one attack with its Rotting Fist.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 ({@damage 3d6}) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the {@spell remove curse} spell or other magic.

action.name: Poison Blast
entries: The mummy targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. A jet of poisonous bile shoots towards the creature. It must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw against the blast or become {@condition poisoned} until the end of the poison mummy's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it also takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The High Priestess' innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The High Priestess has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The High Priestess makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its shortsword.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The wormling can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 1-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wormling makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage. The target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking the poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Kraken Hatchling
languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The kraken can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken makes three attacks between its tentacles and lightning shock.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The Kraken Hatchling has 10 tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Lightning Shock
entries: The Kraken Hatchling magically charges a burst of lightning through its body. All creatures it is touching must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Creatures submerged in water make this save at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Blood Demon makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of its Vomit Blood ability.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage.

action.name: Vomit Blood {@recharge 5}
entries: The Blood Demon vomits acidic blood in a 30-foot line 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage or half as much damage on a successful save.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Abyssal Weapons
entries: Xer'Gaal's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage on a hit (included in the attacks).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Xer'Gaal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

bonus.name: Incorporeal Form
entries: Xer'Gaal turns {@condition invisible} and incorporeal until the start of its next turn. In this form, it resists all damage except force and radiant damage, and can move through creatures and objects as though they were difficult terrain. It takes {@damage 1d10} force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Once Xer'Gaal uses this feature, it cannot do so again until it reduces another creature to 0 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Xer'Gaal makes three attacks.

action.name: Longsword +2
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Blood Storm {@recharge 5}
entries: Xer'Gaal conjures a storm of blood to rain in a 20-foot-radius sphere centred on a point Xer'Gaal can see within 120 feet of it. The sphere remains for 1 minute or until Xer'Gaal loses {@status concentration} (as if concentrating on a spell), and its area is lightly obscured and difficult terrain.

Any creature that moves into the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) acid damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Any corpses caught in the area are turned into Blood Demons.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Xer'Gaal adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Xer'Gaal must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

legendary.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Xer'Gaal makes a longsword attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Xer'Gaal moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Tarrasque Pup has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Hardened Carapace
entries: The tarrasque pup takes half damage from any {@spell magic missile} spell, line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The tarrasque pup deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Titanic Growth
entries: Over the course of an uninterrupted long rest, the tarrasque pup grows into a {@creature Tarrasque}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarrasque pup makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tarrasque pup can't bite another target.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Swallow
entries: If the tarrasque pup hits a bite attack against a small or tiny creature it is grappling, the target takes the bite's damage, is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attack and other effects outside the tarrasque pup, and it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque pup's turns.

If the tarrasque pup takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque pup must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque pup. If the tarrasque pup dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 ft. of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

entries: Vesper makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: Vesper swings their sword in a wide arc, sending forth a blast of radiant energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 8d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede The Boss's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The Boss has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If The Boss fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

bonus.name: Lashing Command
entries: The Boss targets one creature within 90 feet that is {@condition charmed} by her with a telepathic command. That creature uses its reaction to move up to its movement speed and make a single melee attack against a creature of The Boss's choice.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Boss's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}). The Boss can cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Boss makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her tail.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by The Boss until the end of their next turn. Once a creature succeeds on this saving throw, they are immune to The Boss's charm effects for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 6}) slashing damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Adamantine Infused Weaponry
entries: The ammunition and weapons used by the soldiers of Eisenholz are made from a mixture of iron and adamantine. Weapon attack rolls made by the Eisenholz Soldier count as magical for the purposes of overcoming damage resistance, and score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.

action.name: Bayonet
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Arquebus
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The nightclaw's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Feline Reflexes
entries: If a spell or effect allows the nightclaw to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

bonus.name: Shimmerstep
entries: The nightclaw teleports 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightclaw makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The hart of the forest's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hart of the forest has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sovereign of Beasts
entries: The hart of the forest can comprehend and communicate with any Beast, even if the Beast knows no languages.

trait.name: Water Walk
entries: The hart of the forest can choose to walk on water as if it were solid ground.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the hart of the forest fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hart of the forest casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hart of the forest makes two attacks: one with its gore and one with its hooves.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Call of the Wild {@recharge 6}
entries: The hart of the forest summons one {@creature Nightclaw|DMSecretWeapon} with a mighty bellow that reverberates throughout the forest.

trait.name: Adamantine Infused Weaponry
entries: The ammunition and weapons used by the soldiers of Eisenholz are made from a mixture of iron and adamantine. Weapon attack rolls made by Thomas Smile count as magical for the purposes of overcoming damage resistance, and score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Thomas makes two attacks between his Rapier and Arquebus.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Arquebus
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Chaos Magic Burst
entries: Roll on the Chaos Magic Burst table. Thomas teleports up to 15 feet, and then casts that spell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Pigeon Boy Bandit has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the bandit's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bandit makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Opportunist
entries: If a creature within 5 feet of Hank attacks a creature other than him, Hank can use his reaction to make one melee attack against that creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hank makes two attacks between his Disarming Slash and Speed Barrel Shot.
