action.name: Disarming Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is holding a weapon or object, they must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or drop that weapon or object.

action.name: Speed Barrel Shot
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the Brigand hits with it (included in the attack).

bonus.name: Blow The Man Down
entries: After the brigand takes the Attack action, they can take the Shove action as a bonus action against a creature they attacked this turn.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage in melee or 5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage at range.

trait.name: Rum Resistance
entries: Pirate King Maukle resists bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage, and has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Maukle makes three attacks.

action.name: Heavy Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target creature is grappled by Maukle, they take an additional {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hook Chain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet closer to Maukle, and be {@condition grappled} by him until the end of this turn. If Maukle is grappling a creature in this way, he cannot use his Hook Chain again.

trait.name: Immortal
entries: When the immortal chicken is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not fall unconscious. Instead, it regains 30 hit points and teleports to a random, unoccupied space within 30 feet.

action.name: Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ravenbeast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Black Feather Fury
entries: If a creature makes a spell attack against the ravenbeast, that creature takes {@damage 1d10} psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ravenbeast makes one bite attack and two talon attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Feathershot
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 50/150 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

monster.name: Nyxarath the Winged Evil
languages: understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede Nyxarath's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Nyxarath has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Nyxarath's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Nyxarath makes three melee attacks: one with its bite and two with its scythe.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) piercing damage, and if that target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) poison damage.

action.name: Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Pitched Screech {@recharge 6}
entries: Creatures within 30 ft. of Nyxarath must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of their next turn. A {@condition deafened} creature is immune to this effect.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The elemental can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Frosty
entries: A creature that hits the elemental with a melee attack takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage and has its movement speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Snow Slam attacks.

action.name: Snow Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Snow Storm {@recharge 5}
entries: The elemental conjures an icy tempest that blasts forth in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If Rudolf moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, Rudolf can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Rudolf fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Narrative Importance
entries: Attacks and effects that would kill Rudolf reduce him to 1 hit point instead. While Rudolf has 1 hit point, he is placated and will not harm other creatures.

bonus.name: Dashing Through The Snow {@recharge 6}
entries: Rudolf takes the Dash action, and its movement does not provoke opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Rudolf uses his Nose So Bright action, and then makes one Gore attack.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Nose So Bright
entries: Rudolf's blood-red nose bursts with dazzling, crimson light. Creatures within 30 feet of him must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Blizzard Wizard
entries: Jack Frost is surrounded by a raging blizzard. The area within 30 feet of him is difficult terrain for creatures lacking the Ice Walk trait, and ranged attack rolls that target Jack Frost are made at disadvantage. Jack Frost can suppress this blizzard as an action if he chooses.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: Jack Frost can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost him extra movement.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Jack Frost fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jack Frost rolls {@dice 1d4}. He makes that many Icicle Spear attacks.

action.name: Icicle Spear
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

action.name: It's Ice To Beat You! (1/Day)
entries: Jack Frost summons a Frost Elemental, which appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of him.

action.name: Oh, Hail No! {@recharge 6}
entries: A torrent of hail falls in a 30-foot-tall cylinder with a 30-foot radius at a point within 120 feet of Jack Frost. Exposed flames in the area are doused. Creatures within the area make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Ice Don't Think So! (3/Day)
entries: Jack Frost attempts to interrupt a creature he can see within 60 feet in the process of casting a spell. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) cold damage and be unable to cast spells until the start of its next turn. If a spell slot was used to cast the spell, the spell slot is not expended. If the creature used an action to attempt to cast a spell, it can use that action to attempt something else, instead.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Sense
entries: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The colossal spider makes one bite attack and one web attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage and becoming {@condition poisoned} for the next minute on a failed save, or taking half as much damage and not becoming {@condition poisoned} on a successful one.

action.name: Web
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60/120 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition restrained} by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a {@dc 13} Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 15; hp 10; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the ice hound moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with an attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The ice hound has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ice hound makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Icy Howl {@recharge 5}
entries: The ice hound lets loose a chilling howl infused with freezing magic. Creatures within 30 feet of the ice hound that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) cold damage and be {@condition frightened} of the ice hound until the end of its next turn. In addition, allied creatures within 30 feet of the ice hound that are immune to cold damage gain 16 ({@damage 3d10}) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The trick sparrow doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

bonus.name: Tricky Swap {@recharge 4}
entries: The trick sparrow magically swaps places with one of its duplicates.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The trick sparrow uses its Duplicate action, and then makes two Beak attacks.

action.name: Duplicate
entries: The trick sparrow conjures an illusory duplicate of itself at a point within 30 feet of it. The duplicate mirrors the sparrow's movements, but is completely intangible. It has an AC of 17, and vanishes if it is hit with an attack roll.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the elephant demon's darkvision.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The elephant demon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The elephant demon's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the elephant demon moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the elephant demon can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Trumpeting Bellow {@recharge 6}
entries: The elephant demon lets loose a deafening bellow. Creatures within 30 feet of it who can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition deafened} and {@condition stunned} until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elephant demon makes one gore attack and one greataxe attack.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d12 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Elemental Adaptation
entries: After the Gigan Scythemaw takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, it gains resistance to that damage type and its Belch action deals an additional {@damage 1d12} of that damage type. These changes last until the gigan scythemaw finishes a long rest.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the gigan scythemaw fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gigan scythemaw makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 2d12 + 10}) piercing damage, plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) slashing damage.

action.name: Belch {@recharge 6}
entries: The gigan scythemaw lets out a thunderous belch, releasing a hideous fume of carrion and decay in a 60-foot cone. Creatures in that cone must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 52 ({@damage 8d12}) poison damage, plus {@damage 1d12} of any damage types the gigan scythemaw has absorbed via its Elemental Adaptation trait. A creature who fails this save by 5 or more also falls {@condition prone}, wretching, as they are overcome by the stench. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The celestial spirit's weapon attacks are magical. When the celestial hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Divine Burst
entries: If the celestial scores a critical hit with a weapon attack, the target of its attack is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The celestial spirit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The celestial spirit makes two longsword attacks.

action.name: Holy Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) radiant damage.

reaction.name: Healing Authority
entries: When a creature the celestial spirit can see within 30 feet of it casts a spell that restores hit points to a creature, the celestial spirit can use a reaction to capture that magic for itself. The spellcaster must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or the spell fails, and the celestial spirit regains hit points equal to 5 × the failed spell's level.

trait.name: Ice Brand
entries: General Blanka's weapon attacks deal an additional {@damage 2d6} cold damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Ice Shield
entries: A creature that hits General Blanka with a melee attack takes {@damage 2d6} cold damage. This trait is suppressed if General Blanka took fire damage since the end of his last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Blanka makes two greatsword attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Imperious Command (3/Day)
entries: Blanka casts the {@spell command} spell (spell save {@dc 13}), targeting up to three creatures. He uses the command word "drop" or "approach", either forcing targets to fall {@condition prone} or use their turn to move as close as they can to him.

trait.name: Raging Attacker
entries: Gilgard has advantage on attack rolls and Athletics checks, and attack rolls have advantage against him.

bonus.name: Sheer Force
entries: Gilgard barrels into a creature within 5 feet of him. That creature makes an Athletics or Acrobatics check (their choice) contested against Gilgard's Athletics check. Whoever loses the contest falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gilgard makes two flame-tongue rapier attacks.

action.name: Flame-Tongue Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Brave
entries: The gladiator has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Brute
entries: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gladiator hits with it (included in the attack).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gladiator makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the gladiator must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 ({@damage 18d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Vanishing
entries: The dragon turns {@condition invisible} until the start of its next turn, or until it uses another legendary action.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The whale can't use its blindsight while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The whale doesn't need to eat, sleep, or breathe.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The whale has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

bonus.name: Ethereal Form (3/Day)
entries: The whale turns incorporeal until the start of its next turn. It can move through creatures and objects as though they were difficult terrain, but cannot end its turn in another creature's space. The first time it moves through another creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 5d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Kismet can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Kismet fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kismet makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage, plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Dart
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Half-Life (3/Day)
entries: A pulse of green light flows from The Sea Queen's Tears, through Kismet, and streaks towards a creature he can see within 30 feet of him. That creature makes a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, its hit point total is reduced to half its current value (rounded down). If this reduction of a creature's hit point total causes it to lose hit points, Kismet gains temporary hit points equal to the amount the creature lost.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons:

items.name: Fire Breath
entries: The dragon exhales fire in a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Freezing Breath
entries: The dragon exhales an icy cloud in a 10-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Golden Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: If the Golden Golem was awakened by an offering of magic, it can use a bonus action to cast the following spells once each: {@spell blur}, {@spell enlarge/reduce}, {@spell mirror image}.

trait.name: Necrotic Blows
entries: If the Golden Golem was awakened by an offering of blood, it deals an additional {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage with its weapon attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Golden Golem makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 50/100 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 8d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the abyssphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abyssphinx has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

trait.name: Plenty of Time to Kill
entries: The abyssphinx can take a reaction once per turn, rather than once per round.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abyssphinx makes two attacks between its claws and its lesser magic surge.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) magical slashing damage.

action.name: Lesser Magic Surge
entries: A surge of magic blasts from the sphinx into the mind of a creature within 120 ft. of it. That creature must make an Intelligence saving throw ({@dc 18}), taking 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic, 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force, and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

action.name: Greater Magic Surge (3/Day)
entries: The abyssphinx lets loose a chaotic surge of greater magic. It chooses up to 10 creatures it can see within 120 ft. of itself. Roll on the Greater Magic Surge table to determine the effect of the surge. The targets must make a Charisma saving throw ({@dc 18}), being subjected to the effect of the greater magic surge on a failed save:

entries.caption: Greater Magic Surge
rows: The target takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) force damage and cannot make any attack rolls with advantage for the next minute.
The target takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage and cannot concentrate on spells for the next minute.
The target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) necrotic damage and cannot take reactions for the next minute.

reaction.name: Abyssal Cry
entries: When the abyssphinx is hit by an attack roll, it can use its reaction to deal 5 ({@damage 1d10}) thunder damage to all creatures within 15 ft. of it.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the goldwyrm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The goldwyrm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

trait.name: Molten Metal
entries: Creatures that start their turn within 10 feet of the goldwyrm take {@damage 1d10} fire damage. The first time on a turn a creature touches the goldwyrm or hits it with a melee weapon attack, that creature takes {@damage 1d10} fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Goldwyrm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage, plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Vomit Gold {@recharge 6}
entries: The goldwyrm vomits a bubbling, scalding river of pure molten gold in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 ({@damage 12d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this effect is fully encased in gold, has full cover from everything outside its golden casing, and has disadvantage on death saving throws. A creature can use an action to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to shatter this gold casing, freeing the creature inside.

trait.name: Shadow Steps
entries: Opportunity attacks made against the voidling have disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The voidling makes two attacks with its Necrotic Touch. It can forgo one Necrotic Touch attack to use its Shadow Puppet instead.

action.name: Necrotic Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shadow Puppet
entries: A phantom, shadowy monstrosity rises in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the voidling, strikes at a creature within 10 feet of it, and dissipates into nothingness. The creature it strikes at must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage on a failed save.

trait.name: Grip Of The Watchtower Guardian
entries: The angel has advantage on attack rolls against creatures it is grappling.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the angel fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel uses its Grasping Hands, and then makes four attacks between its Crush, Fling, and Divine Bolt. It can only use its Crush attack once per creature it is grappling each turn.

action.name: Grasping Hands
entries: Numerous stone hands burst from the earth and attempt to grapple all creatures within 120 feet of the angel. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the creature is Large or smaller, it is also {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target the angel is grappling. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Divine Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 19} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) radiant damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is {@condition petrified} until the angel falls to 0 hit points.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller object held or creature {@condition grappled} by the angel is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction, where it lands {@condition prone}. When it lands, it takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Ensnare
entries: The plant pod uses its animated vines to attempt to ensnare a Medium or smaller creature within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). The plant pod can grapple up to two creatures at a time.

action.name: Devour
entries: The plant pod moves one creature it is grappling to within 5 feet of it, and attempts to devour the target. That creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be encased inside the plant pod. The plant pod can only have one creature encased at a time. While encased in the plant pod, a creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and the plant pod regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.
If the plant pod takes 9 or more damage in a single turn or dies, any creature it has encased is jettisoned, landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the plant pod.

trait.name: Stinging Strike
entries: When the necrotic shrub makes an attack, if it rolls the highest number on any dice rolled as part of the damage roll, the target of that attack falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Thorn Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Poison Pollen Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: The necrotic shrub exudes a foul burst of pollen. Creatures within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d12}) poison damage and become {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition poisoned} condition on a success.

resist.note: from non-magical attacks not made with silvered weapons

trait.name: Cursed Strike
entries: When the kobold skeleton scores a critical hit on an attack roll, the target becomes {@condition frightened} of the kobold skeleton until the end of the skeleton's next turn.

trait.name: Spook Tactics
entries: The kobold skeleton has advantage on attack rolls against {@condition frightened} creatures.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kobold skeleton loses its resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-magical attacks not made with silvered weapons.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

immune.note: from non-magical attacks not made with silvered weapons

trait.name: Spook Tactics
entries: The dead dragon wyrmling has advantage on attack rolls against {@condition frightened} creatures.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Terrorizing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a psychoactive, toxic fume in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage and becomes {@condition frightened} of the dead dragon wyrmling until the end of the wyrmling's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The construct has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magical Detonator
entries: When the construct falls to 0 hit points, it can choose to burst into fragments of magical energy. If it does so, each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = your spell save DC) or take {@damage (PB)d10} fire damage.

bonus.name: Overclock (PB/Long Rest)
entries: The clockwork companion can take an additional action this turn, and takes {@damage (PB)d4} fire damage at the end of this turn.

action.name: Piston Driver
entries: {@atk rw} your spell attack modifier to hit, range 30 ft., one target you can see. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + PB} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Specialised Assistance (PB/Long Rest)
entries: The companion takes the {@action Help} action, and the creature it helps can also add your Proficiency Bonus to its attack roll or ability check.

monster.name: Blink Dog
languages: understands Sylvan but can't speak it

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Teleport {@recharge 4}
entries: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guard makes two attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ragna makes two attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Ragna adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monster.name: Vengeful Amalgam

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages its component creatures did in life but cannot speak

trait.name: Burning Vengeance
entries: The amalgam is possessed with a furious, unquenchable hatred for its creator. It is immune to effects that would dominate its mind or alter its mood, and it has advantage on attack rolls against the creature(s) who created it.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The amalgam is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Forged in Flame
entries: If the amalgam took fire damage since the end of its last turn, it can make one Slam attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Many Brains
entries: The amalgam has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The amalgam makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Armistician's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

trait.name: Burning Weapons
entries: Armistician's weapon attacks are magical. When he hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Armistician has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Armistician makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage.

action.name: Fallen One's Touch (3/Day)
entries: Armistician touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 ({@damage 4d8 + 2}) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness if its alignment is good or neutral. If its alignment is evil, it instead takes 20 ({@damage 4d8 + 2}) radiant damage.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede Pergozal's darkvision.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Pergozal fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Pergozal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Pergozal makes three melee attacks: two with his Fork and one with his Tail. He can use Hurl Flame in place of any melee attack.

action.name: Fork
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose 10 ({@damage 3d6}) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time Pergozal hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 10 ({@damage 3d6}). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

reaction.name: Infernal Contract (3/Day)
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of Pergozal casts a spell, he can seal that spell in an Infernal Contract. The initial spell proceeds as normal, but that spell cannot be cast again within 120 feet of Pergozal for the next 616 days.

trait.name: Artillerist Tactics
entries: Being {@condition prone} does not impose disadvantage on the kobold squad artillerists' attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kobold squad makes two Artillery attacks. If the squad has 9 hit points or fewer, they make only one Artillery attack instead.

action.name: Artillery
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 40/80 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) fire damage. If the kobolds roll a 6 on their damage die, the target is also {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Cavalry Tactics
entries: The kobold squad cavalry doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when moving out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kobold squad makes two Slam attacks. If the squad has 9 hit points or fewer, they make only one Slam attack instead.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the kobolds roll an 8 on their damage die, the target falls {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Skirmisher Tactics
entries: The kobold squad skirmishers have advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold squad's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kobold squad makes two Slash attacks. If the squad has 9 hit points or fewer, they make only one Slash attack instead.

action.name: Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage. If the kobolds roll an 8 on their damage die, the target's speed falls to 0 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Gnomish Cunning
entries: Nylus has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

trait.name: Leadership
entries: Allied creatures within 5 feet of Nylus have advantage on attack rolls.

trait.name: Satchel of Spear Holding
entries: Nylus carries 100 spears in his small, unassuming satchel.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Nylus makes three attacks: one with his beard and two with his spear.

action.name: Beard
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target can't regain hit points. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Coven Acolyte is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit +4} to hit with spell attacks). The acolyte has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger (Melee)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger (Ranged)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +2} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one creature. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Coven's Might
entries: The Coven Elder has a bonus to all saving throws equal to the number of {@creature Coven Acolyte|DMSecretWeaponAdventures|Coven Acolytes} within 60 feet of it.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Coven Elder is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit +4} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Coven Elder makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger (Melee)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Dagger (Ranged)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +3} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one creature. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The holiday spirit can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Fluid Form
entries: The Holiday Spirit can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through and stop in a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spirit Siphon
entries: The Holiday Spirit draws power from festivities and collective emotion. The nature of any given festivity reflects the energy the creature is able to drain, determining its unique traits. The GM chooses from one of the traits from the Spirit Siphon table, selecting one that best reflects the celebrations that have drawn the spirit's attention.

entries.caption: Spirit Siphon Table
rows: The first time the spirit deals damage to a creature on its turn, it rolls {@dice 2d8}. That creature takes additional cold damage equal to the result. If the result on both dice are the same, the target instead gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the result, and resists all damage dealt by the spirit until the start of the spirit's next turn.
The spirit regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. This trait does not trigger if it took damage from a critical hit since the end of its last turn.

The spirit aggressively targets the focus of the festivity. It has advantage on attack rolls against the creature(s) who are the subject of the current celebration, and the first time it deals damage to such a creature on its turn, it gains {@dice 1d10} Temporary Hit Points and can use its reaction to move up to 30 feet.

The spirit is one with flowing champagne and neat spirits. The first time it deals damage to a creature each turn, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way is also intoxicated. It has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and Dexterity-based Attack Rolls, and speaks with slurred speech. A creature can repeat this save at the end of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

The Spirit knows the spell {@spell animate dead}, and can use its action to cast it without components. When it does so, it can choose the carcasses of beasts (such as carved chicken, suckling pig, etc.) to animate as zombies or skeletons, in addition to the bones and corpses of humanoids.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Holiday Spirit makes two Sapping Touch attacks.

action.name: Sapping Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) necrotic damage, and the target feels a wave of apathy wash over them. They have a -3 penalty to the next attack roll or saving throw they make before the end of their next turn.

action.name: Fluid Fling
entries: The Spirit hurls a fragment of its fluid body at a point it can see within 60 feet. Creatures within 10 feet of that point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) poison damage and falling {@condition prone} on a failed save. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and does not fall {@condition prone}.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The basic witch innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit +6} to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The basic witch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

bonus.name: Witch, PLEASE (2/Day)
entries: The basic witch exploits the vulnerability of one humanoid {@condition charmed} by her. That {@condition charmed} target automatically fails the next saving throw they make this turn against one of the witch's spells.

action.name: Pumpkin Spiced Karate
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The basic witch lets loose a mighty slap infused with pumpkin spice. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

ac.special: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Blistering Touch (Caustic Only)
entries: Creatures {@condition grappled} by or grappling the ooze take {@damage 1d8} + the spell's level acid damage at the start of the ooze's turn.

trait.name: Corrode Metal (Caustic Only)
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the ooze corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the ooze is destroyed after dealing damage. The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal in 1 round.

trait.name: Fungal Form (Fungal Only)
entries: The ooze is immune to poison damage and the {@condition poisoned} condition.

trait.name: Poison Spores (Fungal Only)
entries: Once per turn, when the ooze takes damage, it releases a cloud of spores. Creatures within 5 feet of it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC equals your Spell Save DC). On a failed save, that creature is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + 3} + the spell's level acid damage (caustic form) or poison damage (fungal form).

monster.name: Fungal Abomination
languages: understands any languages it knew as a humanoid but cannot speak

trait.name: Dank Moss
entries: While in sunlight, the mushroom folk has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. While in darkness or dim light, it has a +1 bonus to its AC and attack rolls.

action.name: Spore Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage.

action.name: Spore Burst (1/Day)
entries: The mushroom folk detonates a sack of spores hidden beneath the hood of its pileus. The mushroom folk takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, and non-plant creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way is also {@condition stunned}. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The fungal druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit +4} to hit with spell attacks). It may know additional spells and cantrips at the GMs discretion, but it has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Shillelagh Quarterstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Poison Spray
entries: The druid extends a hand toward a creature within 10 feet and projects a puff of noxious gas and spores. That creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 6 ({@damage 1d12}) poison damage.

trait.name: Divine Resistance
entries: Priest Set adds {@dice 1d4} to all saving throws.

bonus.name: War Cleric
entries: Priest Set makes a Longsword attack.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Sacred Flame
entries: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature Priest Set can see within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Fireball (3/Day)
entries: Priest Set casts the {@spell fireball} spell at 3rd level (save {@dc 15}).

action.name: Greater Invisibility (1/Day)
entries: Priest Set turns {@condition invisible}, along with everything he is wearing and carrying, for the next minute, or until he loses {@status concentration}.

monster.name: Divine Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Divine Resistance
entries: The golem adds {@dice 1d4} to all saving throws.

trait.name: Inured to Hellfire
entries: Whenever the divine golem is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Divine Balance (2/Day)
entries: The golem's eyes and mouth alight with blinding beams of radiance which focus on a creature it can see within 120 feet. That target makes a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it swaps its current Hit Points with those of the golem.

bonus.name: Conjure Water Elemental
entries: Ochtore summons a {@creature water elemental} in an unoccupied space within 90 feet. It takes its place in initiative immediately after his own. Ochtore can only have one elemental summoned in this way at a time.

bonus.name: Dispel Magic
entries: Ochtore targets one creature, object, or magical effect within 120 feet. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ochtore makes two Crushing Wave attacks.

action.name: Crushing Wave
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit +7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage and the target falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Lightning Bolt (3/Day)
entries: Ochtore extends a hand as a bolt of lightning crackles forth in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 ({@damage 9d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Illusory
entries: The phantasm is a malevolent, illusory force. It takes the shape of a creature of CR 1 or below that is most intimidating to the creatures in its vicinity. A creature suspicious of the phantasm's form can attempt a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check at the start of its turn, identifying the phantasm as an illusion on a success. If a creature is aware the phantasm is an illusion, it automatically succeeds on saving throws to resist the phantasm's Terrify action, and resists the damage of the phantasm's attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phantasm makes two Illusory Strike attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of the Terrify action.

action.name: Illusory Strike
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) psychic damage. When the phantasm attacks, its shape shifts to give the impression it is attacking with the form it has adopted. For example, a phantasm in the form of a brown bear appears to strike with its claws.

action.name: Terrify (2/Day)
entries: An unholy wave of terror rolls from the phantasm, washing over all non-fey creatures within 30 feet of it. Creatures in that area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the phantasm.

trait.name: Blood Fueled
entries: When the blood gnoll alpha deals damage to a creature that has fewer than half its maximum hit points remaining, it can immediately use its bonus action to move up to 30 feet without provoking opportunity attacks and make a single melee weapon attack against a different target.

trait.name: Blood Rage
entries: While the blood gnoll alpha has fewer than half its maximum hit points remaining, it has advantage on attack rolls and attack rolls made against it have advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blood gnoll alpha makes two attacks, choosing from its bite, spear, or longbow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +3} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

monster.name: Billie, the Greatest of All Time

immune.special: Billie is immune to all damage

trait.name: Charge
entries: If Billie moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: Billie has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock her {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Mountain Bound
entries: Billie cannot leave the mountain she resides upon by any means.

trait.name: The Greatest of All Time
entries: Billie is immune to effects that would cause her to fall to 0 hit points or kill her outright.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Havoc Tree

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The Havoc Tree deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Petrified Wood
entries: When the Havoc Tree drops to 0 hit points, it regains all hit points and becomes {@condition paralyzed} for {@dice 1d4} hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Havoc Tree makes three attacks between its Light Branch Slam and Casting Rock attacks. Each attack the Havoc Tree makes must target a different player.

action.name: Light Branch Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the Havoc Tree was dealt fire damage last turn, this attack deals an additional {@damage 1d6} fire damage.

action.name: Casting Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +8} to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

legendaryHeader: The Havoc Tree has legendary actions equal to the number of player characters minus 1.

legendary.name: Rock On!
entries: The Havoc Tree makes a Casting Rock attack.

legendary.name: Not my Sweet, Sweet Plumbs! (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Havoc Tree withdraws some branches to cover its trunk. It gains a +3 to its AC until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Heavy Branch Sweep (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Havoc Tree sweeps a heavy branch low to the ground, sweeping in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) bludgeoning damage and falling {@condition prone} on a failed save. If the Havoc Tree was dealt fire damage last turn, this attack deals an additional {@damage 1d6} fire damage on a failed save.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Moister can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Carrion Stench
entries: A {@condition poisoned} creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the Moister takes {@damage 1d6} poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Moister makes a pincer attack. If the Moister started its turn grappling at least one creature, the Moister also uses its bite attack against one grappled creature.

action.name: Pincer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the Moister doesn't have two other creatures grappled.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage. The target makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 14}), and becomes {@condition poisoned} on a failed save. A {@condition poisoned} creature may repeat this save at the start of their turn, ending the condition on a success.

trait.name: Evil by Nature
entries: Giant Buzzers are a type of wasp, and therefore are instantly recognisable to all sentient creatures as inherently, irredeemably evil.

action.name: Spicy Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Buzz Buzz {@recharge 5}
entries: The Giant Buzzer buzzes annoyingly. Any non-allied creature that can hear it within 100 ft. makes its next attack roll or saving throw with disadvantage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The Spice Leopard has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Spice Leopard has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Spice Leopard's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Spicy Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The Spice Leopard exhales its Spicy Breath in a 10-foot cone of gas. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and being {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Dutch Courage
entries: At the start of its turn, the Drunken Brawler can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: One Too Many
entries: After taking the Multiattack action on their turn, the Drunken Brawler must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take {@damage 1d4} poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Drunken Brawler makes two attacks, both with their Greataxe.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Acrobat's Agility {@recharge 5}
entries: Don can choose {@action Dodge} or {@action Disengage} as a bonus action.

action.name: Tidal Trident
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Thrown Sword
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit +6} to hit, range 20/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: The Show Goes On
entries: When an attacker Don can see hits him with an attack, he can use his reaction to halve the attack's damage only once.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The Seal-Iron can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Seal-Iron has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Seal-Iron's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Scalding Water {@recharge 5}
entries: The Seal-Iron fires a jet of scalding water. {@atk rw} {@hit +4} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

legendaryGroup.name: Mistwalker
lairActions: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the mistwalker takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects. The mistwalker can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

items: The mistwalker summons 2 {@creature Mistling|DMSecretWeapon|mistlings} to aid it in combat.

The mistwalker creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centred on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for 1 minute. The mistwalker can see through mist in its lair.

regionalEffects: The region containing a mistwalker's lair is permeated by flowing mist, creating the following effects:

items: Creatures that attempt to navigate the area within 5 miles of the mistwalker's lair cannot leave without the use of divination magic, finding themselves walking past the same stone or tree over and over again.
Thick fog blocks sunlight within 5 miles of the lair.
Crops spoil and animals flee within 5 miles of the lair.
The souls of creatures that die within 1 mile of the lair are trapped. They magically transform into {@creature Mistling|DMSecretWeapon|mistlings} that serve the mistwalker.

regionalEffects: If the mistwalker dies, these effects fade over the course of {@dice 1d10} hours.

legendaryGroup.name: The Rat Emperor
lairActions: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the rat emperor takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; the rat emperor can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

items: A giant {@creature swarm of rats} appear in a 30 ft. long 10 ft. wide line crawling out from burrows beneath the ground and attempt to carry hostile creatures in a direction of the rat emperor's choosing. Creatures caught in the rat stream must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be moved 20 ft. After this action is completed, the rats who formed the wave scatter and flee back underground.
The rat emperor summons {@dice 1d4 - 1} {@creature Ratsecutioner|DMSecretWeapon|Ratsecutioners} who appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of it.
An inebriated creature gains temporary hit points equal to 5 multiplied by their proficiency bonus when they become inebriated. The creature loses these temporary hit points when the condition ends.

An inebriated creature has advantage on Charisma checks to interact with friendly creatures with the inebriated condition, and disadvantage on Charisma checks to interact with all other creatures. In addition, they have advantage on saving throws to resist the {@condition frightened} condition, and disadvantage on Intelligence and Dexterity checks and saving throws.
The inebriated condition ends automatically after {@dice 1d8} hours, or when the creature finishes a long rest. This timer resets if the creature ingests more intoxicants.
Creatures immune to the poisoned condition are also immune to the inebriated condition.

entries.name: Guides For Use
entries: The inebriated condition will usually take effect when a creature in a game is drunk, although it could apply to any number of non-lethal intoxicants a player or creature might have ingested. If players are drinking alcohol, a GM can request a DC 0 Constitution saving throw to avoid the inebriated condition each time they finish a drink, with the DC increasing by 5 for each subsequent drink they take.

items: A creature with the freezing condition has disadvantage on dexterity-based attack rolls and saving throws, cannot make opportunity attacks, has a -2 penalty to its AC, a -10 foot penalty to its movement speed, and gains one point of {@condition exhaustion} each hour.
Creatures with a resistance to cold damage make saves to resist the freezing condition at advantage, and creatures with an immunity to cold damage are immune to the freezing condition.

A creature who spends 10 minutes warming themselves from a sufficient source of heat can end the freezing condition on themselves. Moving to a warm location, such as a heated tavern sheltered from the elements, will also end the condition after 10 minutes.

entries.name: A Note On Fire Damage
entries: A GM might consider an optional rule to end the freezing condition for a creature if that creature takes sufficient fire damage, or is set on fire. If so, it is recommended that the creature take fire damage at least once per turn, every turn, for 10 rounds to end the condition. A simple firebolt spell will be insufficient to rid the target of the deep, bone-aching chill of the freezing condition.

entries.name: Guides For Use
entries: The freezing condition will usually take effect when a creature is exposed to unusually cold temperatures over a significant amount of time (at least one hour). A simple cone of cold spell will not be enough to impart the freezing condition on a creature, and GM's should be careful not to arbitrarily buff all cold damage spells and effects with the freezing condition. However, a GM might choose to add the freezing condition to a particularly vicious and powerful White Dragon's breath weapon, or as a buff to cold damaging spells that are cast by a powerful frost giant sorcerer.

While players are moving through extremely cold areas, a GM can request a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw to avoid the freezing condition each hour, with the DC increasing by 5 for each subsequent hour they spend exposed to the elements.

items: A creature with the cursed condition cannot regain hit points and cannot gain the benefits of a short or long rest.

The cursed condition grows more potent when a creature is threatened. When in initiative in combat, a creature with the cursed condition rolls {@dice 1d8} at the start of each of its turns to determine one random negative effect from the table below.
The cursed condition ends if a creature dies, or if they are the target of a spell or effect that can end a curse, such as {@spell remove curse} or {@spell greater restoration}.

rows: You can act and move normally this turn.
You have a -{@dice 1d6} penalty on all attack rolls and ability checks this turn.
You cannot concentrate on spells or abilities until the end of this turn.
You cannot take bonus actions or reactions until the start of your next turn.
You take {@damage #$prompt_number:min=1,title=Enter a Number!,default=123$#d8|Xd8} necrotic damage, where X is equal to your proficiency bonus.
You must use your full movement this turn to move as close to the nearest hostile creature, and attack them, if able.

You are transformed into your choice of a {@creature Brown Bear}, {@creature Giant Eagle}, or {@creature Giant Toad}. Its game statistics replace your own, except your hit point total remains the same. You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form, and you can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech.

entries.name: Guides For Use
entries: The cursed condition does not mess around! Although the in-combat random effects can be nasty, its true power lies in the potential to kill players who cannot benefit from rests or recover their hit points. GM's can use the cursed condition as a long-term narrative complication, hassling players in combat against enemies that otherwise wouldn't be challenging as players desperately search for a way to break the curse.

The cursed condition grows less dangerous once the players access spells such as {@spell remove curse} and {@spell greater restoration}. A GM might consider requiring such spells to be upcast to a certain level to remove a cursed condition imparted by a very powerful magical object or spell.

entries.name: Optional Rule: Transformation
entries: This condition aims to bring complications to combat while still being fun. GM's might consider allowing higher level players who roll an 8 to transform themselves into more powerful beasts in casual games. A good rule of thumb is to offer three beasts as options of a CR equal to no more than 1/3rd the player's level. If a GM wishes to use this optional rule, they should choose the creatures in advance, have the stat blocks ready, and only ever offer three choices to the player in the interest of sparing them from "analysis paralysis". If you find your players are unable to choose quickly, you can have them roll {@dice 1d6}, taking the first transformation on a 1-2, the second on a 3-4, and the third on a 5-6.

items: A burning creature sheds bright light for 10 feet and dim light for a further 10 feet and gains no benefit from being invisible.
The burning creature and all creatures it is touching take 1d10 fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

The burning condition ends on a creature if it is fully submerged in water or a non-flammable liquid, or the creature uses an action to attempt a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 10}) to quell the flames. If this condition was imparted by a spell, the DC of the Dexterity saving throw to quell the flames is instead equal to the caster's spell save DC.

entries.name: Guides For Use
entries: The burning condition is essentially "being on fire". It might be triggered by taking a critical hit from a fire elemental, rolling a natural 1 on a Dexterity save to avoid a fireball, or as a penalty for storming through a burning building. Some players with a fire immunity or resistance, such as certain types of dragonborn and tieflings, might be able to exploit this condition while grappling creatures to deal more damage than they take.

items: A wounded creature has vulnerability to bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage.

The wounded condition ends if the wounded creature or an ally takes an action to attempt to stabilise it, which requires a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. Spells and items that stabilise a creature, such as the spare the dying cantrip, can target a wounded creature even if it doesn't have 0 hit points, and automatically end the wounded condition.

entries.name: Guides For Use
entries: The wounded condition attempts to fill a space in D&D conditions between negative debuffs ({@condition blinded}, {@condition frightened}, etc.) and "turn stealing" effects ({@condition stunned}, {@condition paralyzed}, etc.). Rather than demanding immediate action, it offers a choice to the target; fight on and risk massive damage, or take a turn off to attempt to heal? The wounded condition might be triggered by taking a critical hit from a weapon attack, taking over 50% damage from a single instance of bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage, or as a result of triggering a spiked trap.

items: A goaded creature becomes hostile to the creature(s) that goaded it.
A goaded creature has advantage on attack rolls made against the creature(s) that goaded it, and disadvantage on attack rolls made against any other target.
The goaded condition ends immediately if the creature that goaded a target falls to 0 hit points.

items.name: The Goad Action
entries: A creature can use its action to attempt to goad a creature that can see or hear it within 60 feet. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 10 + the goading creature's Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the target is goaded for the next minute. A goaded creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Guides For Use
entries: The goaded condition represents a creature being taunted or provoked to extreme action. A GM may decide to reward a player's creativity or roleplay by giving a target disadvantage on its Wisdom saving throw to resist the goaded condition. GM's may decide to give a player the goaded condition in response to a significant, narrative event— for example, in response to a character's ally being killed by an enemy.

condition.name: Bolstered
entries: A bolstered creature's speed increases by 10 feet, and it has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws to resist or end the {@condition Frightened} condition while the creature that bolstered it is within line of sight and isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Guides For Use
entries: The bolstered condition is a positive counterpart to the {@condition Frightened} condition. Bolstering an ally is a powerful, magical effect; it is unlikely that a simple display of comradery or positive words will be sufficient to grant the bolstered condition. With that in mind, a GM may decide to reward a player's collaborative roleplay by giving an ally the bolstered condition.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Shield
entries: You gain proficiency with shields and medium armor, and wearing medium armor doesn't impose disadvantage on your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

Over the course of a long rest, you can attune to a shield, bonding to it as you imbue it with eldritch magic. While holding that shield, you can speak its command word as a bonus action to cause it to animate. The shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The shield remains animated for 1 minute, until you use a bonus action to end this effect, or until you are {@condition incapacitated} or die, at which point the shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free. You can still only benefit from one shield at a time. Once you command your shield to animate in this way, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
If your bonded shield is destroyed or is more than 5-feet away from you, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony to conjure it in your hands, unharmed.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Shadow
entries: As an action, you or a creature you touch turns {@condition invisible} for a number of minutes equal to your Warlock level. This invisibility ends early if the invisible creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell, uses a bonus action to end the effect, or you use this feature again. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
You gain a bonus to {@skill Insight}, {@skill Perception}, and {@skill Stealth} checks equal to your Charisma modifier.
You learn the {@optfeature Devil's Sight} eldritch invocation or another eldritch invocation of your choice. This invocation doesn't count against the number of invocations you can learn.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Fortification
entries: You can cast {@spell shield of faith} at will, without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Abjuration
entries: You can cast the spell {@spell shield} a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, without expending a spell slot. You regain all expended uses of this feature when you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Fortification (9th Level)
entries: Your AC increases by 1.

optionalfeature.name: Eyes of Night
entries: You can cast the spell {@spell darkvision} at will, without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Gift of Shadows
entries: You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed while in dim light or darkness.

optionalfeature.name: Shadow Vanishing
entries: When you are hit by an attack roll, you can use a reaction to gain resistance to all damage from the triggering attack. You can then teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Shroud
entries: You can cast the spell {@spell darkness} at will, without expending a spell slot.
